summary_cn: 泰国经济学家警告，虽然包括东芝（Toshiba）等日本巨头因全球需求增长而扩大数据中心投资，但不应将所有经济希望寄托于此。数据中心产业创造的就业机会有限，建议泰国并行发展其他经济引擎，实现多元化增长。
desc_original: “เอกนิติ” ดึงยักษ์ใหญ่ญี่ปุ่นขยายลงทุนดาต้าเซ็นเตอร์ หลังดีมานด์โลกโต “โตชิบา” เตือน! อย่าฝากความหวังเศรษฐกิจไว้ที่ดาต้าเซ็นเตอร์อย่างเดียว เหตุจ้างงานน้อย แนะเร่งปั้นเครื่องยนต์อื่นควบคู่

title: Google หนุนไทยฮับดิจิทัลอาเซียน
desc: กฟผ.ผนึก Google พัฒนาโครงสร้างพื้นฐานระบบไฟฟ้า รองรับการขยายตัวของ Data Center ในไทย เดินหน้าพลังงานสะอาดไร้คาร์บอนตลอด 24 ชั่วโมง พร้อมเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพการใช้พลังงานในชุมชน
title_cn: Google携手泰国打造亚洲数字枢纽
summary_cn: 泰国电力公司与谷歌（Google）合作开发电力基础设施，支撑数据中心在泰国的扩张。项目将全天候提供清洁无碳电力，同时提升社区能源使用效率。这一举措有助于泰国建立亚洲数字中心的战略地位，促进数字经济发展。
desc_original: กฟผ.ผนึก Google พัฒนาโครงสร้างพื้นฐานระบบไฟฟ้า รองรับการขยายตัวของ Data Center ในไทย เดินหน้าพลังงานสะอาดไร้คาร์บอนตลอด 24 ชั่วโมง พร้อมเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพการใช้พลังงานในชุมชน

title: Mobile, fixed broadband value set to reach B452bn
desc: Thailand's mobile and fixed broadband industries are projected to generate a combined economic value of 406 billion baht in 2026, before rising to 452 billion baht by 2030, according to the National Board of Digital Economy and Society Office (BDE).
title_cn: 泰国移动宽带产业规模将达4520亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国国家数字经济与社会办公室（BDE）发布预测数据，全国移动通讯与固定宽带产业2026年经济产值为406亿泰铢，到2030年将增至452亿泰铢。这反映出泰国数字基础设施投资的持续增长趋势。
desc_original: Thailand's mobile and fixed broadband industries are projected to generate a combined economic value of 406 billion baht in 2026, before rising to 452 billion baht by 2030, according to the National Board of Digital Economy and Society Office (BDE).

title: Sea row talks move to KL
desc: Thailand and Cambodia will hold a third round of conciliation talks over their maritime dispute in Kuala Lumpur from Tuesday to Friday under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (Unclos).
title_cn: 泰柬海域争端谈判移至吉隆坡进行
summary_cn: 泰国与柬埔寨就海洋边界纠纷启动第三轮调解谈判，定于本周二至周五在吉隆坡进行。谈判将按照联合国《海洋法公约》（Unclos）框架展开，旨在通过国际法律程序和平解决双方的海域划分争议。
desc_original: Thailand and Cambodia will hold a third round of conciliation talks over their maritime dispute in Kuala Lumpur from Tuesday to Friday under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (Unclos).

title: PCE backs state plan to expand B20 biodiesel use
desc: SET-listed Petchsrivichai Enterprise (PCE) says it is prepared to support the government's plan to expand B20 biodiesel use, citing ample production capacity and a strong supply chain despite concerns over weather-related pressure on palm oil output.
title_cn: PCE公司支持政府扩大B20生物柴油使用
summary_cn: 泰国上市公司佩奇瑞维奇企业（PCE）表示支持政府扩大B20生物柴油应用的计划。该公司拥有充足生产能力和强大供应链网络，尽管天气变化对棕榈油产出造成压力，但PCE对未来供应仍保持乐观，积极推动泰国绿色能源转型。
desc_original: SET-listed Petchsrivichai Enterprise (PCE) says it is prepared to support the government's plan to expand B20 biodiesel use, citing ample production capacity and a strong supply chain despite concerns over weather-related pressure on palm oil output.

title: Ministry downplays fears over arsenic
desc: The Ministry of Public Health has found no cases of acute or chronic arsenic poisoning among residents living and working along the Kok, Sai, Ruak and Mekong rivers, despite concerns over contamination.
title_cn: 公共卫生部否认河水砷污染健康风险
summary_cn: 公共卫生部证实，在克河 Kok、赛河 Sai、瑞河 Ruak 和湄公河沿线居住和工作的居民中，未发现急性或慢性砷中毒病例。这在一定程度上打消了公众对水源砷污染的担忧。公共卫生部的调查结果表明，尽管存在污染顾虑，但目前居民的健康状况良好。
desc_original: The Ministry of Public Health has found no cases of acute or chronic arsenic poisoning among residents living and working along the Kok, Sai, Ruak and Mekong rivers, despite concerns over contamination.

title: Officials step in to ease rice milling fears in Chiang Rai
desc: The government says it is stepping up efforts to support rice farmers in Chiang Rai province, amid concerns over arsenic contamination from polluted border rivers.
title_cn: 政府加大力度支持清莱水稻农民应对砷污染
summary_cn: 清莱省面临边界河流污染导致的砷污染威胁，对当地稻米生产造成冲击。政府宣布加大力度支持受影响的水稻农民，推出措施缓解农民和消费者对食品安全的担忧。该举措旨在稳定当地农业生产，同时重建消费者对清莱米产品的信心，应对跨境河流污染造成的食品安全隐患。
desc_original: The government says it is stepping up efforts to support rice farmers in Chiang Rai province, amid concerns over arsenic contamination from polluted border rivers.

title: Public backs rally, but few  keen to join
desc: Nearly two-thirds of respondents support the protest movement led by Mano Khrueakaew, better known as Kamnan Mano, but most have no intention of joining demonstrations, according to a Nida Poll released on Sunday.
title_cn: 民众支持抗争运动，但参与度不高
summary_cn: 尼达民调（Nida Poll）显示，近三分之二的泰国受访者支持卡南曼诺（Kamnan Mano）领导的抗议运动，支持度相当可观。然而，调查也发现大多数受访者表示无意实际参加示威活动。这反映出泰国民众对抗争运动理念的认可度与实际参与意愿之间存在显著差异，民调于周日发布。
desc_original: Nearly two-thirds of respondents support the protest movement led by Mano Khrueakaew, better known as Kamnan Mano, but most have no intention of joining demonstrations, according to a Nida Poll released on Sunday.

title: Network demands urgent action on river pollution
desc: A civic network has called on the government to step up efforts to tackle heavy-metal contamination in six rivers, including by addressing pollution from mines in Myanmar and speeding up water and soil testing in eight Thai provinces.
title_cn: 民间组织呼吁政府紧急应对河流污染
summary_cn: 一个民间网络组织向政府呼吁加快应对六条河流中的重金属污染问题。该组织要求政府采取措施解决来自缅甸矿山的污染源，并加速在八个泰国省份进行水和土壤检测。这一举动反映出民众对跨境环境污染和食品安全日益关注和担忧。
desc_original: A civic network has called on the government to step up efforts to tackle heavy-metal contamination in six rivers, including by addressing pollution from mines in Myanmar and speeding up water and soil testing in eight Thai provinces.

title: Banks drive growth in second-hand home supply
desc: The growing supply of bank-owned distressed properties is adding to second-hand housing stock while making commercial banks more cautious about extending new home loans, according to the Real Estate Information Center (REIC).
title_cn: 银行不良资产推动二手房供应增长
summary_cn: 房地产信息中心（REIC）指出，银行持有的困难资产正在增加二手房屋供应。这导致商业银行在发放新房贷款时态度变得更为谨慎。这一趋势反映出泰国房地产市场正在调整，可能为首次购房者提供机会，同时也反映出银行对新贷款风险的担忧。
desc_original: The growing supply of bank-owned distressed properties is adding to second-hand housing stock while making commercial banks more cautious about extending new home loans, according to the Real Estate Information Center (REIC).

title: Carmakers face uncertain future
desc: Thailand's automotive industry is undergoing one of the most significant transformations in its history, as carmakers grapple with a challenging mix of economic uncertainty, geopolitical tensions, fierce price competition and the rapid transition towards new-energy vehicles.
title_cn: 汽车制造商面临不确定的未来
summary_cn: 泰国汽车产业正经历历史上最重大的转型期，面临经济不确定、地缘政治紧张、价格竞争激烈、向新能源车转型等多重挑战。业界分析认为，这种由多个因素交织而成的困境，使得泰国汽车制造商必须在短期内应对市场压力，同时为长期的产业转型做好准备。这种不确定性也反映了全球汽车产业正在经历的重大变革。
desc_original: Thailand's automotive industry is undergoing one of the most significant transformations in its history, as carmakers grapple with a challenging mix of economic uncertainty, geopolitical tensions, fierce price competition and the rapid transition towards new-energy vehicles.

title: TikTok Shop identifies key emerging shopping trends
desc: Thai consumers are turning to Thai brands and increasingly buying products discovered through founder-led brand storytelling, livestream demonstrations and short videos, reshaping how local brands compete in the e-commerce market, according to TikTok Shop.
title_cn: TikTok小店发现新兴购物趋势
summary_cn: 泰国消费者的购物习惯正在快速改变，越来越多人倾向选择泰国本土品牌，并通过创始人讲述品牌故事、直播展演、短视频等创新渠道发现和购买产品。这一消费新趋势正在重塑本地品牌在电商市场上的竞争格局，为泰国品牌和中小企业提供了全新的增长机遇，也表明社交电商正逐渐成为泰国零售市场的重要力量。
desc_original: Thai consumers are turning to Thai brands and increasingly buying products discovered through founder-led brand storytelling, livestream demonstrations and short videos, reshaping how local brands compete in the e-commerce market, according to TikTok Shop.

title: Businesses urged to prep for quantum era
desc: Quantum computing could open up new business opportunities for financial services beyond its potential threat to data encryption, with SCBX urging Thai businesses to prepare for both the risks and commercial applications of the emerging technology.
title_cn: 企业需为量子时代做准备
summary_cn: 量子计算技术即将成为现实，既存在风险也蕴含机遇。一方面可能威胁现有数据加密体系；另一方面为金融服务、物流、科研等领域开启新商机。泰国盛盛互联（SCBX）呼吁泰国企业和组织提前认识量子技术的双面性，既要防范潜在风险，更要抓住新兴技术带来的商业机遇，为量子时代的到来做好充分准备。
desc_original: Quantum computing could open up new business opportunities for financial services beyond its potential threat to data encryption, with SCBX urging Thai businesses to prepare for both the risks and commercial applications of the emerging technology.

title: Joint venture pioneers organ transplants
desc: Mahidol University has partnered with SET-listed Betagro Plc and New Zealand-based NZeno Limited to establish a joint venture focused on developing innovations in pig-to-human transplantation, with the ultimate goal of enabling kidney transplants from pigs to humans.
title_cn: 异种器官移植迎来新突破
summary_cn: 玛希隆大学（Mahidol University）与泰国上市企业Betagro Plc及新西兰公司NZeno Limited建立合资企业，共同推进异种器官移植技术研发。该项目聚焦于开发从猪到人的器官移植创新方案，最终目标是实现猪肾脏向人类移植。若成功，这将在医疗领域掀起革命，为数百万需要器官移植的患者提供全新的治疗选择和生存希望。
desc_original: Mahidol University has partnered with SET-listed Betagro Plc and New Zealand-based NZeno Limited to establish a joint venture focused on developing innovations in pig-to-human transplantation, with the ultimate goal of enabling kidney transplants from pigs to humans.

title: Office mulls new option for individual savings scheme
desc: The Fiscal Policy Office (FPO) has proposed adding a new option to the Thailand Individual Savings Account (TISA) scheme, a long-term savings and investment scheme that offers tax deductions, allowing parents to claim tax benefits on investments made for their children's long-term savings.
title_cn: 个人储蓄计划拟增新选项
summary_cn: 泰国财政部建议为「泰国个人储蓄账户」（TISA）这一长期储蓄投资方案增加新选项。新提案的关键亮点是允许父母为子女的长期储蓄和投资申请税收减免优惠。这项措施旨在鼓励家庭进行长期财务规划，特别是针对儿童和青少年的教育储蓄，同时促进国民储蓄率提升，支撑泰国的经济发展。
desc_original: The Fiscal Policy Office (FPO) has proposed adding a new option to the Thailand Individual Savings Account (TISA) scheme, a long-term savings and investment scheme that offers tax deductions, allowing parents to claim tax benefits on investments made for their children's long-term savings.

title: Is all well at the BoT?
desc: An unusual public dispute has recently erupted within the Bank of Thailand, following a sharp public rebuke by its chairman, Somchai Sujjapongse, on Nov 15 over what he described as the central bank's slow progress in reviewing proposed legislative amendments and its failure to reverse the prolonged contraction in SME lending, which has continued for 17 consecutive quarters.
title_cn: 泰国央行前景堪忧
summary_cn: 泰国央行近期出现罕见的内部公开纷争。央行主席索姆柴·素贾蓬（Somchai Sujjapongse）在11月15日对央行工作提出尖锐批评，指责其在审查拟议法律修正案方面进展缓慢，以及未能扭转中小企业（SME）贷款持续萎缩的局面——相关贷款已连续萎缩17个季度。这一罕见的公开内部分歧反映了央行面临的政策执行压力。
desc_original: An unusual public dispute has recently erupted within the Bank of Thailand, following a sharp public rebuke by its chairman, Somchai Sujjapongse, on Nov 15 over what he described as the central bank's slow progress in reviewing proposed legislative amendments and its failure to reverse the prolonged contraction in SME lending, which has continued for 17 consecutive quarters.

title: Small firms urged to seize Chinese growth opportunities
desc: The Office of Small and Medium Enterprise Promotion (Osmep) is urging small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to explore new markets amid growing uncertainty.
title_cn: 泰国中小企业受促开拓中国市场
summary_cn: 在全球经济不确定性加剧的背景下，泰国中小企业委员会（Osmep）主动出击，敦促本国中小企业（SMEs）把握中国市场增长机遇，积极开拓新的商业市场。这一政策导向反映泰国在应对外部经济压力时的战略性调整，鼓励中小企业寻求新的增长点以应对本土市场挑战。
desc_original: The Office of Small and Medium Enterprise Promotion (Osmep) is urging small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to explore new markets amid growing uncertainty.

title: Singer Kong testifies in Gun probe
desc: Popular folk singer Kong Huayrai said that he has provided proof to the authorities that he had donated money to the Gun Jompalang Chuai Su Foundation for families affected by the State Audit Office (SAO) building collapse.
title_cn: 民歌手孔为国家审计局坍塌事件作证
summary_cn: 泰国知名民歌手孔·华叻（Kong Huayrai）就向受国家审计局（SAO）大楼倒塌事件影响的家庭救助基金会Gun Jompalang Chuai Su Foundation捐款一事向当局提供了证明材料。国家审计局大楼坍塌是泰国近年的重大灾难事件，造成大量伤亡，相关部门正在进行深入调查以确认责任。
desc_original: Popular folk singer Kong Huayrai said that he has provided proof to the authorities that he had donated money to the Gun Jompalang Chuai Su Foundation for families affected by the State Audit Office (SAO) building collapse.

title: Four arrested over 'nominee scheme'
desc: Immigration police have arrested a Chinese businessman and three Thai women over a suspected nominee-shareholding scheme aimed at circumventing restrictions on foreign business operations in Chon Buri.
title_cn: 春武里：四人因外资代理股权计划被捕
summary_cn: 春武里府（Chon Buri）移民警察成功破获一起外资规避经营限制的案件，逮捕了1名中国商人和3名泰国女性。他们涉嫌利用代理人持股方案，以泰国公民名义隐性控制企业，从而规避泰国对外资直接经营的法律限制。这类「代理股权计划」是外资非法进入限制性行业的常见手段。
desc_original: Immigration police have arrested a Chinese businessman and three Thai women over a suspected nominee-shareholding scheme aimed at circumventing restrictions on foreign business operations in Chon Buri.

title: “วราวุธ” เปิดงาน “สนามชัยบ้านฉัน มหัศจรรย์ สีสัน 4 ภาค”
desc: “วราวุธ” เปิดงาน “สนามชัยบ้านฉัน มหัศจรรย์ สีสัน 4 ภาค” จัดเต็ม 3 วัน โชว์ของดีของสนามชัย วัฒนธรรมเหนือ-กลาง-อีสาน-ใต้
title_cn: 沃拉武德启动「宋素之家奇幻色彩四地区」文化展活动
summary_cn: 泰国官员沃拉武德（Vorawut）启动为期三天的「宋素之家（Sanam Chai）奇幻色彩四地区」大型文化推广活动。活动集中展示宋素地区的传统工艺、特产商品，以及来自泰国北部、中部、东北部、南部四个地区的特色文化，旨在推介地方文化遗产与经济发展。
desc_original: “วราวุธ” เปิดงาน “สนามชัยบ้านฉัน มหัศจรรย์ สีสัน 4 ภาค” จัดเต็ม 3 วัน โชว์ของดีของสนามชัย วัฒนธรรมเหนือ-กลาง-อีสาน-ใต้

title: “เท่าพิภพ” ให้กำลังใจ “ไอซ์ รักชนก”เชื่อ “ฟ้าจะเป็นใจให้ไอซ์รอด”
desc: “เท่าพิภพ” ให้กำลังใจ “ไอซ์ รักชนก” ฟังคำพิพากษาคดีม.112 พรุ่งนี้ เชื่อ “ฟ้าจะเป็นใจให้ไอซ์รอด”
title_cn: 某官员为冰·拉坤打气 相信天意保佑其渡难关
summary_cn: 某高层官员为面临宪法第112条判决的人民党议员冰·拉坤（Ice Rukchanok）打气鼓励，表示相信上天会保佑其渡过难关。宪法第112条涉及违反君主制罪名，对泰国政坛影响深远，该案件备受关注。
desc_original: “เท่าพิภพ” ให้กำลังใจ “ไอซ์ รักชนก” ฟังคำพิพากษาคดีม.112 พรุ่งนี้ เชื่อ “ฟ้าจะเป็นใจให้ไอซ์รอด”

title: พัทลุงอ่วม น้ำป่าไหลท่วมพื้นที่ 3 อำเภอ “ควนขนุน” สังเวยแล้ว 1 ศพ
desc: น้ำท่วม 3 อำเภอระดับน้ำยังเพิ่มขึ้น ล่าสุดน้ำไหลผ่านเส้นทางเข้าอำเภอศรีบรรพต รถทุกชนิดต้องใช้ความระมัดระวัง พบผู้เสียชีวิตแล้ว 1 ศพ
title_cn: 帕图隆府洪灾 3县被淹已致1人遇难
summary_cn: 泰国南部帕图隆府（Phatthalung）遭遇山洪灾害，3个县区被洪水淹没，水位持续上升。洪水已蔓延至县城主干道，所有车辆需谨慎通行。截至目前已确认1人遇难，灾情仍在发展中。

title: Proxy shares network busted, 7 arrests
desc: Seven suspects have been arrested for alleged involvement in a foreign criminal network using Thai nationals as proxy shareholders to facilitate illegal business activity and property ownership in Chon Buri province.
title_cn: 代理股东网络被破获 7人被逮捕
summary_cn: 泰国警方成功破获一个由外籍犯罪分子主导的跨国非法网络，该网络利用泰国国民作为代理股东掩护，进行违法商业运作和不动产登记，以规避针对外资产权的法律限制。此案发生在春武里府（Chon Buri），7名嫌疑人已被逮捕。案件反映了泰国当局对涉外非法产权活动日益严厉的打击力度，对在泰经营和投资的外资具有警示意义。

title: Luxury cruise ship brings international tourists to Pattaya
desc: Luxury cruise ship brings international tourists to Pattaya Legacy One of the world’s most luxurious cruise ships , the Seven Seas Explorer, arrived in Chon Buri yesterday, November 21, bringing hundreds of international tourists to explore Pattaya , Sattahip and other destinations in Thailand. Operated by Regent Seven Seas Cruises, the vessel docked at Chuk Samet Port in Sattahip district at around 9am, where tour buses were waiting to take passengers on excursions. Travellers could choose from several destinations, including Nong Nooch Tropical Garden, Pattaya and other attractions in Chon Buri, while some headed to Bangkok. The ship is scheduled to leave the port today, November 22, at approximately 5pm. desc: Mongolian woman arrested over theft at Suvarnabhumi Airport Legacy A Mongolian woman was arrested at Suvarnabhumi Airport for allegedly stealing from a Thai passenger . Police are investigating her possible involvement in three earlier thefts involving Japanese and Chinese travellers. The arrest took place yesterday, November 21, following reports of missing belongings from passengers at the airport earlier in the week. Between November 17 and 20, Japanese and Chinese passengers reported three separate thefts on the fourth floor of the passenger terminal. The missing items included cash, credit cards and important documents, with some victims also reporting unauthorised credit card transactions. CCTV footage from the three incidents showed a suspect with similar features, and further checks suggested the person had been travelling to and from the airport via the Airport Rail Link. title: Tarutao National Park rangers rescue 22 tourists after boat engine fails
desc: Tarutao National Park rangers rescue 22 tourists after boat engine fails Legacy Park rangers and navy personnel rescued 22 tourists stranded at sea in Satun’s Tarutao National Park after their tour boat’s engine failed on Saturday, November 21, Matichon reported. The group was scuba diving near Koh Phueng when the engine broke down and strong winds pushed the boat away from them. Rescuers took all 22 ashore at Ao Ling on Koh Dong, and the group later returned to Koh Lipe. The head of Tarutao National Park, Surachai Thathet, received the report at about 11.10am. Surachai said the engine failure meant the crew could not reverse the boat to pick up the group, and the rough sea carried it further away. He sent rangers from two park stations to the scene, along with navy personnel based on Koh Lipe. Park officials later found the boat, named Chalam Wan, washed up on the eastern side of Koh Dong. They are inspecting it and will help the operator recover it. title: Proposed AI system claims it can cut river arsenic by 94.6%
desc: Proposed AI system claims it can cut river arsenic by 94.6% Legacy Thailand plans to test an AI-powered water treatment system that simulations suggest could reduce arsenic levels in the Sai River by up to 94.6%, potentially protecting 27,000 rai of farmland in Chiang Rai. The government has approved an 18-month pilot project in Mae Sai, covering the 2027 rainy season , as part of efforts to tackle arsenic contamination in the Kok and Sai rivers. Deputy government spokesperson Patdarasm Thongsaluaykorn said the technology was developed by researchers from Thailand Science Research and Innovation, Naresuan University and the DHI Institute. The system uses AI to monitor water turbidity and divert muddy water into treatment ponds when necessary, where chemicals help separate arsenic-carrying sediment. Treated water is tested before being returned to the river, while contaminated sediment is collected and handled under established safety standards. Photo via Facebook: Suchart Chomklin Researchers tested the design using a digital river model covering 523 days. Simulations showed that three treatment units installed along kilometres 95 to 99 of the Sai River could reduce arsenic levels

title: Anutin orders strict Chiang Mai burning enforcement before smog season
desc: Anutin orders strict Chiang Mai burning enforcement before smog season Legacy Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered northern provinces, above all Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai, to enforce burning laws in full against anyone setting fire to weeds, forests or crop residue before the PM2.5 smog season. Provincial officials must also step up patrols and keep firefighting crews and equipment ready to move in as soon as burning is found. Anutin gave the order at 11am yesterday, November 21, as he chaired a meeting of the National Disaster Prevention and Mitigation Command at Government House in Bangkok, which had been called mainly to deal with contaminated water sources. He also told the provinces to run public awareness campaigns, and he directed the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation to help high-risk areas prepare. At the same meeting, Anutin, who is also interior minister, told the Interior Ministry to prepare for flooding in South Thailand and have relief plans ready in advance. title: Yi Peng festival affects 189 flights in Chiang Mai, Lamphun
desc: Yi Peng festival affects 189 flights in Chiang Mai, Lamphun Legacy Airlines have cancelled 52 flights and rescheduled another 137 ahead of the Loy Krathong and Yi Peng festivals in Chiang Mai and Lamphun, as aviation officials prepare for the release of sky lanterns that could affect aircraft operations. A total of 189 flights will be affected between November 23 and 25, while airlines have scheduled 63 additional flights to accommodate the expected increase in visitors. Deputy Transport Minister Phattharaphong Phattharaprasit announced the preparations on November 20, saying large numbers of Thai and foreign tourists were expected to travel to Chiang Mai and Lamphun for the celebrations on November 24 and 25. He said Aeronautical Radio of Thailand (AEROTHAI) had been instructed to coordinate flight schedules and introduce safety measures to reduce risks from sky lanterns and smoke lanterns. title: Bangkok’s Prachim Ratthaya Expressway toll rise due December 15, delay studied
desc: Bangkok’s Prachim Ratthaya Expressway toll rise due December 15, delay studied Legacy The car toll on Bangkok’s Prachim Ratthaya Expressway, the Si Rat to Outer Ring Road route, is due to rise from 65 to 80 baht on December 15, but the Expressway Authority of Thailand (EXAT) will meet the operator next week to look at easing the increase or putting it back. Under the new rates, vehicles with more than four and up to 10 wheels will pay 130 baht instead of 105 baht, a rise of 25 baht. Vehicles with more than 10 wheels face the biggest increase, 35 baht, taking their toll from 150 to 185 baht. EXAT said the rise is not a new charge but follows the 30-year concession it signed with Bangkok Expressway and Metro (BEM) on September 14, 2012, which calls for tolls to be reviewed by vehicle type every five years. Tolls last went up in 2021, and the Transport Ministry notice setting the new rates appeared in the Royal Gazette on September 15. title: New skywalk eases access to historic Talat Phlu community
desc: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has opened a new skywalk across Khlong Bangkok Yai, linking Bangkok Yai and Thon Buri districts and improving access to the historic Talat Phlu community.
title_cn: 曼谷新建人行天桥 便利塔拉普鲁历史社区出行
summary_cn: 曼谷大都会管理局（BMA）新开放了一条横跨郭邦艾运河（Khlong Bangkok Yai）的天桥，连接曼谷艾区（Bangkok Yai）和通武里区（Thon Buri）。这项基础设施改善工程大幅便利了进入历史悠久的塔拉普鲁社区（Talat Phlu）的出行，为当地居民和游客提供了更安全便利的通道。
desc_original: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has opened a new skywalk across Khlong Bangkok Yai, linking Bangkok Yai and Thon Buri districts and improving access to the historic Talat Phlu community.

title: Thai youth showcase conservation efforts at COP31 climate summit
desc: Thai youth representatives took centre stage at the UN's COP31 climate summit, sharing their experiences in forest and wildlife conservation and highlighting young people's role in environmental protection.
title_cn: 泰国青年在COP31气候峰会展示生态保护成果
summary_cn: 泰国青年代表在联合国COP31气候峰会上发声，分享森林与野生动物保护的实践经验与成果。泰国青年通过展示本地生态保护项目，强调年轻一代在应对气候变化和环保中的重要角色，彰显泰国在全球气候行动中的承诺。
desc_original: Thai youth representatives took centre stage at the UN's COP31 climate summit, sharing their experiences in forest and wildlife conservation and highlighting young people's role in environmental protection.

title: PM rejects Cambodia  conciliation
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has reaffirmed Thailand's opposition to Cambodia's compulsory conciliation bid over their maritime dispute, warning that other bilateral talks cannot proceed while Phnom Penh insists on that approach.
title_cn: 总理拒绝柬埔寨调解提案
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷·查尼瓦拉重申，泰国坚决反对柬埔寨对泰柬海事争端提出的强制调解方案。他明确警告，只要金边（Phnom Penh）继续坚持强制调解立场，双方的其他重要双边会谈将无法取得进展。此举充分反映了泰国在维护领土主权和海事权益上的原则立场。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has reaffirmed Thailand's opposition to Cambodia's compulsory conciliation bid over their maritime dispute, warning that other bilateral talks cannot proceed while Phnom Penh insists on that approach.

title: NACC member in soup over 'bribe'
desc: An independent panel has unanimously found grounds to pursue corruption allegations against National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) member Ekkawit Watchawalku over an alleged 246-baht gold bribe from former deputy national police chief Pol Gen Surachate Hakparn, news media say.
title_cn: 国家反腐委员会成员因受贿陷入困境
summary_cn: 独立调查小组一致裁定，对国家反腐委员会成员艾卡威特指控其从前副警察局长苏拉差特收取246泰铢黄金贿赂有充分理由追究。这一腐败丑闻涉及政府高层廉政问题，直接威胁国家反腐机构本身的公信力和独立性。此案件引起各方关注，可能对泰国反腐工作和政治环境产生重要影响。
desc_original: An independent panel has unanimously found grounds to pursue corruption allegations against National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) member Ekkawit Watchawalku over an alleged 246-baht gold bribe from former deputy national police chief Pol Gen Surachate Hakparn, news media say.

title: Faith finds a greener path
desc: Thailand's so-called "faith economy" has become an economic driver as people increasingly turn to spiritual items in search of luck and prosperity. But the growing popularity of religious offerings has created a waste problem for temples and shrines, prompting calls for a greener approach to faith.
title_cn: 信仰找到「绿色」之路
summary_cn: 泰国的「信仰经济」已成为重要的经济增长驱动力，民众为求好运和繁荣纷纷购买宗教用品。然而宗教祭品激增给寺庙和神社带来严重的废弃物问题，引发人们对更加环保方式的呼吁。许多信仰场所正在探索可持续发展的供奉模式，以平衡精神信仰与生态保护。
desc_original: Thailand's so-called "faith economy" has become an economic driver as people increasingly turn to spiritual items in search of luck and prosperity. But the growing popularity of religious offerings has created a waste problem for temples and shrines, prompting calls for a greener approach to faith.

title: Anutin defends US trade agreement as best possible outcome
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul defended Thailand's trade deal with the US, insisting the kingdom had secured the greatest possible benefits despite its limited bargaining power.
title_cn: 阿努廷为泰美贸易协议辩护称系最佳方案
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷为日前签署的泰美贸易协议进行辩护，表示鉴于泰国在国际贸易谈判中的相对地位限制，该协议已成功争取到了最大可能利益。协议涉及关税减让、农产品贸易、制造业合作等关键领域，对泰国经济发展具有长远意义。此协议是泰国经济外交战略的重要成果。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul defended Thailand's trade deal with the US, insisting the kingdom had secured the greatest possible benefits despite its limited bargaining power.

title: Ties with Myanmar stay despite ICJ ruling: PM
desc: Thailand will maintain relations with Myanmar despite an International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Saturday.
title_cn: 国际法院裁决后泰国与缅甸关系不变
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷宣布，尽管国际法院（ICJ）近日裁定缅甸对罗兴亚人（Rohingya）犯有种族灭绝罪，泰国将继续维持与缅甸的外交关系和双边合作。这一表态充分显示泰国在地区外交中采取的实用主义立场，优先考虑与邻国的经贸利益和战略协调。泰国与东南亚邻国的关系仍以实际合作为核心。

desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said he is monitoring demonstrations by the Gen Z protest movement but has not seen indications the rallies are escalating.

title: 973 pavilions set for royal cremation

title: Govt moves to curb river toxins
desc: The government is preparing to declare pollution control zones covering more than 150 kilometres along the Mekong River and surrounding areas as it steps up efforts to tackle contamination affecting water sources in the upper North.

summary_cn: 泰国政府正筹备宣布沿湄公河（Mekong）及周边地区超过150公里的污染控制区，进一步加强污染控制工作，以解决影响泰国北部水源的污染问题。此举旨在保护当地饮用水安全和环境卫生。

title: Chanthaburi elephant calf losing fear of people, keepers cut contact
desc: Chanthaburi elephant calf losing fear of people, keepers cut contact Legacy An orphaned wild elephant calf at the Khao Soi Dao Wildlife Breeding Station in Chanthaburi has begun following its keepers and lost its fear of people, so staff have cut back on direct contact to keep it from becoming tame. Vets reported yesterday, November 21, that the male calf, aged about one to two years, is healthy and recovering steadily. The Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) moved the calf to the station late on November 1, after rangers found it standing beside its dead mother in a rubber plantation in Phawa subdistrict, Kaeng Hang Maeo district, with a loose snare on its front left leg. A post-mortem was ordered on the mother, and no cause of death has been made public. Keepers have changed the way they feed the calf and now strictly limit touching it, the station’s veterinary team said, because they want to keep its wild instincts as intact as possible. The calf now eats 13.4 kilogrammes of natural plants a day, including banana stems and leaves, ripe bananas, bamboo leaves and wild grasses. title: QR code tickets to replace MRT tokens from Jan 1
desc: The operator of the MRT Blue and Purple lines in Bangkok is preparing to replace traditional single-journey tokens with QR code tickets, with passengers expected to be able to test the new system from December.
title_cn: 地铁升级换新：二维码车票将于1月起取代传统代币
summary_cn: 曼谷地铁蓝线和紫线运营商计划从2027年1月1日起，用QR code二维码车票取代传统单程代币。乘客可从12月起开始测试这一新系统。此项升级将提升出行便利度，推进曼谷公共交通现代化建设。

title: Thailand land appraisal values to rise 16% from January, lifting property costs
desc: Thailand land appraisal values to rise 16% from January, lifting property costs Legacy Official land appraisal values across Thailand will rise by more than 16% on average from January 1, 2027, and the highest, on central Bangkok roads such as Silom and Ploenchit , will pass 1 million baht per square wah. Buyers, owners and developers will pay higher transfer fees and land tax on the new values. Treasury Department Director-General Teeraluck Saengsanit told Prachachat Turakij that the department has revalued 37 million plots for the 2027 to 2030 cycle, replacing values from 2023 to 2026 that were compiled seven to eight years ago. The largest increases fall on Bangkok business roads such as Rama I and Wireless Road, though official values there still sit below selling prices. Photo courtesy of Prachachat The Agency for Real Estate Affairs (AREA), a private valuation firm, puts market prices for Siam, Chidlom and Ploenchit at 3.95 million baht per square wah this year, up 2.6%, with Wireless Road at 3.15 million baht, according to its president Sopon Pornchokchai. He forecast that land prices would rise by an average of 3.5% a year from 2027 to 2032. Isara Boonyoung, honorary presid

title: Thailand foreign tourist arrivals reach 26.76 million, down 4.66%
desc: Thailand foreign tourist arrivals reach 26.76 million, down 4.66% Legacy Thailand foreign tourist arrivals reached 26.76 million between January 1 and November 14, which is 4.66% fewer than in the same period last year, and the government has stepped up its high-season promotions. The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) expects about 6 million foreign visitors in November and December, roughly 3 million a month. Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul said foreign visitors spent 1,304,947 million baht over the period. China was the largest market with 4,385,062 arrivals, followed by Malaysia with 3,384,864, India with 2,013,658, Russia with 1,515,102 and South Korea with 977,164. In the week of November 8 to 14, the ministry said, arrivals rose 4.26% on the previous week to an average of 94,789 a day. Short-haul markets grew 2.15%, helped by a 42.40% jump in visitors from India, while long-haul markets grew 7.04%. Some European markets are also recovering. The fall in French arrivals narrowed from 6.32% in October to 2.16% last week, and German arrivals, which were down 6.61% in October, grew 0.52%. title: Chiang Rai river pollution zone planned as hotel bookings fall below half
desc: Chiang Rai river pollution zone planned as hotel bookings fall below half Legacy Thailand plans to declare a pollution control zone covering more than 100 kilometres of the Kok, Sai and Ruak rivers over contamination blamed on mining in Myanmar, and a tourism group says Chiang Rai hotel bookings have fallen below 50%. Thai and Myanmar officials meet in Bangkok on November 25 and 26. Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin said Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul had ordered the zone, which would last about six months and could reach 500 metres to 1 kilometre inland. Measures could include bans on activities that release toxins, round-the-clock monitoring and controls on moving chemicals. The Pollution Control Department is due to submit the proposal on November 27, and the National Environment Board, chaired by Deputy Prime Minister Songsak Thongsri, will receive the plan on December 2. title: Malaysian arrested over alleged Bangkok phone scam that cost woman 8 million baht
desc: Malaysian arrested over alleged Bangkok phone scam that cost woman 8 million baht Legacy A 36 year old Malaysian man has been arrested in Bangkok, accused of collecting cash for a phone scam gang whose members posed as officials and took about 8.25 million baht in cash and gold from a 75 year old woman in Bang Bon district. Police say the same man also collected 1.95 million baht from an 18 year old university student in Samut Prakan. Police announced the arrest of Muhammad Nor bin Abu Bakar at Bang Bon Police Station yesterday, November 20, and said officers detained him at a hotel in Lat Phrao district on a Thonburi Criminal Court warrant for jointly committing fraud by impersonating another person. The woman, whom police identified only by a pseudonym, told investigators that a caller contacted her on October 12 and asked whether she had ordered banned drugs, then told her to report to police in Mae Sot, Tak province. She withdrew 950,000 baht on October 14, 2 million baht on October 21 and 3 million baht on October 22, and on November 7 gave the gang a further 1 million baht along with gold weighing 20 baht, the Thai unit for gold, handing over each at her home. title: Daily Bangkok to London flights among 87 airlines’ Thai slot requests
desc: Daily Bangkok to London flights among 87 airlines’ Thai slot requests Legacy Eighty-seven passenger and cargo airlines have applied for Thai airport slots or schedule changes for summer 2027, according to the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT). The requests include a plan by Norse Atlantic UK to raise its Bangkok to London Gatwick service from four flights a week to daily. They are plans rather than confirmed schedules, because the CAAT still has to allocate slots according to each airport’s capacity. Air Chief Marshal Manat Chavanaprayoon, the CAAT’s director-general, said its representatives attended the 159th IATA Slot Conference in Budapest, Hungary, from November 17 to 19, acting as Thailand’s slot coordinator. U-Tapao, Samui , Chiang Mai, Phuket , Don Mueang and Suvarnabhumi were all on the agenda, with requests for more frequent flights, new international routes and services from carriers that do not yet fly to Thailand. In Bangkok, Air India Express wants to run two flights a week on a route from Visakhapatnam through Suvarnabhumi to Varanasi. title_cn: 87家航空公司申请泰国机场时段：北欧大西洋计划开通曼谷-伦敦日班
summary_cn: 泰国民航局收到87家客运和货运航空公司提交的2027年夏季航班时段调整申请。北欧大西洋航空公司（Norse Atlantic UK）计划将曼谷飞伦敦盖特威克（London Gatwick）航线从每周4班增加至每日班。印度航空快运、哈萨克航空等多家公司也提交了开辟新路线和增班的申请。涉及机场包括素万那普（Suvarnabhumi）、廊曼（Don Mueang）、清迈、普吉等。民航局作为泰国时段协调方，将根据各机场容量和运力条件最终确定时段分配。

They are plans rather than confirmed schedules, because the CAAT still has to allocate slots according to each airport’s capacity. Air Chief Marshal Manat Chavanaprayoon, the CAAT’s director-general, said its representatives attended the 159th IATA Slot Conference in Budapest, Hungary, from November 17 to 19, acting as Thailand’s slot coordinator. U-Tapao, Samui , Chiang Mai, Phuket , Don Mueang and Suvarnabhumi were all on the agenda, with requests for more frequent flights, new international routes and services from carriers that do not yet fly to Thailand. In Bangkok, Air India Express wants to run two flights a week on a route from Visakhapatnam through Suvarnabhumi to Varanasi. title: Chinese boss flees Thailand as police bust alleged Chiang Mai exchange front
desc: Chinese boss flees Thailand as police bust alleged Chiang Mai exchange front Legacy Cyber police have charged a Chinese woman and her Thai nominee over a Chiang Mai exchange shop that allegedly turned online scam money into cryptocurrency for a Chinese boss, who left Thailand before officers raided the shop and his home on November 10. The Cyber Crime Investigation Bureau announced the case yesterday, November 20, saying four victims of fake overseas share investment schemes lost 9,435,607.97 baht in total, sent through 24 mule bank accounts and withdrawn in cash for handover to a Chinese man known as Tiger. Brokers allegedly changed the cash into the USDT stablecoin for a 2% to 3% fee. Police identified Tiger as Wenjun Feng, a 42 year old Chinese national living in Doi Saket district, whose crypto wallet recorded turnover of more than 2,749,566 USDT, about 92 million baht. Nan Provincial Court issued an arrest warrant for Feng on September 25, but he had already left the country, so police asked immigration officers to put him on a watchlist and contacted foreign agencies. title: Two Indonesians held in alleged Ayutthaya crystal meth pickup
desc: Two Indonesians held in alleged Ayutthaya crystal meth pickup Legacy Police in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya have charged two Indonesian me n after allegedly catching them at the place under a U-turn bridge where two suitcases holding 38 kilogrammes of crystal meth had been left on Wednesday, November 18. Officers are now searching for a man known as Jimmy, who the pair said gave them their orders, and for whoever left the suitcases. The provincial governor and the provincial police chief announced the arrests yesterday, November 20, and put the value of the seized drugs at about 7.6 million baht. A worker cutting grass found the two suitcases under the bridge over the railway at Ban Ma, in Ban Ko subdistrict, and called local police at about 10.30am. Officers opened them and found 38 bags of crystal methamphetamine, each weighing 1 kilogramme and hidden inside pouches that looked like tea packaging. title: Bangkok’s Song Wat Road hosts Loy Krathong drones and river fireworks
desc: Bangkok’s Song Wat Road hosts Loy Krathong drones and river fireworks Legacy Bangkok’s historic Song Wat Road will hold a two-night Song Wat Loy Krathong celebration on November 23 and 24, with a light parade, digital krathong floating and a riverside show of 300 drones and more than 12,000 fireworks. The main show comes on the evening of November 24, the night of the festival itself. The Culture Ministry said on November 20 that Culture Minister Sabida Thaised will open the event, called River Meets Magic in English, at 8.30pm on November 24 at the AWC elephant courtyard in Samphanthawong district. The ministry’s Department of Cultural Promotion is organising it to pass the tradition on to younger Thais and to bring cultural tourism to the old riverside trading district. After a performance of Thai sepha recitation, contemporary dance and lighting, the opening will include a symbolic first krathong released on an immersive LED screen. title: SCB first to test tokenised deposits

title_cn: 泰日升级经济伙伴协定，携手LINE推动AI赋能中小企业
summary_cn: 泰国高层官员与日本财务部长举行会谈，推进日泰经济伙伴协定(JTEPA)升级和税收协议完善，支持前沿产业投资和碳信用市场发展。双方与LINE公司共同宣布三项计划，通过人工智能技术为中小企业赋能，增强网络防护能力，建立灾害预警系统，促进泰国中小企业数字化转型和信息安全建设。
desc_original: “เอกนิติ” หารือ รมว.คลังญี่ปุ่น ยกระดับ JTEPA–อนุสัญญาภาษี หนุนลงทุนอุตสาหกรรมอนาคต ตลาดคาร์บอนเครดิต จับมือ LINE ประกาศ 3 แผนใหญ่ ใช้ AI ติดอาวุธเอสเอ็มอี สกัดภัยออนไลน์ แจ้งเตือนภัยพิบัติ

title: Global imbalances weigh on 2027 outlook
desc: The Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI) has warned that three major global imbalances -- trade imbalances, the AI investment boom and rising cyber-attack risks -- could weigh on Thailand's economic outlook next year.
title_cn: 全球失衡压低2027年经济前景
summary_cn: 泰国发展研究院(TDRI)发布警告，指出国际贸易失衡、人工智能投资热潮和网络攻击风险上升等三大全球失衡因素，将对泰国2027年经济前景构成压力。该研究强调应对这些挑战需要政策调整和风险管理措施。
desc_original: The Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI) has warned that three major global imbalances -- trade imbalances, the AI investment boom and rising cyber-attack risks -- could weigh on Thailand's economic outlook next year.

title: ซีพี-เมจิ เร่งเครื่องโต ทุ่ม 4.8 พันล้านผุดโรงงานใหม่ ปูทางยอดขาย 3.5 หมื่นล้าน
desc: ซีพี-เมจิ ทุ่ม 4,800 ล้านบาท สร้างโรงงานแห่งที่ 3 ใน จ.สระบุรี เพิ่มกำลังผลิต 250,000 ตันต่อปี รับตลาดนมพรีเมียมและผลิตภัณฑ์โภชนาการโต ตั้งเป้ายอดขาย 20,000 ล้านบาทในปี 2573
title_cn: 正大-明治加速增长，投入48亿泰铢建新工厂
summary_cn: 正大-明治公司(CP-Meiji)宣布投资48亿泰铢在沙拉武里府(Saraburi)建设第三座现代化工厂，年增产能25万吨。新工厂将专注高端奶制品和营养食品生产，以满足市场不断增长的需求。公司制定2030年销售目标2万亿泰铢，推动业务快速扩张，巩固在泰国乳制品市场的领先地位。
desc_original: ซีพี-เมจิ ทุ่ม 4,800 ล้านบาท สร้างโรงงานแห่งที่ 3 ใน จ.สระบุรี เพิ่มกำลังผลิต 250,000 ตันต่อปี รับตลาดนมพรีเมียมและผลิตภัณฑ์โภชนาการโต ตั้งเป้ายอดขาย 20,000 ล้านบาทในปี 2573

title: Farm groups wary of US ethanol imports
desc: Thai sugar cane and cassava growers have called on the government to maintain non-tariff barriers on US ethanol imports and provide greater clarity on commitments under the proposed Agreement on Reciprocal Trade (ART), warning that market liberalisation could hurt domestic biofuel production and farm incomes.
title_cn: 泰国农业组织警惕美国乙醇进口冲击
summary_cn: 泰国甘蔗和木薯种植农户组织呼吁政府维持对美国乙醇进口的非关税壁垒，并就拟议的「互惠贸易协议」(ART)条款做出更明确承诺。农业界担忧完全的贸易自由化将冲击国内生物燃料生产产业，导致农民收入下降，呼吁政府在推进开放时保护本土农业。
desc_original: Thai sugar cane and cassava growers have called on the government to maintain non-tariff barriers on US ethanol imports and provide greater clarity on commitments under the proposed Agreement on Reciprocal Trade (ART), warning that market liberalisation could hurt domestic biofuel production and farm incomes.

title: 6 ค่ายรถยนต์ญี่ปุ่นโปรยยาหอมไทย ขานรับ “เอกนิติ” ประกาศลงทุนเพิ่ม 1.3 แสนล้านบาท
desc: 6 ค่ายรถยนต์ญี่ปุ่นประกาศลงทุนในไทยเพิ่ม 134,000 ล้านบาท หลัง “เอกนิติ” บินถกถึงโตเกียว กางโครงสร้างภาษีสรรพสามิตใหม่เก็บรถนำเข้า BEV-REEV 35% เริ่ม 1 ม.ค. 2570 หนุนผู้ลงทุนในประเทศ
title_cn: 6家日本汽车企业响应激励政策，宣布大幅增投13万亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国政府推出新的特别消费税政策，对进口电动汽车(BEV)和增程式电动汽车(REEV)征收35%的关税，自2027年1月1日起正式实施。该政策旨在扶持国内汽车投资者。6家日本汽车制造商随之宣布增加在泰国的投资13万4千亿泰铢，展示对泰国市场的长期承诺。这一举措将促进泰国汽车产业发展，创造更多就业机会。
desc_original: 6 ค่ายรถยนต์ญี่ปุ่นประกาศลงทุนในไทยเพิ่ม 134,000 ล้านบาท หลัง “เอกนิติ” บินถกถึงโตเกียว กางโครงสร้างภาษีสรรพสามิตใหม่เก็บรถนำเข้า BEV-REEV 35% เริ่ม 1 ม.ค. 2570 หนุนผู้ลงทุนในประเทศ

title: China to boost economic, security ties
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Chinese President Xi Jinping have agreed to deepen economic and security cooperation, government spokesman Ekkapob Pianpises says.
title_cn: 中国将深化与泰国经济安全合作
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷·查鲁瓦汗和中国国家主席习近平达成共识，同意深化经济和安全领域合作。泰国政府发言人埃卡波·皮安皮塞斯宣布了这一决定。两国在贸易、基础设施和区域稳定方面的战略合作有望进一步加强，这反映了中泰关系的重要战略地位。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Chinese President Xi Jinping have agreed to deepen economic and security cooperation, government spokesman Ekkapob Pianpises says.

title: Subsidy delays draw Democrat criticism
desc: The Democrat Party on Friday called on the government to explain delays in its solar subsidy scheme, saying none of the more than 70,000 registered households had received the promised 50,000-baht subsidy.
title_cn: 民主党批评政府太阳能补贴延迟
summary_cn: 民主党（Democrat Party）周五要求政府解释太阳能补贴计划的延迟原因。该补贴计划承诺向注册家庭提供5万泰铢，但超过7万户登记家庭至今尚未收到补贴。这一拖延引发了在野党的强烈不满和问责，涉及政府能源政策执行力问题。
desc_original: The Democrat Party on Friday called on the government to explain delays in its solar subsidy scheme, saying none of the more than 70,000 registered households had received the promised 50,000-baht subsidy.

title: Dems call on SEC to reconsider stablecoin rules
desc: Democrat Party deputy leader Korn Chatikavanij has urged the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to delay proposed stablecoin regulations, warning they could drive cryptocurrency transactions underground, weaken efforts to combat money laundering and damage the digital asset industry.
title_cn: 民主党促请证监会重新考虑稳定币规则
summary_cn: 民主党副主席科恩·查蒂卡瓦尼（Korn Chatikavanij）呼吁泰国证券交易委员会（Securities and Exchange Commission, SEC）推迟实施拟议的稳定币监管规则。科恩警告称，这些规则可能迫使加密货币交易转向地下，削弱反洗钱工作效能，并损害数字资产行业的发展前景。
desc_original: Democrat Party deputy leader Korn Chatikavanij has urged the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to delay proposed stablecoin regulations, warning they could drive cryptocurrency transactions underground, weaken efforts to combat money laundering and damage the digital asset industry.

title: Minister vows more budget transparency
desc: Prime Minister's Office Minister Paradorn Prissananantakul has pledged greater transparency and public participation in preparing the fiscal 2028 budget, with agencies facing tighter limits on funding requests.
title_cn: 政府官员承诺提高预算透明度
summary_cn: 总理办公室部长帕拉多恩·普里萨南南塔库尔（Paradorn Prissananantakul）承诺在编制2028财年预算时提高透明度并增进公众参与，同时对各机构的资金申请设立更严格的限额。这一举措旨在加强政府财政管理，提升公共部门的问责度和效率。
desc_original: Prime Minister's Office Minister Paradorn Prissananantakul has pledged greater transparency and public participation in preparing the fiscal 2028 budget, with agencies facing tighter limits on funding requests.

title: Locals help save leatherback turtle eggs
desc: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has instructed the Department of Marine and Coastal Resources to work with coastal communities to protect a leatherback turtle nest, the first of the new nesting season, in Phangnga.
title_cn: 攀牙当地社区携手保护棱皮龟卵
summary_cn: 自然资源与环境部长素查·乔姆林（Suchart Chomklin）指示海洋与沿海资源部与沿海社区合作，保护发现在攀牙府（Phangnga）的棱皮龟（leatherback turtle）巢穴。这是本季首个龟类筑巢点。该合作展示了泰国在海洋生物保护和社区参与方面的努力。
desc_original: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has instructed the Department of Marine and Coastal Resources to work with coastal communities to protect a leatherback turtle nest, the first of the new nesting season, in Phangnga.

title: Northern rivers face testing
desc: The Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives will collect soil and water samples from 250 high-risk sites in northern Thailand from Monday to Wednesday to assess contamination by arsenic and other heavy metals.
title_cn: 泰国北部河流启动毒性检测
summary_cn: 农业与合作部将在本周一至周三期间从泰国北部250个高风险地点采集土壤和水样本，对砷及其他重金属污染进行全面检测评估。此举旨在掌握北部地区的环保状况，为进一步的污染防治工作奠定科学基础。
desc_original: The Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives will collect soil and water samples from 250 high-risk sites in northern Thailand from Monday to Wednesday to assess contamination by arsenic and other heavy metals.

title: Swiss firms eye gains as Thai-EFTA trade pact nears
desc: Swiss businesses eye wider market access and new investment opportunities in Thailand as its free trade pact with the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) soon takes effect, Switzerland's ambassador said.
title_cn: 瑞士企业看好泰国-欧自贸协定机遇
summary_cn: 随着泰国与欧洲自由贸易协会（EFTA）自由贸易协定即将生效，瑞士企业对在泰国的市场拓展和投资机遇充满期待。瑞士驻泰大使表示，瑞士企业期待通过该协议获得更为广泛的市场准入。
desc_original: Swiss businesses eye wider market access and new investment opportunities in Thailand as its free trade pact with the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) soon takes effect, Switzerland's ambassador said.

title: Chiang Rai rice clears checking for toxicity
desc: Tests on Chiang Rai rice found no toxic substances above safety limits, Deputy Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Piyarat Tiyapairat said, as authorities stepped up checks on crops, water and soil amid concerns over pollution in northern river basins.
title_cn: 清莱水稻通过毒性检测
summary_cn: 农业与合作副部长皮亚腊表示，清莱生产的水稻经过检测未发现超出安全限值的有毒物质。当局在北部河流盆地污染问题引起广泛关注的背景下，加强了对农作物、水质和土壤的全面检查工作。
desc_original: Tests on Chiang Rai rice found no toxic substances above safety limits, Deputy Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Piyarat Tiyapairat said, as authorities stepped up checks on crops, water and soil amid concerns over pollution in northern river basins.

title: Ministry defends HIMARS plan
desc: The Defence Ministry has defended the planned acquisition of US-made High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems (HIMARS), saying the acquisition is part of the military's broader strategy to strengthen national defence capabilities and long-term operational readiness.
title_cn: 国防部为购置HIMARS火箭系统辩护
summary_cn: 泰国国防部为计划采购美制高机动火力火箭系统（HIMARS）进行了正式辩护。国防部表示，此举是泰军强化国防能力、确保长期作战准备和提升整体防卫水平的战略举措。
desc_original: The Defence Ministry has defended the planned acquisition of US-made High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems (HIMARS), saying the acquisition is part of the military's broader strategy to strengthen national defence capabilities and long-term operational readiness.

title: PM to chair urgent meeting on toxic northern rivers
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will chair an urgent meeting at Government House on Saturday on toxic contamination in northern rivers, as the government prepares to make the issue a national priority.
title_cn: 总理召开北部河流污染紧急会议
summary_cn: 泰国总理将于本周六在政府府邸主持一场紧急会议，重点讨论北部河流的有毒污染问题。政府正在筹备将该事项列为国家优先处理项目，以应对日益严峻的环保挑战。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will chair an urgent meeting at Government House on Saturday on toxic contamination in northern rivers, as the government prepares to make the issue a national priority.

title: Navy presses on with new frigate plan
desc: The Royal Thai Navy (RTN) is ready to proceed with its new frigate procurement project after the Comptroller General's Department ruled the original project should be cancelled, its chief said on Friday.
title_cn: 泰国皇家海军继续推进新护卫舰采购项目
summary_cn: 泰国皇家海军(RTN)宣布继续推进新型护卫舰采购项目。尽管审计总署之前裁定原项目应予取消，但海军高层表示坚持推进该计划，显示该国加快舰队现代化的决心。
desc_original: The Royal Thai Navy (RTN) is ready to proceed with its new frigate procurement project after the Comptroller General's Department ruled the original project should be cancelled, its chief said on Friday.

title: 5 districts hit by rebel attacks
desc: Suspected insurgents carried out coordinated attacks across five districts in Narathiwat early Friday, planting bombs, burning tyres and damaging CCTV cameras. No casualties were reported, authorities said.
title_cn: 那拉提瓦(Narathiwat)五区遭武装分子协同袭击
summary_cn: 那拉提瓦府五个区域周五凌晨遭疑似分离主义武装分子协同袭击。袭击者放置炸弹、焚烧轮胎并毁坏监控摄像头。当局未报告任何伤亡人员。
desc_original: Suspected insurgents carried out coordinated attacks across five districts in Narathiwat early Friday, planting bombs, burning tyres and damaging CCTV cameras. No casualties were reported, authorities said.

title: Khon Kaen police arrest five in alleged 15-million-baht mule account ring
desc: Khon Kaen police arrest five in alleged 15-million-baht mule account ring Legacy Police in Khon Kaen have arrested five Thais accused of withdrawing scam victims’ money from rented mule accounts at a shopping mall, for a network police say a Chinese boss ran from abroad. The two account holders said they were paid 5,000 baht a day, and the group allegedly handled about 15 million baht. Provincial Police Region 4, which covers the northeast, announced the arrests yesterday, November 20. The digital fraud teams of two banks had flagged account holders making suspicious cash withdrawals at a bank counter inside a Khon Kaen mall, and officers linked the same group to a withdrawal at another bank on November 14. Plain-clothes officers watched the group take out cash at the bank and detained all five, aged 29 to 36, in the mall’s second-floor car park as they prepared to drive away. Police seized 680,000 baht in cash, 480,000 baht withdrawn from one account and 200,000 baht from the other, and charged the five with membership of a secret society, with the case passed to Mueang Khon Kaen police. summary_cn: 泰国外交部长强调，罗兴亚穆斯林种族灭绝案系缅甸与国际法院之间的法律诉讼。泰国将恢复外交互动但不违背法院判决，同时呼吁停止暴力、开放人道主义救援通道。

title: AIHM Open Day gives students a first look at Bangkok’s hotel-based hospitality school
desc: AIHM Open Day gives students a first look at Bangkok’s hotel-based hospitality school Legacy High school students weighing up a career in hotels, guest experience or food and beverage can get a close look at a hospitality degree at the Asian Institute of Hospitality & Management (AIHM) Open Day on Saturday, November 28, before they decide where to apply. AIHM Open Day runs from 9.30am to 3pm on the ninth floor of Avani+ Riverside Bangkok Hotel, where the institute’s campus is based. Applications for the April 2027 intake are now open, and admissions staff will be on hand to help with the process, which makes the day as useful for parents as it is for students. What happens on the day The day gives visitors a feel for both the teaching and the people behind it, including: Hands-on workshops led by AIHM faculty Trial classes taught by industry experts A tour of the campus and the hotel spaces where students learn The chance to talk with lecturers and current students An overview of AIHM’s programmes and the international study and career routes open to students Admissions advice for anyone applying for the 2027 intakes Places are reserved through an online form on AIHM’s website

title: Taiwanese man held for scam operation after argument with Pattaya neighbour
desc: Taiwanese man held for scam operation after argument with Pattaya neighbour Legacy Police uncovered a transnational scam operation and arrested four foreign suspects in Pattaya on November 17 after the Taiwanese leading gang member had a dispute with his Thai neighbours . The investigation began after a Thai man filed a complaint against his foreign neighbour, identified as 33 year old Taiwanese national Jian. The complainant also submitted CCTV footage showing their confrontation to police. The footage showed Jian reversing his yellow sedan along an alley while avoiding another passing vehicle. His car nearly hit the complainant’s motorcycle, prompting the Thai man’s wife to approach and ask him to stop. Although no collision occurred, Jian got out of his vehicle and argued with the woman over her intervention. Her husband then stepped forward to protect her, and the confrontation escalated. Photo via Amarin TV The Thai man punched Jian in the face, prompting the Taiwanese man to retrieve an iron bar from his car. The Thai man subsequently returned to his house and came back with a machete. The woman managed to intervene before the confrontation escalated further. Poli

title: Chinese scam boss’s right-hand man arrested in Thailand
desc: Chinese scam boss’s right-hand man arrested in Thailand Legacy Thai police arrested a man accused of helping run a Cambodia-based call centre scam that used artificial intelligence to impersonate police officers , with reported losses reaching tens of millions of baht . The suspect, identified as 33 year old Supakorn, was arrested today, November 20, at a house in Khlong Sam subdistrict, Khlong Luang district, Pathum Thani. According to the Crime Suppression Division, Supakorn was a senior member of a scam network based in Poipet, Cambodia, and allegedly worked as the right-hand man of its Chinese boss. The gang reportedly contacted victims while pretending to be police officers, warning them that their phone numbers had been linked to serious criminal cases. Scammers then used AI to imitate police officers’ faces and voices during video calls. Photo via สื่อกลางเดลี่ Online Victims were told that their cases could be cleared if they transferred money into designated accounts to prove their innocence. The money was allegedly sent to mule accounts , which the gang changed daily to avoid having the funds frozen. The arrest followed an investigation by the Anti-Cyber Scam

title: Medicare overseas: what US expats in Thailand need instead
desc: Medicare overseas: what US expats in Thailand need instead Legacy Medicare Part B will cost US$209.40 a month from January 2027, about US$2,500 a year (roughly 82,000 baht), and it won’t pay a single baht of a hospital bill in Thailand. CMS confirmed the 2027 figure on November 17, 2026. Since Medicare doesn’t work overseas (more specifically, Thailand), US expats need to decide whether to keep paying for it and what should cover their bills in Thailand instead. This guide looks at what Medicare, Medigap and the VA will pay, what dropping Part B costs if you later change your mind, and how to set up coverage whichever way you go. What Medicare pays in Thailand Original Medicare generally doesn’t cover overseas care. There are a few narrow exceptions, involving border hospitals in Canada or Mexico and travel through Canada between Alaska and another state, but none of them would help someone living in Thailand. Photo via designer491/Getty Images Part D drug plans can’t pay for prescriptions bought abroad either, which matters in a country where private hospital pharmacies charge private prices. Some Medicare Advantage plans include emergency coverage overseas

The elephant, named Somkid, surprised online viewers with his playful behaviour and close interactions with the Thai mahout, Ton. African elephants have a reputation for being larger, less tractable and harder to keep than Asian ones, but it is different for Somkid. Ton shares videos of the animals through his TikTok account, สมคิดช้างแอฟริกาแสนซน , which translates to “Somkid, the playful African elephant”. The account has attracted nearly 195,000 followers. Photo via TikTok/ @somkid0821 Several videos featuring Somkid gained attention online. He can be seen lying down, sitting, dancing and playing with Ton in ways that remind Thai audiences of the interactions they often see between mahouts and Asian elephants. title: ‘Aren’t you ashamed?’ Aed Carabao confronts fighting fans at concert
desc: ‘Aren’t you ashamed?’ Aed Carabao confronts fighting fans at concert Legacy Thai rock legend Aed Carabao called out concertgoers for fighting during his band’s performance at the Surin Elephant Fair yesterday, November 19, asking whether they were ashamed of their behaviour . Aed Carabao, whose real name is Yuenyong Opakul, 72, is the lead singer, guitarist, songwriter and a founding member of the Thai rock band Carabao . The disturbance took place during the sixth day of the festival, which drew large crowds of young people, Thai tourists and foreign visitors to watch the band perform. title: 阿努廷与习近平在深圳会谈　聚焦跨境水污染治理与经贸合作
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国总理府发言人埃卡波介绍，2026年11月20日，泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷在第33届亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议结束后，在中国深圳与中国国家主席习近平举行双边会谈。双方讨论了跨境水污染治理、贸易与投资、铁路互联互通及打击网络诈骗等议题，并表示将深化泰中全面战略合作伙伴关系，延续中国国务院总理李强此前访泰期间的会谈成果。 阿努廷表示，跨境水污染已影响沿岸环境及民众生活，泰方关注赛河、郭河、洛克河及湄公河流域的水质。习近平表示，中方愿提供技术支持，与泰方合作加强水质检测、持续监测和污染治理。阿努廷提议将这一议题纳入12月在中国桂林举行的澜沧江—湄公河合作领导人会议议程。 经贸方面，双方讨论了数字技术、清洁能源、航天技术和电动汽车等领域的投资合作，并提出通过地理标志注册和线上平台拓展泰国产品在中国的销路，推动50万吨泰国大米贸易。双方还将推进中老泰铁路互联互通，并讨论向马来西亚和新加坡延伸。涉及廊开—万象第二座铁路桥及清孔—那堆—磨憨铁路线路等项目。 双方同意加强打击网络诈骗等跨国犯罪。泰方表示，愿与中方合作发布准确的旅游安全信息。会谈还涉及安全和普惠的人工智能应用、缅甸和平进程，以及依据国际法和平处理泰柬间问题。 阿努廷表示，泰国将继续推进加入《国家管辖范围以外区域海洋生物多样性协定》的国内程序，并愿考虑加入国际调解组织。泰方还请求中方支持将传统泰服列入联合国教科文组织非物质文化遗产名录。 编译：jinda；审校：wan 来源媒体：泰国总理府（据发言人通报） 原文链接（本站原刊）：https://www.thaiheadlines.com/195094/ The post 阿努廷与习近平在深圳会谈 聚焦跨境水污染治理与经贸合作 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 阿努廷与习近平深圳会谈 推进水污染治理与中泰经贸合作
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷在APEC会议后与中国国家主席习近平会谈。双方就跨境水污染治理达成共识，将在赛河、郭河、洛克河及湄公河流域加强水质监测与污染治理；在数字技术、清洁能源、电动汽车等领域推进投资合作；推动50万吨泰国大米贸易；同步推进中老泰铁路互联互通；加强打击网络诈骗等跨国犯罪合作。

title: 泰国总理参访比亚迪深圳总部 深化泰中新能源汽车产业合作
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 中国深圳，2026年11月19日，泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷·参威拉军率泰国政府代表团访问比亚迪股份有限公司深圳总部，比亚迪集团董事长兼总裁王传福热情接待。访问期间，泰国政府代表团参观比亚迪礼宾楼，深入了解比亚迪新能源汽车前沿技术、创新成果及全球业务发展情况。双方围绕比亚迪在泰国的持续投资、未来业务布局及绿色 产业生态建设等议题展开深入交流，共同探讨深化产业合作、推动泰国汽车产业转型升级的机遇。 泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷·参威拉军率泰国政府代表团到访比亚迪总部 比亚迪集团董事长兼总裁王传福对泰国政府长期以来给予比亚迪的支持表示感谢。他表示，比亚迪始终坚持技术创新，目前新能源汽车业务已覆盖全球120多个国家和地区，全球累计销量突破1,900万辆。泰国是比亚迪全球化布局的重要战略市场。未来，比亚迪将持续加大在泰投资力度，未来将在在泰国投产及引入更多车型，为当地消费者提供更丰富的产品选择。 王传福董事长（右）向阿努廷总理（左）介绍比亚迪车型 泰国总理阿努廷·参威拉军高度评价比亚迪在新能源汽车领域的技术创新与发展成果，对比亚迪的电池技术、闪充等前沿技术表示赞赏。他表示，泰国将持续推动新能源汽车产业发展，完善泰国新能源汽车充电设施，以应对城市空气污染及能源转型等挑战。同时，泰国政府欢迎比亚迪进一步扩大在泰投资，并期待比亚迪发挥产业带动作用，吸引更多上下游供应链企业赴泰投资建厂，完善本土新能源汽车产业生态，推动泰国汽车产业向电动化、绿色化方向转型发展。 阿努廷总理（左）向王传福董事长（左）展示其比亚迪座驾 自2022年正式进入泰国乘用车市场以来，比亚迪持续加大在泰投资力度，2023年启动罗勇生产基地建设，并于2024年7月正式投产，罗勇工厂为当地创造超过6,000个就业岗位，其中泰籍员工占比超95%。作为比亚迪首个海外乘用车生产基地，罗勇基地已形成涵盖冲压、焊装、涂装、总装及各类零部件全工艺全产业链生产制造体系，本地化率超过50%，设计年产能达15万辆。 目前，比亚迪泰国基地已量产五款车型，分别为BYD DOLPHIN、BYD ATTO 3、BYD SEAL 5 DM-i、BYD SEALION 5 DM-i及BYD SEALION 6 DM-i，产品不仅服务泰国本土市场，也出口至全球多个国家和地区。通过持续深化本地生产、供应链协同、人才培养及技术交流，比亚迪正不断融入泰国汽车产业生态，助力当地产业链上下游协同发展。 阿努廷总理和王传福董事长等双方代表合影 32年来，比亚迪始终坚持以技术创新驱动发展，持续推动新能源汽车产业变革。未来，比亚迪将继续深化全球化布局，加大在泰国的投资与业务拓展力度，推动新能源汽车及相关产业链协同发展，将更多绿色科技成果带到泰国，为泰国汽车产业升级、绿色经济转型及全球可持续发展贡献力量。 The post 泰国总理参访比亚迪深圳

title: Thaiwatsadu, BnB home bring back Canadian Christmas trees with over 1,000 festive items

title: 曼谷民主纪念碑今日有集会！周边道路实施交通管制
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，11月20日，泰国青年团体计划在曼谷民主纪念碑举行“Z世代集会”（#ม็อบเจนZ），要求保障教育权利及学生权益，提出废除征兵制度、推动新宪法、保护环境等多项诉求。泰国政府表示尊重民众和平集会及表达意见的权利，但呼吁青年依法、理性参与，避免受到他人煽动而引发暴力事件。警方已部署警力维护现场秩序，封闭民主纪念碑周边部分道路，提醒民众提前规划出行路线。 此次集会由“自由青年”（Nawachon Seri）团体发起，多个学生及青年组织参与。活动定于11月20日在民主纪念碑举行，主要诉求包括保障教育权利及学生权益，同时讨论废除征兵制度、公共预算分配、制定新宪法、教师及教育劳动者权益、环境与自然保护、反殖民主义以及反对垄断资本主义等议题。 针对青年团体集会，泰国总理府副发言人普洛伊塔莱表示，政府尊重民主制度下民众表达意见的权利与自由，也愿意听取社会各群体提出的建设性意见。政府呼吁参与集会的青年以和平方式表达政治诉求，保持理性与建设性，不得违反法律，也应避免受到别有用心人士煽动，导致现场出现暴力事件。 此前，泰国教育部长巴瑟已要求教育部所属各学校及机构，不得因学生和平参与集会而对其进行处罚、威胁、施压或剥夺任何权利，国家警察总署及曼谷市政府做好现场秩序维护和安全保障工作。 政府同时要求曼谷京畿警察署部署警力，密切维护现场秩序并提供安全保障，防止突发事件发生，确保参与集会的青少年及其他民众安全。警方提醒参加者不得携带武器、参与斗殴、伤害他人、破坏财物、擅自闯入场所，或妨碍执法人员执行公务，否则可能触犯《刑法》及2015年版《公共集会法》等相关法律。 在未成年人法律责任方面，政府指出，根据2003年版《儿童保护法》第26条第（3）项及第78条，任何人强迫、威胁、诱导、鼓励或纵容儿童实施不当行为，或使儿童面临违法风险，可被判处不超过3个月监禁、最高3万泰铢罚款，或两者并罚。政府呼吁家长密切关注子女的活动，避免未成年人被他人利用或卷入违法行为，并提醒青年考虑自身行为可能对未来造成的影响。政府强调，和平且不携带武器的集会属于宪法保障的权利与自由，但必须在法律框架内进行。 交通方面，负责民主纪念碑周边地区的Samran Rat警察局宣布，因集会活动，将封闭Ratchadamnoen 中路进城方向道路，从Khok Wua路口至民主纪念碑。警方建议民众提前安排出行，从Ratchadamnoen中路进城方向驶来的车辆，可右转进入Tanao路，再左转进入Bamrung Mueang路；从Ratchadamnoen中路出城方向行驶的车辆，可正常经由Somdet Phra Pinklao大桥通行；从Dinso 路驶来的车辆则只能左转。 此外，Chana Songkhram警察局也发布交通提示，Ratchadamnoen中路从Khok Wua路口至Phan F

title: 阿努廷与习近平双边会谈！深化两国战略合作，聚焦水污染治理与经贸投资
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，11月20日，泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷与中国国家主席习近平举行双边会谈，双方同意加强跨境水污染治理合作，重点关注赛河、郭河、洛克河及湄公河流域，强化水质检测与监测。此外，两国还将扩大贸易与投资合作，推动铁路互联互通，加强打击网络诈骗等跨国犯罪。 泰国总理府发言人埃卡波表示，泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷在第33届亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议结束后，与中国国家主席习近平举行全面双边会谈，旨在进一步巩固两国全面战略合作伙伴关系，延续中国国务院总理李强上周正式访问泰国期间取得的会谈成果。 在环境与水资源领域，阿努廷重点提出跨境水污染问题，指出相关污染已对环境和民众生活质量造成影响。习近平表示，中国不支持任何破坏环境的活动，愿与泰国合作解决河流中的有毒物质污染问题，并提供技术支持，加强水质检测、持续监测及系统性治理。 阿努廷还提议，将跨境水污染问题纳入今年12月在中国桂林举行的湄公河—澜沧江合作机制（MLC）领导人会议议程，推动相关国家共同讨论并寻求解决方案。 在经贸与投资方面，泰中双方同意从三个方向深化合作。第一，鼓励中国对泰国进行高质量投资，以“共同创造”的方式推动数字技术、清洁能源、航天技术及电动汽车等高端产业发展。第二，促进双边贸易平衡，通过地理标志注册及线上平台拓展泰国商品在中国市场的销售渠道，同时推动采购50万吨泰国大米。第三，双方将加快推进中国—老挝—泰国铁路网络建设，并进一步连接马来西亚和新加坡。相关项目包括廊开—万象第二座铁路桥以及清孔—那堆—磨憨铁路线路。 在安全领域，阿努廷与习近平同意切实加强打击跨国犯罪的合作，尤其是严厉打击网络诈骗团伙。泰国政府高度重视各国游客的人身安全，愿与中国合作传播准确可靠的信息，增强中国游客赴泰旅游的信心。 在地区及国际合作方面，阿努廷支持中国为促进地区和平与稳定发挥建设性作用，强调相关合作应以国际法和东盟中心地位为基础。双方还将加强安全、普惠型人工智能合作，协调支持缅甸实现和平。泰方同时重申，将坚持通过和平谈判及依据国际法的方式处理与柬埔寨之间的问题。 此外，阿努廷支持中国在生物多样性保护方面发挥作用，并表示泰国将继续推进加入《国家管辖范围以外区域海洋生物多样性协定》的国内程序。泰国也愿意考虑加入国际调解组织（IOMed），并请求中国支持泰国推动将“传统泰服”列入联合国教科文组织人类非物质文化遗产名录。 泰国总理府发言人表示，此次会谈体现了泰中两国紧密的双边关系，也反映出阿努廷推动双方合作取得实际成果的决心。双方将重点解决影响民众生活的跨境水污染问题，同时创造更多经济机遇、保障游客安全，共同促进地区和平与稳定，实现两国人民的共同利益。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：泰国总理府） The post 阿努廷与习近平双边会谈！深化两国战略合作，聚焦水污染治理与经贸投资 appe

title: Looser TV broadcasting rules urged
desc: A National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) study says the regulator should let digital TV broadcasting network providers cover only 80% of the population with their networks, which could significantly cut the monthly network rental fees paid to them by digital TV broadcasters and ease the latter's business costs.
title_cn: 呼吁放宽电视广播规定，降低运营成本
summary_cn: 泰国国家广播电信委员会（NBTC）研究建议放宽监管规定，允许数字电视广播网络运营商仅需覆盖全国人口的80%，无需实现全覆盖。此举可显著降低数字电视广播公司向网络运营商支付的月度租赁费用，缓解行业商业成本压力。
desc_original: A National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) study says the regulator should let digital TV broadcasting network providers cover only 80% of the population with their networks, which could significantly cut the monthly network rental fees paid to them by digital TV broadcasters and ease the latter's business costs.

title: Korakot eyes the top job at THAI
desc: With nearly four decades at Thai Airways International (THAI), the former commercial chief brings deep institutional knowledge and extensive international experience to the race for the airline's top job.
title_cn: 科拉科特（Korakot）竞逐泰国国际航空首席执行官职位
summary_cn: 泰国国际航空公司（THAI）前商业主管科拉科特参与公司最高职位的竞争。科拉科特在THAI工作近四十年，具有深厚的机构知识和丰富的国际商务经验，这为其竞争CEO职位奠定了坚实基础。
desc_original: With nearly four decades at Thai Airways International (THAI), the former commercial chief brings deep institutional knowledge and extensive international experience to the race for the airline's top job.

summary_cn: 泰国财政部与日本开发银行（JBIC）联合推动泰日经济合作升级，启动「Second Take-off」计划。双方计划吸引超过2万亿铢投资，重点聚焦数据中心和智能电网等战略性基础设施建设，以提升两国经济合作水平和区域竞争力。

title_cn: 铁路局设定11月28日期限 力求解决高铁3机场项目争议
summary_cn: 泰国铁路局（SRT）宣布以11月28日为期限，争取解决「高铁3机场」项目的遗留争议。若届时未获明确进展，铁路局将启动司法程序推进项目。该项目涉及连接曼谷三大机场的高速铁路网络，系泰国重要基建规划之一。

title: Neighbours up arsenic fight
desc: The government is stepping up cooperation with Myanmar to trace the source of arsenic contamination in the Kok and Sai rivers in Chiang Rai, while accelerating efforts to provide safe alternative water supplies to affected communities.
title_cn: 清莱（Chiang Rai）铁合格防砷污染 泰缅协力溯源供水
summary_cn: 泰国政府加强与缅甸跨境合作，联手追踪清莱克河（Kok River）和赛河（Sai River）砷污染源头。同时推进应急措施，加快为受污染地区供应安全饮用水，保障当地社区健康。砷污染问题威胁周边农业和生活用水。
desc_original: The government is stepping up cooperation with Myanmar to trace the source of arsenic contamination in the Kok and Sai rivers in Chiang Rai, while accelerating efforts to provide safe alternative water supplies to affected communities.

title: Anutin sets out three Apec priorities
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Thursday urged Apec leaders meeting in China to advance an Asia-Pacific free trade area, work together to fight online fraud and train workers in artificial intelligence and cloud computing.
title_cn: 阿努廷阐述亚太经合组织三大优先议题
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷在中国出席亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议时提出三大优先议题：推进亚太自由贸易区建设、携手打击网络诈骗、加强人工智能与云计算人才培养。这些议题反映泰国在区域经济一体化、数字安全和人才建设方面的战略关切，对泰国未来的国际竞争力和产业发展具有指导意义。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Thursday urged Apec leaders meeting in China to advance an Asia-Pacific free trade area, work together to fight online fraud and train workers in artificial intelligence and cloud computing.

title: PM chases closer ties at Apec
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has sought closer trade and investment ties with Russia and Hong Kong, with discussions covering energy security, tourism and links between major regional economic hubs.
title_cn: 总理寻求与俄罗斯、香港深化贸易投资关系
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷在亚太经合组织会议期间积极谋求与俄罗斯和香港的贸易投资深化，涵盖能源安全、旅游产业和区域经济枢纽联动等领域。这体现泰国在全球经济格局中的战略定位，特别是在能源供应稳定性和旅游经济发展方面的核心利益诉求。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has sought closer trade and investment ties with Russia and Hong Kong, with discussions covering energy security, tourism and links between major regional economic hubs.

title: Thrifty Thai tourists keen to travel more next year
desc: Despite economic concerns, Thai travellers are more likely than the global average to plan trips next year, but are looking to save on accommodation in order to spend more on other travel experiences, according to a survey by SiteMinder, a hotel distribution platform provider.
title_cn: 泰国游客明年旅游热情高涨，倾向节俭住宿换取体验消费
summary_cn: 酒店分销平台 SiteMinder 的调查显示，尽管全球经济存在不确定性，泰国游客明年旅游意愿高于全球平均水平。游客倾向于在住宿上节省开支，转而在餐饮、活动等其他旅游体验上投入更多预算。这反映泰国游客消费心理变化，对旅游业、酒店和相关服务商的经营策略具有重要参考价值。
desc_original: Despite economic concerns, Thai travellers are more likely than the global average to plan trips next year, but are looking to save on accommodation in order to spend more on other travel experiences, according to a survey by SiteMinder, a hotel distribution platform provider.

title: Farmers fret over US deal
desc: Mounting concerns over the Thailand-US trade deal have prompted farmers and opposition politicians to question its transparency and warn of potentially serious repercussions for domestic industries.
title_cn: 泰国农民和政界人士对美泰贸易协议表示担忧
summary_cn: 泰国农民和反对派政治人士对美泰贸易协议持续表达担忧，质疑谈判过程的透明度，并警告协议可能对国内农业、制造业等产业造成严重冲击。这反映农业部门对国际贸易政策的关切，涉及本土产业保护与经济开放之间的核心平衡问题，对泰国经济结构调整有深远影响。
desc_original: Mounting concerns over the Thailand-US trade deal have prompted farmers and opposition politicians to question its transparency and warn of potentially serious repercussions for domestic industries.

title: Feedback sought on national oil plan
desc: Thailand has opened a public consultation on its 2026 National Oil Plan, a strategy that seeks to reshape the country's energy landscape by accelerating the use of biofuels while strengthening energy security through larger emergency oil reserves.
title_cn: 泰国启动 2026 年国家能源计划公众咨询
summary_cn: 泰国启动 2026 年国家油气能源计划的公众咨询，战略重点包括加快生物燃料使用和扩大战略油气储备以强化能源安全。该计划旨在重塑泰国能源格局，应对国际油气市场波动风险，对能源价格、工业生产成本和宏观经济政策都有潜在深远影响。
desc_original: Thailand has opened a public consultation on its 2026 National Oil Plan, a strategy that seeks to reshape the country's energy landscape by accelerating the use of biofuels while strengthening energy security through larger emergency oil reserves.

title: Flying drone taxis set to hit Phuket next year
desc: Phuket's skies are set for a high-tech revolution as the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) begins drafting commercial licensing rules for autonomous flying taxis, clearing the way for tech provider Sky ICT to launch the nation's first electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) fleet and positioning the resort island as Southeast Asia's premier smart aviation hub.
title_cn: 普吉岛明年启动无人机出租车服务
summary_cn: 普吉岛即将迎来高科技变革。泰国民用航空局（CAAT）正起草自主飞行出租车的商业许可规则，为科技公司Sky ICT推出泰国首支电动垂直起降（eVTOL）车队扫清障碍，将普吉岛打造成东南亚智能航空枢纽。
desc_original: Phuket's skies are set for a high-tech revolution as the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) begins drafting commercial licensing rules for autonomous flying taxis, clearing the way for tech provider Sky ICT to launch the nation's first electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) fleet and positioning the resort island as Southeast Asia's premier smart aviation hub.

title: Solar subsidy registrations below target
desc: More than 70,000 households have registered for the government's solar subsidy scheme, well below its target of 1 million, with applications open until Jan 31, 2027.
title_cn: 太阳能补贴注册人数远低于目标
summary_cn: 泰国政府推出的太阳能补贴计划注册人数已超过7万户，与100万户的目标差距巨大。该计划旨在鼓励家庭安装太阳能系统以促进可再生能源发展，申请截止日期为2027年1月31日。
desc_original: More than 70,000 households have registered for the government's solar subsidy scheme, well below its target of 1 million, with applications open until Jan 31, 2027.

title: PP reform rejection fuels backlash
desc: The rejection of a major Social Security Fund overhaul proposed by the People's Party (PP) has reignited debate over the government's commitment to reform, with critics accusing ruling parties of abandoning election promises to improve transparency, accountability and professional fund management.
title_cn: 人民党改革遭拒引发政治争议
summary_cn: 人民党（PP）提议的社会保障基金重大改革遭国会否决，引发新一轮政治辩论。批评人士指控执政党背弃选举承诺，放弃改进基金透明度、增强问责制和实现专业化基金管理等改革目标。
desc_original: The rejection of a major Social Security Fund overhaul proposed by the People's Party (PP) has reignited debate over the government's commitment to reform, with critics accusing ruling parties of abandoning election promises to improve transparency, accountability and professional fund management.

title: Two Si Racha police officers dismissed over Chinese detainee’s escape
desc: Two senior officers attached to Si Racha police station have been ordered to leave the force after an investigation found evidence implicating them in the escape of a Chinese detainee awaiting deportation
title_cn: 中国被遣返人员越狱 西芭兰县（Si Racha）两警官遭撤职
summary_cn: 泰国西芭兰县警察局查明，该局两名资深警官与一名等待遣返的中国被羁押人员逃脱事件有牵连，经调查已被下令离职。此案涉及执法部门的监管失职和可能的渎职行为，引发对警方纪律的关注。
desc_original: Two senior officers attached to Si Racha police station have been ordered to leave the force after an investigation found evidence implicating them in the escape of a Chinese detainee awaiting deportation

desc: เปิดมุมมองที่นักลงทุนต้องรู้ ก่อนซื้อ AWR ชูจุดเด่น Freehold 100% รวม 5 สินทรัพย์พรีเมียม ทั้งออฟฟิศและโรงแรมระดับโลก พร้อมโอกาสเติบโตและคาดปันผล 5.44-6.51%
title_cn: AWR基金IPO投资前必知 历史性融资规模超400亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国地产基金AWR推出IPO融资项目，融资规模创历史新高，超过400亿泰铢。该基金主要投资100%永久产权的五项高端资产组合，包括国际水准的办公楼和酒店物业，投资者可获得5.44%-6.51%的预期分红收益，并享受物业升值的潜在增长空间。

desc: Thairath Money พูดคุยกับ Beth Ann Lim, Director, Public Policy Strategy จาก Meta เปิดเบื้องหลังปราบสแกมร่วมกับตำรวจไทย พร้อมแจงปมรายได้ Scam Ads และขีดจำกัด Big Tech
title_cn: Meta反诈骗启示：删除数百万账户未触根源 敦促政府共享数据
summary_cn: Meta与泰国警方合作打击诈骗活动，已删除数百万个账户。Meta公共政策战略主管Beth Ann Lim在采访中揭露反诈工作幕后故事，指出当前措施未能触及问题根源。她敦促泰国政府解除法律限制，并主张建立数据共享机制以增强反诈效力。此外，Meta还面临涉及诈骗广告收入和大科技公司监管边界的复杂议题。

title: It’s a girl: Zoo reveals sex of newest pygmy hippo
desc: Khao Kheow Open Zoo has revealed that its newest pygmy hippopotamus is female, ending weeks of speculation among fans who eagerly followed the arrival of the latest member of the zoo’s famous hippo family.
title_cn: 确认新生：考艾开放动物园(Khao Kheow)公布最新侏儒河马为母体
summary_cn: 考艾开放动物园宣布其最新侏儒河马为母体，结束了众多粉丝长达数周的性别猜测。这只新生河马是该园著名河马家族的最新成员，代表着泰国野生动物保护事业的进展。园方公布引发广泛关注，众多游客和动物保护爱好者翘首以盼欣赏这位新家族成员。
desc_original: Khao Kheow Open Zoo has revealed that its newest pygmy hippopotamus is female, ending weeks of speculation among fans who eagerly followed the arrival of the latest member of the zoo’s famous hippo family.

title: เบื้องหลังเซ็นทรัล กับกติกาธุรกิจครอบครัวที่ส่งต่อข้ามรุ่น เลือกผู้นำทุก 4 ปี และเสียงสนับสนุน 66%
desc: “100 คนในตระกูล แต่ไม่มีใครขายหุ้นแม้แต่หุ้นเดียว” เบื้องหลังเซ็นทรัล กับกติกาธุรกิจครอบครัวที่ส่งต่อข้ามรุ่น เลือกผู้นำทุก 4 ปี และเสียงสนับสนุน 66% หลักเปิดทางมืออาชีพขับเคลื่อนธุรกิจ
title_cn: 中央百货(Central)背后的家族企业传承：每4年选举领导 获66%支持
summary_cn: 中央百货集团揭示其独特的家族企业治理模式：100名家族成员坚守不出售任何股份的原则，确保家族对企业的永久控制权。企业每4年进行一次领导层选举，新领导者需获得66%成员支持。这一制度既保持家族核心价值观，又通过引入专业管理人员推动现代化经营，实现了传统与进步的平衡。
desc_original: “100 คนในตระกูล แต่ไม่มีใครขายหุ้นแม้แต่หุ้นเดียว” เบื้องหลังเซ็นทรัล กับกติกาธุรกิจครอบครัวที่ส่งต่อข้ามรุ่น เลือกผู้นำทุก 4 ปี และเสียงสนับสนุน 66% หลักเปิดทางมืออาชีพขับเคลื่อนธุรกิจ

title: Chiang Mai bar owner arrested after overcharging complaints by foreign tourists
desc: Chiang Mai bar owner arrested after overcharging complaints by foreign tourists Legacy Tourist Police arrested a bar owner in central Chiang Mai today, November 19, for overcharging foreign customers and operating without a licence. Officers raided RED BAR on Si Don Chai Road at around 2.30am after receiving complaints that customers were charged excessive amounts and prevented from leaving until they paid. Police said they received complaints from foreign tourists and tour guides about the bar in Chang Khlan subdistrict. Complainants alleged that guards and staff blocked customers from leaving and pressured them to settle bills they considered unusually high. Photo via KhaoSod Officers identified the venue as RED BAR and its owner as 34 year old Aphiwat Phithakkiattikun. They arrested him during the raid and took him to Mueang Chiang Mai Police Station for further legal proceedings. According to police, the bar had previously been caught engaging in similar conduct and was ordered to close. title: 小米18 Pro系列登陆泰国！AI背屏与2亿像素徕卡影像成亮点
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月18日，小米正式在泰国发布新一代高端旗舰手机Xiaomi 18 Pro系列，包括Xiaomi 18 Pro和Xiaomi 18 Pro Max两款机型。此次新品的一大亮点是首次将AI功能与机身背屏深度结合，在传统手机屏幕之外增加一块智能交互屏幕，并搭载2亿像素徕卡双摄系统、新一代骁龙8至尊版移动平台及小米最新影像技术，进一步拓展旗舰手机在摄影、视频创作和AI应用方面的使用场景。 从泰国市场公布的信息来看，Xiaomi 18 Pro售价44,999泰铢起，Xiaomi 18 Pro Max售价52,999泰铢起，两款机型均于11月18日至27日开放预订。 AI背屏成为最大亮点 手机交互方式进一步升级 与传统旗舰手机相比，Xiaomi 18 Pro系列最引人关注的创新，是对机身背屏功能的进一步升级。这块背屏并非简单的信息显示窗口，而是融合了拍摄、AI交互、日常信息查看及个性化设置等多种功能。用户可以直接通过背屏查看来电、地图导航、网约车状态及外卖配送信息，也可以将登机牌、二维码、重要文字或图片固定在背屏上，方便随时调用。 在影像应用方面，背屏能够充当后置摄像头的实时取景器，让用户使用画质更出色的后置摄像头进行自拍、多人合影及Vlog拍摄。多人自拍时，当系统检测到画面中超过3人，还会自动切换至超广角镜头。此外，手机支持最高8K 30fps视频录制，并可通过背屏实时预览拍摄画面，为视频创作者提供更多便利。AI功能也是此次背屏升级的重要组成部分。其中，AI Interpreter支持最多29种语言的面对面实时翻译，双方可以分别通过手机正面和背面的屏幕查看对应语言内容，降低跨语言交流的障碍。此外，GenAI Apps功能允许用户通过自然语言描述需求，创建个性化迷你应用，手机还内置超过50款预设应用，涵盖实用工具及小游戏等场景。AI Group Photo Wallpapers则可以将用户的人像与宠物、名人或喜爱的角色组合，生成个性化背屏壁纸。 背屏采用与主屏相同的M11定制面板，支持1至120Hz LTPO自适应刷新率，峰值亮度最高可达4,000 nits，并使用康宁大猩猩玻璃Victus 2提升耐用性。 2亿像素徕卡双摄 强化旅行与夜间摄影能力 影像系统是Xiaomi 18 Pro系列的另一项核心升级。为庆祝小米与徕卡合作五周年，新系列继续采用双方联合开发的移动影像技术，搭载2亿像素徕卡双摄系统，包括1/1.28英寸主摄传感器和1/1.56英寸潜望式长焦传感器，主摄与长焦均达到2亿像素规格。 其中，主摄采用徕卡UltraPure光学设计及Summilux f/1.67镜头，强调在不同光线环境下的进光能力与画面细节表现。Xiaomi 18 Pro Max还搭载Light Fusion 960L影像传感器，逆光场景动态范围最高达到16.2EV。潜望

title: Thai influencer files complaint against actor after altercation at Udon Thani restaurant
desc: Thai influencer files complaint against actor after altercation at Udon Thani restaurant Legacy A Thai social media influencer and volunteer rescuer filed a police complaint against actor Rapeephat “Nam” Ekpankul after the pair were involved in a physical altercation at a restaurant in Udon Thani , allegedly over a YouTube Premium subscription. The 29 year old influencer, Sukon Krueswn, better known as Song Doo Hee, shared footage of the incident on Facebook on November 19. He alleged that Nam attacked him while they were sitting together with friends at the restaurant, without any provocation from him. Sukon said he eventually fled the restaurant because he feared for his safety. He added that the situation could have been more serious if Nam had been carrying a weapon. The footage showed the two men sitting next to each other and arguing before Nam slapped Sukon twice. Other people at the table tried to intervene, but the argument continued. title: Thai police urged to get in shape in new fitness campaign
desc: Thai police urged to get in shape in new fitness campaign Legacy Thai police officers are being urged to get back into shape as the Royal Thai Police launched a new campaign yesterday, November 18, to tackle obesity , improve fitness and encourage healthier eating habits . The campaign, called Thai Police Without Bellies, was launched at Royal Thai Police headquarters in Bangkok by the Police General Hospital. The 2027 programme aims to help officers improve their fitness and prevent chronic conditions such as diabetes, high blood pressure and heart disease. Photo via Inside Thailand Police General Hospital representatives said excess weight and abdominal obesity could affect officers’ health and their ability to perform their duties. The campaign encourages lasting changes to diet and exercise rather than short-term weight loss. Five current and former Thai national athletes joined the launch to share fitness advice and personal experiences. They included athletes from pole vault, sprint relay and 400-metre running events, as well as an athletics coach. title: Thailand opens door to Latin America with Peru free trade deal
desc: Thailand opens door to Latin America with Peru free trade deal Legacy Thailand and Peru have signed a comprehensive Free Trade Agreement (FTA) after negotiations stalled for more than a decade , opening the way for greater trade in goods and services between the two countries. The agreement was signed today, November 19, during the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting in China, with Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Peruvian President Keiko Sofia Fujimori Higuchi witnessing the ceremony. Deputy Prime Minister and Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun said the deal would help Thai businesses expand into Latin America as Thailand looks for new export markets amid growing competition in global trade . Photo via Facebook: ไทยคู่ฟ้า Negotiations had been on hold since 2014 before resuming in 2025. The agreement now covers opportunities in both goods and services, as well as closer business and investment ties. However, the agreement is not yet in force. The Commerce Ministry must first submit it to Parliament for approval and complete the remaining procedures, with businesses expected to begin benefiting from the deal in 2027.
