title: 普吉芭东突发大火致11人死亡！总理阿努廷海外致电指示全力救援
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，11月16日凌晨，普吉芭东发生严重火灾，造成多人伤亡。正在菲律宾马尼拉出席东盟峰会的泰国总理阿努廷第一时间致电普吉府府尹了解事故最新情况，要求当地各部门全力救助伤者，同时尽快查明起火原因，依法严肃处理相关问题。 11月16日，泰国总理阿努廷在菲律宾首都马尼拉出席东盟峰会，得知普吉芭东发生重大火灾后，阿努廷第一时间致电普吉府府尹，了解事故最新情况并对事故中受伤人员及受影响居民表达关切。 阿努廷要求府尹协调当地各相关部门，包括行政部门、警方、消防部门、公共卫生部门及救援机构，全力救助伤者、楼内住户以及可能仍被困在建筑内的人员，同时做好周边区域的安全保障工作，防止事故造成进一步影响。 与此同时，阿努廷要求有关部门加快调查火灾原因，迅速果断地处理相关问题。如果调查发现管理疏漏或存在安全隐患，必须彻底查明，并依法追究相关责任。 据悉，火灾于当天凌晨约3时17分发生，起火地点为普吉芭东一家摩托车租赁店，随后火势蔓延至附近商业楼，共有4间商铺受到影响。消防人员经过约2小时的扑救，最终控制住火势。 目前，相关部门正继续跟进事故后续工作，包括调查起火原因、核查建筑受损情况，并为伤者及受灾人员提供必要协助。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：mgonline） The post 普吉芭东突发大火致11人死亡！总理阿努廷海外致电指示全力救援 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 普吉芭东火灾致11人死亡，总理阿努廷海外下令全力救援
summary_cn: 11月16日凌晨约3时17分，普吉（Phuket）芭东（Patong）一家摩托车租赁店发生火灾，随后蔓延至邻近商业楼宇，共4间商铺受影响，造成11人死亡。消防部门经约2小时扑救控制火势。正在菲律宾出席东盟峰会的泰国总理阿努廷第一时间致电普吉府府尹，要求全力救助伤者和被困人员，做好安全保障，并责成有关部门加快查明火灾原因，对管理疏漏者依法追究责任。

title: DEFA文件正式移交东盟秘书长！泰国企业能否真正降低跨境交易成本？
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月15日，在第49届东盟峰会期间，东盟领导人共同见证了《东盟数字经济框架协议》（ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement，简称DEFA）文件移交东盟秘书长。这标志着东盟数字经济一体化进程取得重要进展。值得注意的是，协议实际签署仪式于11月14日在菲律宾马尼拉举行，15日进行的是文件移交环节。 泰国副总理兼商业部长素帕琪表示，泰国在本次协议谈判中发挥了重要作用，作为DEFA谈判委员会主席国，泰国与东盟各成员国密切协调，推动自2023年启动的谈判于2026年取得成果。接下来，泰国将加快国内批准程序，并与其他成员国协调，争取推动协议于2027年年中正式生效。 素帕琪指出，DEFA旨在解决东盟各国数字法规、技术标准和数字系统存在差异的问题，通过建立共同规则和标准，推动成员国数字系统互联互通，减少跨境商业活动中的重复手续和交易成本。 从具体内容来看，协议涉及无纸化贸易、电子支付、数字身份验证等多个领域。通过推动相关系统衔接，企业未来有望减少纸质文件提交、重复身份核验及跨境支付中的操作环节，让数字交易更加便捷。此外，协议还涵盖人工智能（AI）、数据创新、海底电缆合作以及数字产品非歧视原则等新兴议题，并通过监管沙盒机制，为科技初创企业和中小企业提供测试创新产品与服务的空间。 对于泰国而言，DEFA的潜在受益范围并不局限于科技行业。数字内容、游戏、软件、旅游、农业、金融及物流等领域，都可能从区域数字规则的协调中获得新的发展机会。尤其是中小微企业（MSMEs），如果能够以更低的成本进入其他东盟国家市场，将有机会扩大客户来源，提升区域竞争力。 不过，协议能否真正转化为企业经营层面的便利，仍取决于后续实施情况。 对于一家希望将游戏、软件、旅游服务或农产品销售到东盟其他国家的泰国企业而言，跨境交易不仅涉及产品和服务本身，还包括订单确认、身份核验、支付结算、电子单据认可及售后服务等多个环节。即使电子支付实现互通，如果物流单据仍需重复录入，或者不同国家对电子文件的认可标准不一致，企业依然需要承担额外的时间和运营成本。 与此同时，跨境数字交易规模扩大，也意味着消费者保护、个人数据安全、网络诈骗防范及交易纠纷处理等问题更加重要。如果退款机制、数据使用规范和责任认定不够清晰，即使交易流程更加便捷，也未必能够充分建立消费者信任。 另一个值得关注的问题是中小企业的实际参与能力。大型企业通常拥有专业的数字化团队和成熟的跨境业务系统，而许多小型商家仍面临语言服务、产品数字化、网络安全及跨境运营经验不足等现实困难。因此，协议实施后的配套培训和企业服务，不能仅停留在政策介绍层面，还需要帮助商家了解如何完成跨境签约、收款、单据处理及售后服务，让企业真正具备进入区域市场的能力。 在经济增长预期方面，素帕琪援引波士顿咨询公司（BCG）的研究指出，
title_cn: 东盟数字经济框架协议（DEFA）正式启动，推动区域跨境交易便利化
summary_cn: 11月15日，东盟领导人共同见证《东盟数字经济框架协议》（DEFA）文件移交东盟秘书长。泰国作为谈判委员会主席国，推动协议从2023年启动至2026年完成，预计2027年年中生效。DEFA通过无纸化贸易、电子支付、数字身份验证等手段，解决东盟各国数字法规差异，推动区域数字系统互联互通，降低企业跨境交易成本。协议还涵盖人工智能、数据创新等新兴领域，为中小企业提供监管沙盒测试创新产品。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月15日，在第49届东盟峰会期间，东盟领导人共同见证了《东盟数字经济框架协议》（ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement，简称DEFA）文件移交东盟秘书长。这标志着东盟数字经济一体化进程取得重要进展。值得注意的是，协议实际签署仪式于11月14日在菲律宾马尼拉举行，15日进行的是文件移交环节。 泰国副总理兼商业部长素帕琪表示，泰国在本次协议谈判中发挥了重要作用，作为DEFA谈判委员会主席国，泰国与东盟各成员国密切协调，推动自2023年启动的谈判于2026年取得成果。接下来，泰国将加快国内批准程序，并与其他成员国协调，争取推动协议于2027年年中正式生效。 素帕琪指出，DEFA旨在解决东盟各国数字法规、技术标准和数字系统存在差异的问题，通过建立共同规则和标准，推动成员国数字系统互联互通，减少跨境商业活动中的重复手续和交易成本。 从具体内容来看，协议涉及无纸化贸易、电子支付、数字身份验证等多个领域。通过推动相关系统衔接，企业未来有望减少纸质文件提交、重复身份核验及跨境支付中的操作环节，让数字交易更加便捷。此外，协议还涵盖人工智能（AI）、数据创新、海底电缆合作以及数字产品非歧视原则等新兴议题，并通过监管沙盒机制，为科技初创企业和中小企业提供测试创新产品与服务的空间。 对于泰国而言，DEFA的潜在受益范围并不局限于科技行业。数字内容、游戏、软件、旅游、农业、金融及物流等领域，都可能从区域数字规则的协调中获得新的发展机会。尤其是中小微企业（MSMEs），如果能够以更低的成本进入其他东盟国家市场，将有机会扩大客户来源，提升区域竞争力。 不过，协议能否真正转化为企业经营层面的便利，仍取决于后续实施情况。 对于一家希望将游戏、软件、旅游服务或农产品销售到东盟其他国家的泰国企业而言，跨境交易不仅涉及产品和服务本身，还包括订单确认、身份核验、支付结算、电子单据认可及售后服务等多个环节。即使电子支付实现互通，如果物流单据仍需重复录入，或者不同国家对电子文件的认可标准不一致，企业依然需要承担额外的时间和运营成本。 与此同时，跨境数字交易规模扩大，也意味着消费者保护、个人数据安全、网络诈骗防范及交易纠纷处理等问题更加重要。如果退款机制、数据使用规范和责任认定不够清晰，即使交易流程更加便捷，也未必能够充分建立消费者信任。 另一个值得关注的问题是中小企业的实际参与能力。大型企业通常拥有专业的数字化团队和成熟的跨境业务系统，而许多小型商家仍面临语言服务、产品数字化、网络安全及跨境运营经验不足等现实困难。因此，协议实施后的配套培训和企业服务，不能仅停留在政策介绍层面，还需要帮助商家了解如何完成跨境签约、收款、单据处理及售后服务，让企业真正具备进入区域市场的能力。 在经济增长预期方面，素帕琪援引波士顿咨询公司（BCG）的研究指出，

title: Suvarnabhumi cargo backlog drags on despite 115 extra staff
desc: Suvarnabhumi cargo backlog drags on despite 115 extra staff Legacy The Thai government has set out five measures to clear the cargo backlog at Suvarnabhumi International Airport, including 115 extra warehouse staff, 30 more forklifts, explosives-detection dogs and more storage space at Bangkok’s main airport. A new working group of state and private-sector representatives will report progress to the transport minister every 15 days. Deputy Government Spokesperson Ploythalay Laksamisaengchan announced the plan today, November 16, after the agencies involved met on the orders of Deputy Prime Minister and Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn. She said the delays were hurting both Thai exports and imports. The meeting found three causes, she explained: X-ray scans cannot clearly check dense export cargo, so staff must open it or use sniffer dogs; import storage is so crowded that workers cannot locate shipments ; and staff and machines are shared between inbound and outbound goods. title: Thailand needs 26,000 more EV chargers as holiday queues build, says operator
desc: Thailand needs 26,000 more EV chargers as holiday queues build, says operator Legacy Thailand needs about 26,000 more public EV chargers to keep up with soaring electric car numbers , charging operator SHARGE estimated last week, naming motorway rest stops and holiday routes as the worst bottlenecks . The company put the national ratio at about 30 cars per public charger, against a global average of about 11. Peerapat Sirichantaropas, chief executive of Sharge Management Co Ltd, said Thailand had more than 5,000 public charging stations with about 15,000 chargers between them, for a cumulative fleet of more than 456,000 battery-electric vehicles (BEVs) registered by the end of September. DC fast chargers were the weakest link, at about 47 cars for each one, and in many areas there were not enough of them for everyday use. The company estimates that the country needs 2.7 times as many public chargers as it has now, about 41,000 in total, to keep pace with growth. Its figures show 169,638 BEV registrations in the first nine months of 2026, up 93% on the same period last year, after 122,384 for the whole of 2025, a rise of 72.12% on 2024. title: WORPT app lets tourists spend crypto in Thailand via PromptPay, Visa Prepaid Card
desc: WORPT app lets tourists spend crypto in Thailand via PromptPay, Visa Prepaid Card Legacy International tourists can now spend crypto in Thailand through WORPT, a new app that converts cryptocurrency into Thai baht for everyday payments via Thai QR PromptPay . WORPT has officially launched under the Tourist DigiPay Regulatory Sandbox. The app aims to grow its user base among international tourists, with a projected 150,000 active users. WORPT projects that about 15 billion baht in digital asset purchasing power will be converted into baht and channelled into Thailand’s tourism sector and wider economy over 18 months. The team also expects the app to create opportunities to distribute about 1.95 billion baht in income to local businesses and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) over the 18-month participation period. How the Tourist DigiPay sandbox works The Tourist DigiPay Regulatory Sandbox is overseen by Thailand’s Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). It lets digital asset business operators test cryptocurrency-to-baht conversion services over an 18-month period. International tourists can then use the converted funds to pay for goods and services in Thailand through lic
title_cn: WORPT应用让游客在泰国通过PromptPay支付加密货币
summary_cn: WORPT应用已在泰国「观光客数字支付监管沙盒」正式启动，允许国际游客将加密资产兑换成泰铢，并通过PromptPay二维码进行日常消费。该应用由泰国证券交易委员会（SEC）监管，试点期18个月。预计吸引15万活跃用户，将150亿泰铢加密资产注入泰国旅游和经济，向本地中小企业分配约19.5亿泰铢收入，促进数字资产与传统经济融合。

title: Patong motorbike rental fire kills 11 as smoke traps residents upstairs
desc: Patong motorbike rental fire kills 11 as smoke traps residents upstairs Legacy A fire started at a motorbike rental shop in Patong , killing 11 people in Phuket earlier today, November 16, after thick smoke filled the rented rooms above and the blaze spread to neighbouring shophouses . Police and forensic officers are examining a possible short circuit at an electricity pole outside the building, and the cause has not been confirmed. The alarm was raised at about 3.15am local time on Phang Muang Sai Kor Road in Patong subdistrict, Kathu district, and Patong Municipality firefighters said they reached the scene within about five minutes despite heavy rain. Six fire engines brought the blaze under control after about an hour, while rescue volunteers from the Kusoldharm Phuket Foundation helped bring people out of the building. Firefighters at the scene | Photo via MGR Online Patong Deputy Mayor Sanakorn Keesin said one body was found on the third floor and 10 on the fifth floor, where residents had tried to climb away from the flames but were overcome by the smoke. title: 普吉芭东突发大火！6层商业楼起火，11人死亡
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，11月16日凌晨，普吉芭东镇发生严重火灾，一栋6层商业楼陷入火海，火势迅速蔓延至两侧相邻建筑，共有3栋建筑受到影响。截至目前，事故已确认造成11人死亡。 当地时间11月16日凌晨3时15分左右，消防部门接到报警，称芭东镇一栋6层商业楼发生火灾。该建筑底层经营摩托车租赁业务，起火后，建筑正面及内部迅速陷入火海，随后火势蔓延至两侧相邻的商业楼。 芭东镇副镇长表示，事故发生时当地正下雨。初步推测，火灾可能由电线杆电路短路引发，电线产生火花后，火星落入附近的摩托车停放区域，进而引燃车辆，导致火势迅速扩大。 由于建筑一楼停放着100多辆摩托车，现场还有汽油、轮胎及塑料零部件等易燃物，火势因此迅速蔓延并产生大量浓烟，烟雾扩散至整栋建筑。 该建筑上层用作住宿。火灾发生后，楼内人员试图向更高楼层撤离，以躲避火势和浓烟，但部分人员未能逃脱。救援人员随后在3楼发现1名遇难者，在5楼发现另外10名遇难者，目前确认死亡人数为11人。与此同时，救援人员也全力营救其他受困人员，获救者大多平安。 芭东镇副镇长表示，市政府在凌晨约3时接到报警后，救援人员约5分钟内抵达现场，并调派6辆消防车展开灭火行动。然而，由于现场停放大量摩托车，车辆内的燃油、轮胎等物品助长火势，灭火工作十分困难，现场浓烟密布，消防人员耗时约1小时才控制住火势。 目前，芭东镇政府工作人员及普吉善德堂基金会救援人员仍在现场展开全面排查，确认是否还有其他伤亡人员。相关部门也将进一步调查火灾造成的损失及具体起火原因。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：mgronline） The post 普吉芭东突发大火！6层商业楼起火，11人死亡 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: สรรพสามิต เร่งคลอดเกณฑ์ MIT ดันรถ EV ใช้ชิ้นส่วนไทย เริ่มต้น 40%
desc: สรรพสามิต เร่งวางเกณฑ์ MIT กำหนดสัดส่วนชิ้นส่วนรถยนต์ผลิตในประเทศ เบื้องต้นเริ่มที่ 40% หวังหนุนอุตสาหกรรมชิ้นส่วนไทย ควบคู่ปรับขึ้นภาษีรถ EV นำเข้าเป็น 35% จูงใจตั้งฐานผลิตในประเทศ
title_cn: 泰国推进 MIT 标准力推电动车本地化 零部件比例初定 40%
summary_cn: 泰国政府出台产业扶持政策。海关部门正式推出 MIT（泰国制造）标准，要求电动汽车本地零部件比例初定为 40%，同步上调进口电动车关税至 35%。这一组合举措旨在保护和发展泰国本地零部件产业，吸引制造商在泰国建立生产基地，推动电动车产业链本土化。

title: Renewables set to post strong Q4 growth
desc: Thailand's renewable energy sector is expected to post strong growth in the fourth quarter, driven by government measures to promote E20 gasohol and B20 biodiesel, as well as increased fuel consumption during the year-end travel season, according to Global Green Chemical (GGC), the country's largest producer of ethanol and methyl ester by production capacity.
title_cn: 泰国可再生能源望迎第四季度强劲增长
summary_cn: 泰国可再生能源产业有望在第四季度实现强劲增长。Global Green Chemical（泰国最大的乙醇和甲酯生产商）指出，这一增长得益于政府推广 E20 乙醇汽油和 B20 生物柴油的政策支持，以及年末出行季节带动的燃料消费量增加。
desc_original: Thailand's renewable energy sector is expected to post strong growth in the fourth quarter, driven by government measures to promote E20 gasohol and B20 biodiesel, as well as increased fuel consumption during the year-end travel season, according to Global Green Chemical (GGC), the country's largest producer of ethanol and methyl ester by production capacity.

summary_cn: Power Mall连锁在经济增长乏力的环境下采取积极措施，今年销售增长维持在3-5%。公司重点推动新型科技产品销售，强化人工智能应用，升级门店客户体验。目标明年销售增速超越家电市场整体增长，以此抵抗经济不景气冲击。

title: Capital markets bolster their cyber defences
desc: Thailand's capital market business operators have tightened cybersecurity measures as securities firms and market infrastructure operators face persistent attempts by hackers to infiltrate trading systems and customer accounts.
title_cn: 泰国资本市场加强网络安全防御
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易所和市场基础设施运营商持续面临黑客入侵威胁，针对交易系统和客户账户的网络攻击频繁发生。资本市场参与机构已加强网络安全措施防范此类风险，以保护投资者资产安全。
desc_original: Thailand's capital market business operators have tightened cybersecurity measures as securities firms and market infrastructure operators face persistent attempts by hackers to infiltrate trading systems and customer accounts.

title: Hotels call for greater sustainability
desc: Sustainability should go hand-in-hand with hospitality and tourism businesses in order to create a positive impact on local communities and leverage Thailand's competitiveness, said operators at the Spain-Thailand Hotel and Tourism Seminar.
title_cn: 酒店业倡导可持续发展战略
summary_cn: 在西班牙-泰国酒店与旅游研讨会上，业界人士指出可持续发展应与酒店及旅游经营深度融合，以此为当地社区产生积极影响，并增强泰国在国际旅游市场的竞争力。
desc_original: Sustainability should go hand-in-hand with hospitality and tourism businesses in order to create a positive impact on local communities and leverage Thailand's competitiveness, said operators at the Spain-Thailand Hotel and Tourism Seminar.

title: Megaspeed ตั้งสอบภายใน หลังถูกโยงปมสายลับจีน-อดีตซีอีโอ Nvidia
desc: บริษัท Megaspeed ตั้งกรรมการสอบสวนภายใน กรณีอดีตผู้บริหารซึ่งพัวพันกับ เจนเซน หวง อดีตซีอีโอของ Nvidia ถูกสหรัฐฯ กล่าวหาว่า เป็นสายลับจีน
title_cn: Megaspeed启动内部调查：前管理层被指与英伟达前CEO间谍案有关
summary_cn: Megaspeed公司启动内部调查程序。公司一名前高管被曝与英伟达（Nvidia）前首席执行官黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）有关联，美国已对该前高管提出中国间谍指控。此事涉及国际网络安全和商业信誉争议。

title: WORPT wins approval for tourist payments
desc: WORPT has become the first platform in Thailand to let tourists convert digital currencies and pay via Thai QR PromptPay, with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) granting it an 18-month sandbox period, during which the company expects to generate 15 billion baht in tourism spending.
title_cn: WORPT 获批推出游客支付服务
summary_cn: WORPT 成为泰国首个允许游客转换数字货币并通过泰国二维码支付（PromptPay）的平台。证券交易委员会（SEC）已授予其 18 个月的沙箱试验期。在此期间，WORPT 预计将产生 150 亿泰铢的旅游消费。这一举措有助于推动泰国旅游业数字化转型，简化游客支付流程。
desc_original: WORPT has become the first platform in Thailand to let tourists convert digital currencies and pay via Thai QR PromptPay, with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) granting it an 18-month sandbox period, during which the company expects to generate 15 billion baht in tourism spending.

title: Phuket steps up effort to reclaim land
desc: Phuket is stepping up efforts to reclaim public land and regulate commercial activities at beaches and other coastal locations to protect public access and strengthen its tourism industry.
title_cn: 普吉岛加强公共用地收回工作
summary_cn: 普吉岛当局正加强对公共用地的收回工作，并加强对海滩及沿海地区商业活动的监管。此举旨在保护公众通行权，维护旅游胜地的公共利益，进一步巩固普吉岛作为国际旅游目的地的地位。地方政府计划对非法占用和商业侵占公共区域的行为进行严厉整顿。
desc_original: Phuket is stepping up efforts to reclaim public land and regulate commercial activities at beaches and other coastal locations to protect public access and strengthen its tourism industry.

title: Asean holds the line on Myanmar
desc: Southeast Asian leaders have agreed to pursue a phased, progress-based engagement with Myanmar while maintaining restrictions on its political representation at Asean.
title_cn: 东盟对缅甸政策保持坚定立场
summary_cn: 东南亚领导人就对缅甸的政策达成共识，将采取分阶段、以进展为基础的接触方式。同时，东盟将继续限制缅甸在组织内的政治代表权。这反映了东盟在面对缅甸局势时的谨慎态度，既不完全隔离，也不无条件接纳，体现了区域外交的微妙平衡。
desc_original: Southeast Asian leaders have agreed to pursue a phased, progress-based engagement with Myanmar while maintaining restrictions on its political representation at Asean.

title: Stronger unity needed: PM
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has outlined three priorities for Asean, calling for stronger regional unity, greater economic resilience and people-centred cooperation, as the bloc faces mounting geopolitical tensions, economic fragmentation and transnational security threats.
title_cn: 总理呼吁东盟加强区域团结
summary_cn: 面对地缘政治紧张加剧、经济碎片化和跨国安全威胁，泰国总理阿努廷·查尼瓦拉昆（Anutin Charnvirakul）为东盟提出了三项优先事项：加强区域团结、增强经济韧性和实现以人民为中心的合作。这体现了东盟在面对复杂形势下的战略调整和对区域一体化的重新强调。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has outlined three priorities for Asean, calling for stronger regional unity, greater economic resilience and people-centred cooperation, as the bloc faces mounting geopolitical tensions, economic fragmentation and transnational security threats.

title: Central bank governor defends reform record
desc: Bank of Thailand (BoT) governor Vitai Ratanakorn has defended his approach to tackling Thailand's structural economic problems, insisting that meaningful reform requires real action rather than criticism.
title_cn: 央行行长为经济改革政策辩护
summary_cn: 泰国央行（Bank of Thailand, BoT）行长维泰·拉塔纳科恩（Vitai Ratanakorn）为其经济政策改革方案进行了辩护。他强调，解决泰国结构性经济问题需要切实行动而非空言指责。央行正通过改革措施应对泰国经济中的深层次问题，旨在增强经济结构韧性和竞争力。
desc_original: Bank of Thailand (BoT) governor Vitai Ratanakorn has defended his approach to tackling Thailand's structural economic problems, insisting that meaningful reform requires real action rather than criticism.

title: Govt House protest tests Anutin
desc: A livelihood protest could become a prolonged test of Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul's government if economic grievances remain unresolved and political groups join the campaign.
title_cn: 生计抗议考验阿努廷政府
summary_cn: 泰国政府大楼前爆发生计抗议活动，反映民众对经济困难的深刻不满。若底层经济问题未能得到妥善解决，且政治反对派或其他社会团体也加入声援，此次抗议可能演变为对副总理阿努廷·詹威拉空 Anutin Charnvirakul 政府执政合法性的长期考验。事件凸显经济结构调整的紧迫性，同时也直接考验政府的危机应对能力与决策执行力。
desc_original: A livelihood protest could become a prolonged test of Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul's government if economic grievances remain unresolved and political groups join the campaign.

title: Delta shifts to higher-value manufacturing
desc: Amid increasingly demanding technological requirements and a less predictable global market, Victor Cheng has been steering Delta Electronics (Thailand) towards more sophisticated manufacturing, primarily by strengthening local research and development (R&D) as operating pressures have intensified.
title_cn: 台达电子推进高端制造升级
summary_cn: 面对全球市场波动加剧和技术要求不断提升，台达电子（Delta Electronics）泰国公司在总经理 Victor Cheng 领导下，积极推进向高端制造转变。公司主要通过强化本地研发（R&D）投入、引进先进技术、优化生产流程等措施，以应对日益激烈的市场竞争压力。这一战略转变反映了跨国电子制造企业在全球产业升级背景下的主动调整与创新谋划。
desc_original: Amid increasingly demanding technological requirements and a less predictable global market, Victor Cheng has been steering Delta Electronics (Thailand) towards more sophisticated manufacturing, primarily by strengthening local research and development (R&D) as operating pressures have intensified.

title: Govt, US near trade deal
desc: Thailand and the United States have reached an agreement in principle on a reciprocal trade deal.
title_cn: 泰美贸易谈判取得重大突破
summary_cn: 泰国与美国就互惠贸易协议原则上达成一致，预计将进一步推动两国在经济、贸易、投资等领域的深化合作。该协议一旦最终落地，有望优化两国商业环境，吸引更多投资，同时也可能对泰国市场商品供应、物价水平、就业机会等方面产生连锁效应。这是两国经贸关系发展的重要里程碑。
desc_original: Thailand and the United States have reached an agreement in principle on a reciprocal trade deal.

title: Getting the most out of AI at work
desc: Artificial intelligence is becoming an everyday workplace assistant, but effective prompting, data privacy and information management remain major challenges for SMEs and office workers seeking to maximise its benefits, a forum was told.
title_cn: 职场AI应用的最佳实践
summary_cn: 人工智能日益成为现代职场的常见助手，但数据隐私保护、有效提示编写技巧、敏感信息管理等仍是中小企业和办公人员面临的主要挑战。与会专家围绕这些问题展开讨论，旨在帮助用户充分发挥AI的潜能。完善的AI应用指南和隐私保护机制将促进企业和个人更安心地采用新技术。
desc_original: Artificial intelligence is becoming an everyday workplace assistant, but effective prompting, data privacy and information management remain major challenges for SMEs and office workers seeking to maximise its benefits, a forum was told.

title: Next 3-5 years critical for LEO regulatory framework
desc: The National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) has identified the next 3-5 years as a critical window to enact a comprehensive regulatory framework to deal with the rapid global momentum of low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite development.
title_cn: 低轨卫星监管框架的关键窗口期
summary_cn: 泰国国家广播电信委员会（NBTC）指出，未来3-5年是制定低轨卫星（LEO）监管框架的关键时期，以应对全球卫星产业快速发展带来的挑战和机遇。完善的监管体系对泰国通信产业发展至关重要，不仅涉及频谱分配、轨道管理等技术问题，也关系到国家信息安全和长期竞争力。
desc_original: The National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) has identified the next 3-5 years as a critical window to enact a comprehensive regulatory framework to deal with the rapid global momentum of low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite development.

title: สมเด็จเจ้าฟ้าสิริวัณณวรีฯ ทรงรับปริญญา ศิลปดุษฎีบัณฑิตกิตติมศักดิ์ มหาวิทยาลัยศิลปากร
desc: สภามหาวิทยาลัยศิลปากร ได้ขอพระราชทานถวาย ปริญญาศิลปดุษฎีบัณฑิตกิตติมศักดิ์ สาขาวิชาการออกแบบเครื่องประดับ แด่ สมเด็จพระเจ้าลูกเธอ เจ้าฟ้า สิริวัณณวรี นารีรัตนราชกัญญา
title_cn: 朱拉隆功大学向诗琳通公主颁授艺术设计荣誉博士学位
summary_cn: 朱拉隆功大学（Chulalongkorn University）宣布向诗琳通公主颁授艺术设计荣誉博士学位，专业方向为珠宝设计。此举由校评议会提议，以表彰公主对艺术设计领域的贡献与支持。

title: Cyberthreats put Asean nations in the crosshairs
desc: The government is being advised to elevate cyber-attack prevention to a national agenda as threats increasingly target critical infrastructure, financial systems and industrial sectors, potentially inflicting massive economic damage, an economist has warned.
title_cn: 东盟国家面临日增网络威胁
summary_cn: 经济学家警告，网络攻击日益针对泰国及东盟各国的关键基础设施、金融系统与工业部门，可能造成巨大经济损失。政府被建议将网络防御提升为国家级议程，强化防护能力应对日益增长的网络安全威胁。
desc_original: The government is being advised to elevate cyber-attack prevention to a national agenda as threats increasingly target critical infrastructure, financial systems and industrial sectors, potentially inflicting massive economic damage, an economist has warned.

title: Super El Niño could bring 'severe flooding' to city
desc: Bangkok could face severe flooding in 2027 amid a projected Super El Niño, prompting climate and disaster specialists to urge stronger preparedness and public self-reliance.
title_cn: 超级厄尔尼诺现象可能引发曼谷严重洪灾
summary_cn: 气候与灾害专家警告，2027年预期的超级厄尔尼诺现象（Super El Niño）可能导致曼谷遭遇严重洪水。专家呼吁加强防灾准备工作，提升公众自救和防灾意识，以最大程度减少自然灾害可能造成的损失。
desc_original: Bangkok could face severe flooding in 2027 amid a projected Super El Niño, prompting climate and disaster specialists to urge stronger preparedness and public self-reliance.

title: Thai Airways emergency landing in Delhi, Bangkok arrival due today
desc: Thai Airways emergency landing in Delhi, Bangkok arrival due today Legacy A Thai Airways Airbus A350-900 en route from Munich to Bangkok was forced to divert and land in New Delhi on Saturday night, November 14, after a technical fault , and passengers spent the weekend in hotels in the Indian capital. The airline is flying to Bangkok today, November 16, on a special flight. Flight TG925 left Munich at 1.35pm local time on Saturday and had been due at Suvarnabhumi International Airport at 6.10am Thai time on Sunday, November 15. The crew found a problem during the flight and diverted to Indira Gandhi International Airport. Passengers stayed on board for almost two hours after landing before staff let them off and took them to hotels the airline had booked. Thai Airways said the captain chose to divert with the safety of passengers and crew as the first priority, that the aircraft landed safely and that no passengers were hurt. The airline added that it had followed aviation safety procedures throughout and apologised to passengers for the disruption. Thai media reported that the fault involved one of the aircraft’s engines and that spare parts had to be sent from Thailand bef
title_cn: 泰航客机新德里紧急迫降，返曼航班今日起飞
summary_cn: 泰国航空一架空客A350客机11月14日因技术故障在印度新德里国际机场（Indira Gandhi International Airport）紧急迫降。机上乘客在新德里酒店逗留周末，航空公司随后安排特殊班机于11月16日送返乘客回曼谷，全程未造成人员伤亡。

title: Fortal bets on AI to take Thai dramas to global audiences
desc: Fortal Entertainment, a Thai artificial intelligence (AI) entertainment startup, aims to win back viewers from imported short dramas and reach audiences overseas by adapting Thai novels into mini-series, producing them with its own AI tools and streaming them on its SiamSun application.
title_cn: Fortal Entertainment以AI赋能泰国电视剧出海
summary_cn: 泰国AI娱乐创业公司Fortal Entertainment利用自主开发的AI工具，改编泰国小说为短剧迷你系列，通过其SiamSun应用流媒体平台发行。公司致力于夺回被海外进口短剧挤占的本地观众市场，并拓展国际受众，推动泰国内容全球化。
desc_original: Fortal Entertainment, a Thai artificial intelligence (AI) entertainment startup, aims to win back viewers from imported short dramas and reach audiences overseas by adapting Thai novels into mini-series, producing them with its own AI tools and streaming them on its SiamSun application.

title: FTI draws up criteria for locally manufactured parts
desc: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI), together with domestic automotive and auto parts manufacturers' associations, is working to establish standardised criteria for parts manufactured under the Made in Thailand scheme.
title_cn: FTI 制定本地制造零件标准
summary_cn: 泰国工业联合会（FTI）与国内汽车及零部件制造商协会合作，为「泰国制造」计划下的零件制定统一标准，旨在提升本地制造产业的品质和竞争力。
desc_original: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI), together with domestic automotive and auto parts manufacturers' associations, is working to establish standardised criteria for parts manufactured under the Made in Thailand scheme.

title: TCC pushes 6-point plan  for growth
desc: The Thai Chamber of Commerce (TCC) has proposed six policy priorities to remove structural barriers, attract investment and lift Thailand's economic growth to at least 3% annually.
title_cn: 泰商总会推出六点经济增长方案
summary_cn: 泰国商业总会（TCC）提出六项政策优先事项，目标是消除结构性障碍、吸引外资投资，将泰国年度经济增长率提升至3%以上，助力国家经济发展。
desc_original: The Thai Chamber of Commerce (TCC) has proposed six policy priorities to remove structural barriers, attract investment and lift Thailand's economic growth to at least 3% annually.

title_cn: 议员促修改宪法建立污染者付费制度
summary_cn: 人民权利民主党议员指出，2560年宪法削弱了环保权利，导致泰国东部沿海地区遭有毒废物污染成为「全球垃圾场」。议员呼吁修改宪法，赋予民众起诉政府和私企的权利，并引入「污染者付费」原则以根治环保问题。

summary_cn: 议员纳德汪要求政府在搬迁供水生产设施前回答五个关键问题，批评政府仅治标不治本地分散处理污染。他强调若不从邻国矿场污染源头解决，泰国河流污染问题将永无解决之日。

title: Dhammajayo no-show fuels mystery over ex-abbot's whereabouts
desc: Former Wat Phra Dhammakaya abbot Phra Dhammajayo was unable to attend a major temple ceremony this month because of health concerns, despite expectations among followers that he might make a rare appearance, a spokesman for his disciples said.
title_cn: 法雨寺前住持达摩加亚（Dhammajayo）缺席引发去向之谜
summary_cn: 泰国法雨寺（Wat Phra Dhammakaya）前住持达摩加亚本月因健康原因缺席寺庙重要仪式，追随者原本期待他会罕见现身参加活动。这位曾颇具影响力的僧人近年来行踪神秘，此次缺席再度引发外界对其健康状况和住处的关注。
desc_original: Former Wat Phra Dhammakaya abbot Phra Dhammajayo was unable to attend a major temple ceremony this month because of health concerns, despite expectations among followers that he might make a rare appearance, a spokesman for his disciples said.

title: Elephant runs amok, kills 2 villagers in Surat Thani
desc: Two villagers were trampled to death by a domesticated bull elephant in musth that chased residents away from their parked vehicles and overturned a pickup truck outside a house in rural Surat Thani.
title_cn: 发情公象失控踏死两村民，素叻他尼府发生惨剧
summary_cn: 素叻他尼府（Surat Thani）一头处于发情期（musth）的驯养公象突然失控，踏死两名村民，并对其他居民进行追赶，还推翻了一辆停放在房屋外的皮卡车。发情期公象因荷尔蒙升高具有极高危险性，此事再次警示泰国农村地区与野生动物相处的风险。

title: ‘Zombie fish’ found in Mekong raise concerns over heavy metal pollution
desc: ‘Zombie fish’ found in Mekong raise concerns over heavy metal pollution Legacy Fish with swollen blisters, sores and discoloured fins have been found in the Mekong River , raising concerns about possible links to arsenic and other heavy metals detected in the water. Environmental activist Aombun Thipsuna shared photographs of affected pla khae (catfish) yesterday, November 14. Some residents have dubbed the unusual-looking fish “zombie fish”. Aombun believes heavy metal pollution may be weakening the fish’s immune systems and making them more vulnerable to disease. However, the cause of the symptoms has not been confirmed. Speaking to Ejan, she said local fishermen had been finding fish with similar abnormalities since the period following the Covid-19 pandemic. Photo via Hug Mekong Youth She linked the reports to water-quality monitoring by Pollution Control Department Region 9 in Udon Thani, which she said had recorded increasing heavy-metal concentrations in the Mekong since 2023. According to Aombun, contamination levels rose more sharply between 2024 and 2026. She said the latest arsenic measurements in August were three to four times the standard

title: 曼谷湄南河璀璨灯光节开幕，19处地标点亮夜空
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，近日，泰国旅游与体育部联合泰国国家旅游局正式启动2026年“湄南河璀璨灯光节”。本届活动以“想象之光”为主题，通过灯光、音乐、多媒体投影、无人机表演及烟花秀等形式点亮曼谷湄南河两岸，打造年底旅游旺季的重要夜间旅游活动。 当天，泰国旅游与体育部长素拉萨、泰国国家旅游局局长塔佩妮，以及内阁成员、各国驻泰大使、政府及私营部门代表等共同乘船，沿湄南河欣赏灯光表演，并邀请国内外游客前来体验曼谷夜间旅游的独特魅力。 今年是该活动连续举办的第5年，活动时间为11月13日至12月13日，每晚18时至22时，范围覆盖曼谷拉玛八世大桥至拉玛三世大桥之间的湄南河沿岸，共设置19处表演点位。除结合历史建筑、寺庙、博物馆、桥梁及河畔地标呈现的声光与多媒体表演外，还将安排超过800架无人机组成的空中灯光秀及大型烟花表演。 素拉萨表示，湄南河不仅是曼谷重要的历史文化象征，也是展示泰国旅游魅力的重要载体。通过将传统文化与现代灯光技术相结合，活动能够为游客提供更加丰富的夜间旅游体验，吸引游客延长在曼谷的停留时间。同时，活动也将带动湄南河沿岸游船、酒店、餐饮及其他旅游相关产业发展，促进游客消费，进一步提升曼谷作为国际旅游城市的吸引力。 塔佩妮表示，“湄南河璀璨灯光节”是泰旅局推动2027年度旅游营销计划的重要大型活动之一。泰旅局希望通过发展“节庆经济”，将泰国的历史文化、河岸生活方式与现代多媒体技术相结合，提升旅游体验的附加价值。她指出，泰国正积极推动旅游业从单纯追求游客数量转向更加注重旅游质量与体验价值，并通过发展夜间旅游创造更多消费机会，将经济收益进一步带动至湄南河沿岸社区及相关企业，以实现成为“亚洲第一高价值及深度体验旅游目的地”的目标。 泰旅局预计，本届活动将在一个月内吸引超过140万人次游客参与，创造不少于86亿泰铢的经济收入。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：bangkokbiznews） The post 曼谷湄南河璀璨灯光节开幕，19处地标点亮夜空 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Southern Thailand faces dengue warning amid flooding, 47 deaths
desc: Southern Thailand faces dengue warning amid flooding, 47 deaths Legacy The Thai government has warned residents in southern Thailand of an increased dengue fever risk as flooding and persistent rainfall create more mosquito breeding sites , with 47 deaths recorded nationwide this year. Deputy government spokesperson Ploythalay Laksamisaengchan issued the warning today, November 15, citing figures from the Department of Disease Control (DDC). Thailand recorded 34,875 dengue fever cases and 47 deaths between January 1 and November 7. Most patients were schoolchildren and working-age adults, while the reported deaths were concentrated among elderly people. The DDC figures show that southern Thailand has the country’s highest dengue burden, particularly in Health Regions 11 and 12. Health Region 11 covers Surat Thani, Ranong, Phuket , Phang Nga, Nakhon Si Thammarat, Chumphon and Krabi, while Region 12 includes Trang, Narathiwat, Pattani, Phatthalung, Yala, Songkhla and Satun. The government said dengue levels in Health Region 11 were approximately 1.7 times the national average, possibly due to continued rainfall. title_cn: 南泰洪水引登革热风险 全国逾47人死亡
summary_cn: 泰国南部因持续降雨引发洪水，导致蚊虫滋生地增加，登革热风险大幅上升。今年截至11月7日，泰国共报告登革热病例34,875例，死亡47人，其中南部的卫生区11（包括苏梅岛 Surat Thani、普吉 Phuket 等）和卫生区12（包括董里 Trang、也拉 Yala 等）病情最严重，南部疫情负担约为全国平均水平的1.7倍。患者多为学生和工作年龄人群，死亡病例主要集中在老年人。

title: 泰国全年外国游客预计3124万人次，低于目标！泰旅局启动冬季促销
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月15日，据泰媒报道，泰国国家旅游局局长塔佩妮表示，受主要客源市场增长放缓等因素影响，2026年泰国旅游业仍面临一定挑战。预计今年最后两个月将迎来约583万人次外国游客，全年外国游客总量约为3124万人次，低于旅游局此前设定的3150万人次目标。 为缩小约26万人次的预期差距，泰旅局计划在年底旅游旺季进一步加大市场推广力度，争取额外吸引至少30万人次外国游客，并将促销活动持续推进至春节期间，以实现全年3150万人次的目标。 在11月至12月的旅游推广计划中，泰旅局将重点开发短途客源市场及高消费能力游客群体，通过“Thailand Winter Plus”项目加强对9个重点市场的营销，包括中国大陆、马来西亚、韩国、中国香港、中国台湾、印度、越南、印度尼西亚及海湾阿拉伯国家合作委员会成员国市场。该项目将与航空公司、旅游业合作伙伴及线上平台联合开展促销活动，同时加强邮轮旅游和体育旅游推广，力争在年底维持至少190万人次的短途市场游客规模，并进一步增加外国游客入境人数。 展望2027年，泰旅局预计外国游客人数约为3294万人次，但已将全年目标设定为3400万人次。为弥补约106万人次的差距，旅游局计划重点加强东亚市场的航空运力，争取额外增加约106万个航空客运座位。此外，泰旅局将于2026年11月20日至2027年3月31日推出“Thailand Winter Blast”冬季旅游推广计划，支持至少200架次包机航班，与至少5家航空公司联合推出促销活动，并组织不少于100家海外旅行社及媒体机构参与大型考察活动，进一步扩大泰国旅游市场的国际影响力。 塔佩妮表示，泰旅局将通过刺激年底旅游需求、扩大国际航班运力及提升海外市场信心等措施，持续增强泰国旅游业的竞争力，推动2027年旅游市场进一步增长。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：thansettakij） The post 泰国全年外国游客预计3124万人次，低于目标！泰旅局启动冬季促销 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: FBI-wanted American linked to human trafficking caught in Phuket
desc: FBI-wanted American linked to human trafficking caught in Phuket Legacy An American man wanted in the United States in connection with a human trafficking case was detained at a luxury villa in Phuket after the FBI asked Thai immigration police to locate him. The suspect, identified as 33 year old Ronald, was found at a villa in Chalong subdistrict, Mueang Phuket district, on November 13. Phuket Immigration Police said the FBI had contacted them about Ronald, who was the subject of a US arrest warrant and had been linked to a human trafficking investigation. title: 中介声称收取1.8万元可保入境？泰国移民局回应
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月14日，泰国移民局就近日中国游客在素万那普机场被拒绝入境、滞留候机区域，以及有人声称可支付1.8万元人民币协助通关等争议作出回应。移民局表示，11月12日共有92名外国旅客被拒绝入境，其中45人为中国籍，目前均已陆续被遣返。同时，移民局否认针对中国游客采取歧视性措施，强调加强入境审查主要是为了防范跨国电信诈骗及其他犯罪活动。 此前，社交媒体流传有关中国游客在素万那普机场被拒绝入境的视频和投诉，涉及等待遣返区域的环境，以及有中介声称收取1.8万元人民币便可帮助旅客顺利通过泰国移民检查等问题，引发外界关注。对此，泰国移民局副局长兼发言人程隆警少将表示，移民局局长诺帕辛警中将已获悉相关情况，并立即指示移民局第二分局局长展开调查。 针对网传所谓的“遣返拘留室”，程隆警少将解释称，该区域实际上是供被拒绝入境的外国旅客等待返程航班的临时休息场所，由航空公司负责管理，并非关押刑事犯罪嫌疑人的拘留设施。旅客可以依法使用手机，现场也配备符合基本人权要求的必要设施。由于旅客需根据返程航班安排陆续离境，等待区域内的人数会随航班情况发生变化。对于能够当天乘机返回、无需过夜的旅客，机场方面还另外设置了专门的候机区域，以缓解原有场所的拥挤情况。 关于拒绝入境的原因，移民局表示，泰国目前正在加强对高风险外国旅客的审查，尤其是以旅游名义入境，却无法提供可信旅游行程或证明实际旅行目的的人员。有关措施旨在防止跨国诈骗团伙转移至泰国设立据点，或利用泰国作为藏匿、逃避执法及洗钱的场所。 对于网传中介收取1.8万元人民币帮助旅客通关的说法，移民局指出，自泰国加强入境审查以来，中国部分网络平台出现声称可以提前与泰国移民官员协调、保证顺利入境的收费广告。移民局此前已提醒旅客警惕此类骗局，避免遭到诈骗。程隆警少将强调，目前有关中介收费协助通关的指控尚缺乏具体证据，不能据此认定泰国移民官员存在违法行为。如果投诉者掌握明确线索，移民局愿意接收相关证据，并依法调查涉事人员。 针对外界质疑泰国移民局专门针对中国游客的说法，程隆警少将公布统计数据称，自2026年1月1日至此次数据统计时，共有487.9万人次中国籍旅客入境泰国，其中1.29万人次被拒绝入境，占比约0.26%。他强调，泰国对其他国家旅客同样采取统一的入境审查标准，并不存在专门针对中国游客的区别对待。 泰国移民局表示，根据泰国国家警察总署的政策要求，全国各入境检查站将继续加强对可疑外国人员的筛查，防止涉及犯罪活动的人员进入或长期藏匿泰国。同时强调，泰国始终欢迎遵守法律、以正常旅游为目的的外国游客，并将继续坚持“守法者通行便利，违法者入境困难”的原则。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：tnnthailand） The post 中介声称收取1.8万元可保入境？泰国移民局回应 appeared first o

title: 中国男子涉嫌职务侵占1130万元，潜逃曼谷终落网
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月15日，据泰媒报道，泰国中央调查局联合移民局在曼谷逮捕一名26岁中国籍男子刘某（音译）。该男子因涉嫌利用职务之便侵占公司价值1130万元人民币的货物，被中国警方通缉，随后潜逃至泰国藏匿。 据泰国警方通报，此次行动由中央调查局局长及抑制经济犯罪司司长指挥，抑制经济犯罪司第二调查组与曼谷移民局调查人员联合执行，最终在曼谷Din Daeng区一房间外将刘某抓获。 此前，澜沧江—湄公河综合执法安全合作中心（LMLECC）向泰国警方提供线索，请求协助追查因涉嫌职务侵占而被中国当局通缉的刘某。根据中国安徽省芜湖市公安机关的调查资料，2024年9月至2025年7月期间，刘某担任芜湖某运输有限公司顺德仓库负责人，涉嫌利用管理职权，私自将仓库内的零部件运出并出售牟利。为掩盖相关行为，刘某还涉嫌制作虚假采购订单，并伪造带有客户签名的收款凭证，以掩饰账目异常。相关行为造成公司损失高达1130万元人民币。2025年11月28日，中国警方对其发出逮捕令，并通过网上追逃系统将其列为通缉人员。 泰国警方接获协查请求后，通过出入境记录及相关线索展开调查，确认刘某已逃离中国并藏匿在曼谷，随后部署抓捕行动将其控制。由于刘某在泰国的合法停留许可已过期，泰国警方首先以逾期居留罪名将其逮捕，并移交曼谷移民局调查人员依法处理。同时， （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：mgronline） The post 中国男子涉嫌职务侵占1130万元，潜逃曼谷终落网 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Minibus driver arrested over alleged repeated rape, death threats
desc: Minibus driver arrested over alleged repeated rape, death threats Legacy A Hua Hin minibus driver accused of repeatedly raping a woman inside his vehicle in Bangkok, threatening her and warning that he would harm her daughter , has been arrested in Prachuap Khiri Khan. The suspect, identified as 39 year old Wiranchana, was arrested on November 13 in Wang Phong subdistrict, Pran Buri district. Police said he worked as a driver on the Bangkok to Hua Hin to Pran Buri minibus route. According to the woman’s complaint, the driver tricked her into entering his minibus before locking the doors to prevent her from escaping. title: Bangkok declares war on rats in Silom, Chinatown and Sukhumvit
desc: Bangkok declares war on rats in Silom, Chinatown and Sukhumvit Legacy Bangkok City Hall has started a war on rats in Silom, Yaowarat (Chinatown), Banthat Thong and Sukhumvit, focusing on the food waste that sits on pavements and attracts rats, Governor Chadchart Sittipunt said yesterday, November 14. The city will count rats with motion cameras and traps for about six months to check whether the measures cut their numbers. Chadchart set out the plan on a visit to Bang Rak district, which includes Silom Road. He said the district has so many residents and restaurants that rubbish builds up there several times a day, and that the campaign also covers Din Daeng district. Deputy Governor Pornprom Vikitsreth said the main problem is timing, because people put rubbish bags out in the evening but trucks often collect them late at night or after midnight, which gives rats hours to feed. These are the measures for the pilot areas: Chadchart said dry waste such as plastic is not a main food source for rats, while food scraps are what draw them into an area, so separating food waste and storing it properly is central to the campaign. title: Satun Geopark may lose UNESCO status over management issues
desc: Satun Geopark may lose UNESCO status over management issues Legacy Satun UNESCO Global Geopark risks losing its UNESCO designation after receiving a yellow card , giving Thailand until January 31, 2027, to submit evidence of improvements before another assessment. The warning followed a UNESCO reassessment conducted from July 15 to 19, 2025, which identified weaknesses in the geopark’s management structure and coordination between local agencies. Nipon Chamnongsirisak, director-general of the Department of Mineral Resources, addressed the issue yesterday, November 14, saying the government was working with Satun officials to resolve the problems. UNESCO’s main concerns involve the lack of a permanent management structure and insufficient cooperation between organisations responsible for the site. Satun UNESCO Global Geopark received its international designation on April 17, 2018, becoming one of Thailand’s internationally recognised geological attractions. summary_cn: 沙敦UNESCO全球地质公园因管理结构不完善、机构协调不足收到黄牌警告。联合国教科文组织要求泰国在2027年1月31日前提交整改证据。该地质公园2018年获国际认证，占地约1.62万平方公里，跨Thung Wa、Manang、La-ngu等四县，包含Tarutao国家公园，具有重要地质旅游价值。政府正协调各部门完善管理体系，确保其UNESCO地位。
desc_original: Satun Geopark may lose UNESCO status over management issues Legacy Satun UNESCO Global Geopark risks losing its UNESCO designation after receiving a yellow card , giving Thailand until January 31, 2027, to submit evidence of improvements before another assessment. The warning followed a UNESCO reassessment conducted from July 15 to 19, 2025, which identified weaknesses in the geopark’s management structure and coordination between local agencies. Nipon Chamnongsirisak, director-general of the Department of Mineral Resources, addressed the issue yesterday, November 14, saying the government was working with Satun officials to resolve the problems. UNESCO’s main concerns involve the lack of a permanent management structure and insufficient cooperation between organisations responsible for the site. Satun UNESCO Global Geopark received its international designation on April 17, 2018, becoming one of Thailand’s internationally recognised geological attractions. title: 第49届东盟峰会开幕，多国领导人齐聚马尼拉
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，菲律宾当地时间11月15日上午，泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷携夫人抵达菲律宾首都马尼拉的菲律宾国际会议中心，出席第49届东盟峰会及系列相关会议。菲律宾总统马科斯与夫人在现场迎接，双方握手致意并合影留念。此次峰会期间，菲律宾还特别安排电动三轮车作为领导人的交通工具之一。各国领导人及配偶抵达会场后，在全体会议厅入口处合影，随后共同出席峰会开幕式。 上午9时，第49届东盟峰会正式开幕。仪式首先举行新版东盟标志揭幕及新版东盟旗帜升旗仪式，并奏响东盟会歌。菲律宾总统与东盟秘书长随后参与新版东盟旗帜及相关证书交接仪式。菲律宾总统致欢迎辞后，现场举行以“同心共进”为主题的文化表演，展现东盟各国文化的多样性与区域团结精神。 开幕式的重要议程之一，是正式移交已签署的《东盟数字经济框架协定》。东盟经济共同体理事会主席将协定交予菲律宾总统，再转交东盟秘书长，标志着东盟在推动区域数字经济一体化、促进跨境贸易便利化方面取得重要进展。此外，现场还举行2026年度东盟奖颁奖仪式，表彰为东盟合作及共同体发展作出突出贡献的个人或组织。 本届峰会汇集东盟成员国国家元首、政府首脑及代表，同时邀请多个对话伙伴国家领导人和国际组织代表出席，包括中国国务院总理李强、韩国总统李在明、日本首相高市早苗、印度总理莫迪、澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯、美国总统特朗普、俄罗斯外交部长拉夫罗夫及联合国秘书长古特雷斯。此外，作为东盟轮值主席国的特别嘉宾，巴西总统卢拉、加拿大总理卡尼及国际货币基金组织总裁格奥尔基耶娃也出席相关活动。 根据行程安排，阿努廷上午将出席第49届东盟峰会全体会议，中午与东盟各国领导人共进午餐，随后参加领导人非正式会议，就区域重要议题交换意见。下午，阿努廷计划与老挝总理举行双边会谈，并出席东盟领导人与东盟议会联盟及东盟商业咨询理事会代表的会议，进一步探讨区域合作与经济发展等议题。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：matichon） The post 第49届东盟峰会开幕，多国领导人齐聚马尼拉 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 第49届东盟峰会开幕 多国领导人齐聚马尼拉
summary_cn: 第49届东盟峰会在菲律宾首都马尼拉开幕，泰国总理阿努廷与夫人出席。开幕式举行新版东盟旗帜升旗仪式、移交《东盟数字经济框架协定》并颁发2026年度东盟奖。出席者包括中国国务院总理李强、美国总统特朗普、印度总理莫迪、日本首相高市早苗、韩国总统李在明、俄罗斯外长拉夫罗夫及联合国秘书长古特雷斯等多国领导人。阿努廷的日程包括全体会议、领导人非正式会议、与老挝总理双边会谈，探讨区域合作与经济发展议题。

title: 泰国国王会见中国国务院总理李强
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月14日下午5时22分，泰国国王玛哈·哇集拉隆功与王后素提达在曼谷律实宫会见正在对泰国进行正式访问的中国国务院总理李强。 泰中两国友好交往历史悠久，于1975年7月1日正式建立外交关系。2025年11月13日至17日，应中国国家主席习近平邀请，泰国国王与王后对中国进行国事访问，共同庆祝泰中建交50周年，访问期间曾会见李强总理。泰国王室成员与中国领导人长期保持密切交往，两国高层互访不断深化双边友好关系，增进两国人民相互理解。 此次李强访泰是中国国务院总理自2019年以来首次对泰国进行正式访问，为双方进一步深化各领域合作提供重要契机。两国将重点围绕贸易、投资、电动汽车产业及旅游业等领域探讨合作，进一步增强合作信心，推动构建更加紧密的中泰命运共同体，深化全面战略合作伙伴关系。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：matichon） The post 泰国国王会见中国国务院总理李强 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Songkhla Lake bridge work starts
desc: Construction of a 7km bridge across Songkhla Lake began on Saturday, raising prospects for trade, transport and tourism between Songkhla and Phatthalung as travel time is slashed.
title_cn: 宋卡湖 Songkhla Lake 跨湖大桥工程启动
summary_cn: 宋卡湖跨越大桥于本周六启动建设。这座 7 公里长的大桥将连接宋卡和披集县 Phatthalung，预计大幅缩短两地旅程时间。大桥建成后不仅能促进贸易和运输往来，还将为两地旅游业发展带来新机遇，推动区域经济一体化进程。
desc_original: Construction of a 7km bridge across Songkhla Lake began on Saturday, raising prospects for trade, transport and tourism between Songkhla and Phatthalung as travel time is slashed.

title: Rayong groups oppose fossil, gas expansion
desc: Rayong fishing communities and Greenpeace Thailand have called on the government to halt fossil-gas expansion and industrial development, warning that both pose threats to marine ecosystems and local livelihoods.
title_cn: 罗勇渔业社区与绿色和平反对化石燃料扩张
summary_cn: 罗勇渔业社区及绿色和平组织要求泰国政府停止推进化石燃料及工业扩张项目。两方强调这些发展计划将破坏当地海洋生态系统，直接威胁渔民生计和传统捕鱼业。此事凸显环保与经济发展之间的深层次矛盾。
desc_original: Rayong fishing communities and Greenpeace Thailand have called on the government to halt fossil-gas expansion and industrial development, warning that both pose threats to marine ecosystems and local livelihoods.

title: Army slams temple exhibit in Cambodia
desc: The Royal Thai Army has challenged Cambodia's portrayal of three disputed temples at an international exhibition in Phnom Penh.
title_cn: 泰国军方反驳柬埔寨国际展览中对争议寺庙的描述
summary_cn: 泰国皇家军队公开质疑柬埔寨在金边国际展览中对三座边境争议寺庙的展示方式。这次对峙反映了泰柬两国在边界圣地归属权与文化遗产所有权上的持久分歧，属地区外交中的敏感问题。
desc_original: The Royal Thai Army has challenged Cambodia's portrayal of three disputed temples at an international exhibition in Phnom Penh.

title: Anutin takes pitch to summits
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will highlight Thailand's energy security, infrastructure and investment potential at the upcoming Asean and Apec summits, seeking to attract global investors to use the country as a gateway to a regional market of 700 million people under the concept of "Asean and Beyond".
title_cn: 阿努廷总理为泰国经济发展方案游说国际峰会
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷·查尼瓦拉库尔将在即将召开的东盟与亚太经合组织峰会上推介泰国的能源安全战略、基础设施发展和投资潜力。他以泰国作为通往 7 亿人区域市场的门户这一「东盟及其他」概念为核心，向全球投资者展示泰国的战略地位和商业机遇。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will highlight Thailand's energy security, infrastructure and investment potential at the upcoming Asean and Apec summits, seeking to attract global investors to use the country as a gateway to a regional market of 700 million people under the concept of "Asean and Beyond".

title: Firms to face rising pressure: SCG
desc: Thai businesses face mounting economic and technological pressures over the next three years, prompting calls for stronger preparation, closer supply-chain cooperation and workforce training.
title_cn: 泰国企业面临三年经济科技双重压力
summary_cn: 泰国企业在未来三年面临经济衰退和数字化转型的双重压力。商业领袖呼吁加强供应链合作、强化员工培训、提升技术创新能力，以应对日益激烈的国际竞争和产业结构调整带来的挑战。
desc_original: Thai businesses face mounting economic and technological pressures over the next three years, prompting calls for stronger preparation, closer supply-chain cooperation and workforce training.

title: Stronger resilience, collaboration key
desc: Stronger national resilience and closer public-private collaboration to ensure foreign investment delivers benefits for Thailand's domestic economy, says Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.
title_cn: 强化国家韧性与公私合作为外资进驻关键
summary_cn: 泰国副总理兼财政部长埃克尼蒂·尼迪塔庞帕同强调，加强国家经济韧性和深化公共部门与私营部门的合作是当下重中之重。他指出，泰国需通过完善的政策框架和机制，确保外商投资能为国内经济创造实际收益，而非仅作为资本流入的过客。这要求政府、企业和社会各界的协同努力和长期承诺。
desc_original: Stronger national resilience and closer public-private collaboration to ensure foreign investment delivers benefits for Thailand's domestic economy, says Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.

title: Thais review air safety after US disruptions
desc: The Transport Ministry is reviewing Thailand's aviation safety systems after a communications failure disrupted 22 air traffic control centres across the United States.
title_cn: 美国空管故障触发泰国航空安全全面审查
summary_cn: 因美国近期发生通讯故障导致22个空中交通管制中心瘫痪的严重事件，泰国交通部启动了对国内航空安全系统的全面审查和评估。这一事件凸显了现代航空基础设施对通讯技术的高度依赖性，以及单点故障可能造成的广泛影响。泰国必须确保类似故障不会在国内发生，持续保护民众的出行安全。
desc_original: The Transport Ministry is reviewing Thailand's aviation safety systems after a communications failure disrupted 22 air traffic control centres across the United States.

title: Energy crisis prompts soul searching
desc: Thailand is facing a slow-burning economic crisis as rising energy costs, stagnant wages and mounting household debt squeeze consumers, exposing weaknesses in government policies.
title_cn: 能源危机引发泰国经济深度反思
summary_cn: 泰国正经历一场缓慢而深刻的经济危机，表现为能源成本不断上升、劳动者工资停滞不前、家庭债务负担日益加重。这些多重压力相互叠加，严重挤压了消费者的消费能力和生活质量，进而制约了整体经济增长前景。分析指出，这场危机暴露了政府在产业政策、能源战略和社会保障等方面的系统性不足。
desc_original: Thailand is facing a slow-burning economic crisis as rising energy costs, stagnant wages and mounting household debt squeeze consumers, exposing weaknesses in government policies.

title: Low-rate loan apps draw warning
desc: Police have warned against illegal loan apps offering unrealistically low interest rates, after borrowers suffered losses, threats and harassment.
title_cn: 警方警惕非法低息贷款应用诈骗陷阱
summary_cn: 泰国警方对利用移动应用程序开展的非法贷款业务发出警告，这些应用声称提供不合理的低利率以吸引借款人。受害者已遭遇重大经济损失、人身威胁和持续性骚扰。警方提醒公众要提高金融安全意识，谨慎识别此类金融诈骗。这些非法放贷行为不仅威胁个人财产安全，还可能与黑社会组织相关联。
desc_original: Police have warned against illegal loan apps offering unrealistically low interest rates, after borrowers suffered losses, threats and harassment.

title: Investment and market access key in China links
desc: The Thai Chamber of Commerce has urged Thailand and China to improve investment facilitation, market access and transport links to help businesses in both countries expand.
title_cn: 投资便利化和市场准入成中泰合作重点
summary_cn: 泰国商会呼吁泰中两国政府加强战略合作，重点包括改善投资便利化环境、扩大市场准入、完善跨境运输连接等基础设施建设。通过这些举措，两国企业可获得更多商业机遇，实现业务跨境扩张和深度融合。这也符合区域一体化的大趋势，有利于推动泰国融入更广阔的地区经济生态。
desc_original: The Thai Chamber of Commerce has urged Thailand and China to improve investment facilitation, market access and transport links to help businesses in both countries expand.

title: Asia scam losses hit US$136.5 billion as gangs turn to AI
desc: Asia scam losses hit US$136.5 billion as gangs turn to AI Legacy Scam losses in Asia reached an estimated US$136.5 billion (about 4.6 trillion baht) across 13 markets, including Thailand, over the past 12 months, according to a regional survey presented at an anti-scam summit in Bangkok on November 10 and 11. The organisers warned that criminal gangs are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) to run entire scams automatically. The Global Anti-Scam Alliance (GASA) carried out the survey with Gogolook, the Taiwan-based maker of the Whoscall app, in markets including Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, China and India. They presented it at the Global Anti-Scam Summit Asia 2026, which GASA organised with the Royal Thai Police, the Bank of Thailand and the Ministry of Digital Economy and Society. The survey found that 71% of adults in the region had come across a scam, and that 62% had engaged with a scammer even though 66% felt confident they could spot one. Of those who engaged, 26% lost money, and 51% of the people who lost money had been scammed more than once. title: Thailand weather today, 15 November: heavy rain in 10 provinces
desc: Thailand weather today, 15 November: heavy rain in 10 provinces Legacy The Thai Meteorological Department forecasts heavy rain in 10 provinces today, with the South bearing the brunt of the wet weather. Chumphon, Surat Thani, Nakhon Si Thammarat, Phatthalung, Songkhla, Pattani, Yala, Narathiwat, Krabi and Phang Nga all face scattered thundershowers and isolated heavy rain. Bangkok stays cloudy with a slight rise in temperature and isolated rain, with lows of 24-26°C and highs of 32-34°C. Residents in the South should watch for flash floods and overflows near foothills and waterways. Heavy to very heavy rain may return to the South between 18 and 22 November. A weakening high-pressure system over the upper country is allowing easterly and southeasterly winds to spread across the region. A moderate northeast monsoon is meanwhile affecting the Gulf and the South, driving the wet conditions there. Bangkok The capital stays cloudy with a slight rise in temperature and isolated rain expected through the day. Lows of 24-26°C and highs of 32-34°C are forecast. summary_cn: 中国学生在泰国遭勒索，犯罪分子威胁砍掉其手臂并索要1000万泰铢赎金。泰国警察总长下令警方快速出击，在30分钟内成功追踪并逮捕嫌犯。该案件反映出泰国跨境诈骗和勒索犯罪日益猖獗，外国学生成为主要目标。

summary_cn: 反对党领导人率队视察Rama Khamhaeng地区，了解洪灾受害者困境。对该政府在赔偿款发放上的缓慢进展表示失望，正整理证据代表灾民，计划于11月底向泰国行政法院提交诉讼。此举反映出政府在洪灾后续赔偿工作中的不力。

title_cn: 曼谷水灾救济登记统计：逾70万户已完成转账

title: Thai Immigration defends screening after Chinese complaints
desc: The Thai Immigration Bureau has defended its screening procedures after Chinese travellers denied entry reportedly complained of poor treatment at Suvarnabhumi airport, while alleging that a broker had demanded about 90,000 baht to help them enter Thailand.
title_cn: 泰移民局为审查程序申辞 回应中国游客投诉
summary_cn: 被拒绝入境的中国游客在素万那普机场（Suvarnabhumi Airport）遭遇不当对待，并称有掮客要求9万泰铢协助其入境。泰国移民局随后为其审查程序进行申辞，表示程序合规。此事反映出入境管理中存在的问题及非法中介活动，影响赴泰游客的入境体验。
desc_original: The Thai Immigration Bureau has defended its screening procedures after Chinese travellers denied entry reportedly complained of poor treatment at Suvarnabhumi airport, while alleging that a broker had demanded about 90,000 baht to help them enter Thailand.

title: Mae Hong Son trekking site closed after fatal fall
desc: Namtok Mae Surin National Park has ordered the indefinite closure of Doi Wawajo in Mae Hong Son province following an accident in which a 30-year-old tourist fell to her death from a cliff late on Friday night.
title_cn: 湄宏顺府徒步景点因致命坠崖事故关闭
summary_cn: 美赛瀑布国家公园（Namtok Mae Surin National Park）因周五夜间一名30岁女性游客从悬崖坠落身亡，已无限期关闭湄宏顺府（Mae Hong Son Province）瓦瓦焦山（Doi Wawajo）地区。这提醒赴泰旅客在进行户外活动时需格外谨慎，并关注景区安全措施。
desc_original: Namtok Mae Surin National Park has ordered the indefinite closure of Doi Wawajo in Mae Hong Son province following an accident in which a 30-year-old tourist fell to her death from a cliff late on Friday night.

title: Bangkok smog season under way
desc: Smog in Bangkok is expected to worsen through Monday due to persistently poor air dispersion, with five districts reporting unsafe levels of fine-dust pollution on Saturday.

desc_original: Smog in Bangkok is expected to worsen through Monday due to persistently poor air dispersion, with five districts reporting unsafe levels of fine-dust pollution on Saturday.

title: Violations found at 92% of raided waste plants
desc: Surprise inspections at waste sorting and recycling plants in Samut Sakhon have found that 92% of them had violated the Factory Act, according to Industry Minister Varawut Silpa-archa.

desc_original: Surprise inspections at waste sorting and recycling plants in Samut Sakhon have found that 92% of them had violated the Factory Act, according to Industry Minister Varawut Silpa-archa.

title: 中国总理：泰国仍是中国游客的热门目的地
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月14日，泰国旅游与体育部部长素拉萨透露，中国国务院总理李强对泰国进行正式访问期间，双方会晤的氛围十分融洽，李强总理还在欢迎仪式上特意转身走回来，通过翻译对他说，泰国依然是中国人向往的热门旅游目的地。 在后续的双方会谈中，阿努廷将旅游合作列为首要议题，向中方郑重强调，保障游客安全是泰国的重中之重，泰国在打击电信诈骗、诱骗及人口贩运方面一直非常坚定，泰国政府希望与中国官方持续保持密切合作和信息共享。 关于推动中国游客市场的未来方向，素拉萨表示，他已经和中国驻泰国大使会面交谈过，双方一致同意成立联合工作组以加强信息交流。当前两国游客往来极为紧密，泰国人出境游的第一大目的地是中国，而入境泰国的外国游客中，中国游客也同样位居第一。 至于此前中国驻泰大使馆发布赴泰旅游安全提醒一事，中国驻泰大使已作出解释，该提醒并非为了禁止中国公民赴泰旅游，只是常规性安全提醒，以前也发布过3至4次，但这次被部分媒体进一步放大报道了。泰国认为，发布此类提醒是妥当且有益的，这有助于警醒那些并非真正来泰国观光旅游的人员，例如某些怀有其他目的、暗中前来经商，或将泰国作为中转站前往第三国的人员；如果是按正常行程来泰国度假，之后按期返回的游客，完全可以放心，泰国绝对是安全的。 素拉萨指出，李强总理此次访泰，加上泰国领导人在政策级会议上释放出的明确信号，都充分展示出了两国之间的互相信任、深厚情谊和良好合作，势必将大力促使中国游客对泰国旅游信心的全面回升。 （编译：KA；来源：thairath） The post 中国总理：泰国仍是中国游客的热门目的地 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 五大区域准备就绪，曼谷水灯节即将盛大举办
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月13日，泰国曼谷市长查察在曼谷2026年水灯节新闻发布会上表示，今年水灯节的主题为“传承泰国传统，延续Rattanakosin河脉”，相关活动将于11月23至25日在马哈坎堡一带举办，而三座寺庙的活动则从11月17日开始。当天的新闻发布会现场除了多项表演外，还有用天然材料制作水灯的示范，强调了今年放水灯的重点：安全环保，“三无污染”。 查察介绍说，“三无”一是无面包水灯，因为沉入水底并分解的面包屑可能导致水质变差；二是无非天然材料，提倡使用可降解的天然材料制作水灯；三是无空气污染，帮助减少产生污染的能源使用。同时还有“两安全”，包括防范鞭炮、烟花和天灯带来的危险，以及确保浮桥和码头的安全稳固。 曼谷希望借这次水灯节活动，将马哈坎堡打造成曼谷新地标，因为这里是具有重要历史意义的区域，连接着多条水道，包括Khlong Ong Ang运河、Khlong Bang Lamphu运河、Khlong Maha Nak运河和Khlong Saen Saep运河，附近还有不少知名寺庙，包括金山寺、Wat Ratchanatdaram Worawihan寺和Wat Thepthidaram Worawihan寺。 为此，曼谷已为全市50个地方办事处设定三项主要任务： 任务一：传承泰国传统，延续Rattanakosin河脉 通过连接“三寺一堡”的活动，把民众与历史场所联系起来，借助传统与信仰，恢复Phra Nakhon的魅力，刺激社区经济，推动负责任的文化旅游。曼谷诚邀民众和游客来以下5个地点感受历史街区的魅力： 1. Phra Nakhon区和Pom Prap Sattru Phai区的马哈坎堡（连接“三寺一堡”），活动时间为11月17至29日。可沿路朝拜圣地并游览“三寺一堡”，欣赏泰国艺术文化表演、Noppamas竞选、古市场、河畔生活方式展览、社区商店，以及水中巨型水灯。 2. Bang Phlat区的拉玛八世桥，活动时间为11月16至25日。可欣赏学生和社区的艺术文化表演、参与水灯评选，以及挑选湄南河畔各类商品。 3. Phra Nakhon区的Phra Sumen Fort（Santichaiprakarn公园），活动时间为11月23至25日。可欣赏泰国艺术文化表演、文化遗产智慧展示、社区产品摊位和参加乘船活动。 4. 乍都乍区的Klong Premprakot运河（Wat Samien Naree寺和Wat Thep Sunthorn寺），活动时间为11月24日。可观赏传统长船竞速、船装饰评选、巡游船队、Noppamas竞选、水灯制作评选与示范、民间表演，以及挑选乍都乍特色商品。 5. 廊曼区的Khlong Premprakot运河，活动时间为11月23至25日。可欣赏泰国艺术文化表演、文化遗产智慧展示、Noppamas竞选和社区产品商店。
title_cn: 曼谷五大区域准备就绪，2026年水灯节即将举办
summary_cn: 曼谷2026年水灯节将于11月17至29日在五个地区举办，主题为「传承泰国传统，延续拉达那哥辛河脉」。主会场在玛哈坎堡（Maha Karn Fort）周边，连接金山寺、Wat Ratchanatdaram Worawihan寺等三座寺庙。市政府强调环保理念，推行「三无」（无面包水灯、无非天然材料、无空气污染）和「两安全」（防爆竹烟火、确保浮桥安全）。其他活动地点包括拉玛八世桥（Rama VIII Bridge）、乍都乍区运河等，涵盖文化表演、传统长船竞速、水灯评选等。

title: 泰国抓获一名涉35亿网赌洗钱案的中国籍通缉犯
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月14日，泰国移民局第三分局局长颂波警少将透露，调查人员于昨天抓捕了一名37岁的中国籍男子唐某（化名），其因涉嫌非法经营，被中国福建省龙岩市公安局通缉。据悉，唐某是一专门为境外网络赌博平台提供支付结算和资金清算服务的犯罪团伙成员，主要负责与赌博平台对接联络，该团伙的涉案资金流水高达7亿多元人民币，折合约35亿泰铢。 案发后，唐某于今年10月初以游客身份入境泰国，目前签证尚未到期。但经中国官方确认，唐某与通缉令缉拿对象的信息一致，移民局第三分局决定按照1979版《移民法》第12条第7款的规定，吊销其在泰居留许可。调查小组随后展开实地排查，追踪到嫌疑人正居住在北榄府Bang Sao Thong县的一家酒店内，于是在周边布控蹲守。 11月13日中午12点左右，一辆汽车停在酒店门前的停车场，一名体貌特征与唐某高度吻合的男子从车上走下。调查人员立即上前表明身份，并通过翻译告知他，其在泰居留许可已被吊销。唐某当场承认，他是通缉令及居留许可吊销通知书所指向的嫌疑人，调查人员遂依法对其实施控制，并移交至移民局第三分局进一步处理。 颂波警少将表示，国家警察总署署长萨兰警上将与移民局局长诺帕辛警中将已下令督促下属各单位加紧追捕藏匿在泰国境内的外籍通缉犯，尤其是涉及网络赌博、电信诈骗及跨国犯罪团伙的嫌疑人。泰国移民局将与国内外执法部门保持密切合作，绝不让泰国成为跨国犯罪分子的藏身之地。 （编译：KA；来源：matichon） The post 泰国抓获一名涉35亿网赌洗钱案的中国籍通缉犯 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Health Ministry warns of rising PM2.5 in Bangkok and central Thailand
desc: Health Ministry warns of rising PM2.5 in Bangkok and central Thailand Legacy The Public Health Ministry warned yesterday, November 13, that PM2.5 dust levels in Bangkok, its surrounding provinces and central Thailand are likely to rise from this month , because cool-season weather traps pollution near the ground. The ministry has told health offices and hospitals to prepare for the dust season, which can last until May. Public Health Minister Pattana Promphat said low air pressure and poor air circulation, together with emissions from pollution sources, could let fine dust build up over the capital region. He ordered health agencies to monitor the situation and draw up response plans, with priority given to high-risk areas and vulnerable groups. title_cn: 泰国公卫部预警曼谷及中部地区PM2.5污染上升
summary_cn: 泰国公卫部警告，曼谷、周边省份及中部地区11月起PM2.5污染水平可能上升，原因是冷季气压低、空气流通差，污染源排放物易积聚。公卫部已命令各地卫生机构做好应对准备，污染季节可能持续至5月。当局要求优先关注高风险地区及易感人群（儿童、老人、孕妇等），建议市民通过Air4Thai、AirBKK、Life Dee等应用查看PM2.5指数，污染严重时避免户外活动。

title: Bangkok fuel protesters plan 11-kilometre march to Energy Ministry on Monday
desc: Bangkok fuel protesters plan 11-kilometre march to Energy Ministry on Monday Legacy The Bangkok fuel protest camped near Government House plans to march about 11 kilometres to the Ministry of Energy on Monday, November 16, setting off at 9am, its leader said. The decision follows a meeting with Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul yesterday, November 13, at which the government made no commitment to the demand for a 10-baht fuel price cut. Protest leader Mano Khrueakaew, a subdistrict headman from Krabi known as Kamnan Mano, said the march would start from Chamai Maruchet Bridge, where the group has camped since November 8, with vehicles carrying back anyone unable to finish. The route has not been decided, and he asked police to look after the marchers. Mano said the group chose Monday because nobody would be at the ministry at the weekend, and 9am in the hope traffic would have eased, though the start could move later. The ministry is at the Energy Complex on Vibhavadi Rangsit Road in Chatuchak district. He called Monday the first step in escalating the protest, with a second march of the same distance on November 20, destination not named. Mano told Amarin TV the group would carry

title: 能源+投资，泰国东盟与APEC峰会议题抢先看
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月14日，泰国总理兼内政部部长阿努廷披露了泰国准备在东盟峰会和亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议（APEC）上提出的核心议题，重点聚焦生物能源政策、扩大屋顶光伏发电系统的安装规模和吸引外国投资。阿努廷表示，政府正全力降低民众能源成本，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖，包括利用激励政策引导民众使用B20和E20等生物燃料。 近期B20生物柴油与普通柴油的价差约为每升10泰铢，使得日均消费量从600万升攀升至1000万-1100万升；E20乙醇汽油的日均消费量也从400万升增长至600万-700万升。激励政策不仅有助于减少资金外流，还能为棕榈、甘蔗和木薯等泰国本土能源作物创造消化市场，同时缓解农业废弃物焚烧问题。政府正在考虑调整加油站油枪比例，通过减少91号乙醇汽油油枪数量、增加E20油枪数量来满足不断增长的市场需求。 关于屋顶光伏项目，目前已受到不少外国投资者的关注，政府计划为每户提供5万泰铢的安装资金补贴，允许家庭发电自用，并将多余电量出售给国家电网，从而将居民屋顶转化为国家能源生产基地，并在长期内减少化石燃料发电比重。 在东盟峰会的区域合作框架下，泰国将积极推动能源转型议题，深化在打击技术犯罪、灰色产业、洗钱和毒品方面的合作。另外，阿努廷还提出根据各国优势组建“小多边”（Mini-lateral）合作机制的构想，例如与老挝开展水电能源合作、与越南开展物流与出口合作，以及整合泰国、马来西亚和新加坡三国的发展潜力，吸引投资者将泰国作为生产基地，进而辐射超过7亿人口的东盟市场及区域外市场。 APEC会议则是与大型经济体开展磋商的重要契机，尤其是推进泰美贸易的谈判进展，泰国政府高度重视推动《对等关税协定》（ART）达成最终结果。阿努廷强调，有时候必须退2步以前进7步，但绝不能退3步换前进1步，谈判要让对手看到共同利益，也必须让泰国获得实际利益。 阿努廷补充说，目前全球级投资者都对在泰国扩大业务布局表现出浓厚的兴趣，特别是投资额达数十亿美元的大型项目。让投资者充满信心的关键在于泰国具备稳定的电力系统、完善的基础设施、便捷的交通网络以及优越的战略地理位置，所以，这次国际盛会将是泰国充分利用优势，吸引海外资金，并切实提升国家经济安全的重要机遇。 （编译：KA；来源：thestandard） The post 能源+投资，泰国东盟与APEC峰会议题抢先看 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国总理披露东盟与APEC峰会核心议题：聚焦能源转型与外资吸引
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷公布了国家在即将举行的东盟峰会和APEC会议上的重点议题。政府将推动生物燃料政策（B20和E20），计划为屋顶光伏项目提供5万泰铢补贴，并推出「小多边」合作机制，包括与老挝的水电能源合作、与越南的物流合作，以吸引全球投资者在泰国建立生产基地。同时推进泰美贸易谈判，强调需通过协商实现互利共赢。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月14日，泰国总理兼内政部部长阿努廷披露了泰国准备在东盟峰会和亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议（APEC）上提出的核心议题，重点聚焦生物能源政策、扩大屋顶光伏发电系统的安装规模和吸引外国投资。阿努廷表示，政府正全力降低民众能源成本，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖，包括利用激励政策引导民众使用B20和E20等生物燃料。 近期B20生物柴油与普通柴油的价差约为每升10泰铢，使得日均消费量从600万升攀升至1000万-1100万升；E20乙醇汽油的日均消费量也从400万升增长至600万-700万升。激励政策不仅有助于减少资金外流，还能为棕榈、甘蔗和木薯等泰国本土能源作物创造消化市场，同时缓解农业废弃物焚烧问题。政府正在考虑调整加油站油枪比例，通过减少91号乙醇汽油油枪数量、增加E20油枪数量来满足不断增长的市场需求。 关于屋顶光伏项目，目前已受到不少外国投资者的关注，政府计划为每户提供5万泰铢的安装资金补贴，允许家庭发电自用，并将多余电量出售给国家电网，从而将居民屋顶转化为国家能源生产基地，并在长期内减少化石燃料发电比重。 在东盟峰会的区域合作框架下，泰国将积极推动能源转型议题，深化在打击技术犯罪、灰色产业、洗钱和毒品方面的合作。另外，阿努廷还提出根据各国优势组建“小多边”（Mini-lateral）合作机制的构想，例如与老挝开展水电能源合作、与越南开展物流与出口合作，以及整合泰国、马来西亚和新加坡三国的发展潜力，吸引投资者将泰国作为生产基地，进而辐射超过7亿人口的东盟市场及区域外市场。 APEC会议则是与大型经济体开展磋商的重要契机，尤其是推进泰美贸易的谈判进展，泰国政府高度重视推动《对等关税协定》（ART）达成最终结果。阿努廷强调，有时候必须退2步以前进7步，但绝不能退3步换前进1步，谈判要让对手看到共同利益，也必须让泰国获得实际利益。 阿努廷补充说，目前全球级投资者都对在泰国扩大业务布局表现出浓厚的兴趣，特别是投资额达数十亿美元的大型项目。让投资者充满信心的关键在于泰国具备稳定的电力系统、完善的基础设施、便捷的交通网络以及优越的战略地理位置，所以，这次国际盛会将是泰国充分利用优势，吸引海外资金，并切实提升国家经济安全的重要机遇。 （编译：KA；来源：thestandard） The post 能源+投资，泰国东盟与APEC峰会议题抢先看 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Heavy metals above safe limits found in some Kok and Mekong river fish
desc: Heavy metals above safe limits found in some Kok and Mekong river fish Legacy Tests by the Department of Fisheries found heavy metals above safety standards in some fish and other aquatic animals sampled from the Kok and Mekong rivers in northern Thailand, Director-General Pinsak Surasawadee said yesterday, November 13. The department will meet the Pollution Control Department and the Department of Marine and Coastal Resources on November 23 to agree on a joint response. Pinsak said the results apply only to the samples, sites and sampling periods tested and cannot be taken as a verdict on the safety of all fish and shellfish. The deputy agriculture minister, who oversees the department, ordered closer monitoring of natural waterways because of concern for consumers, fish stocks and the incomes of fishers and fish farmers. The same round of monitoring found all 19 samples from the Prachin Buri and Bang Pakong rivers within standards, although dissolved oxygen was low at some points. Some areas of the inner Gulf of Thailand recorded unusual deaths of aquatic animals, and early tests there found low dissolved oxygen, which the department described as one possible factor. title_cn: 克河与湄公河部分鱼类检出重金属超标
summary_cn: 泰国渔业部发现克河（Kok River）和湄公河部分区域的鱼类和水产动物重金属含量超安全标准。副农业部长已下令加强对天然水体的持续监测以保护消费者。与此同时，暹罗湾内湾部分区域出现异常的水产动物大规模死亡，初步检测显示溶解氧过低可能是因素之一。渔业部将与污染控制部门和海洋沿海资源部于11月23日举行联合会议应对此事。

title: 泰国那空沙旺府的红莲开了，景色极美！
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月13日，泰国那空沙旺府Bueng Boraphet的红莲陆续绽放，粉红鲜艳点染整片水面，与翠绿山峦背景形成鲜明对比，让人仿佛置身于一幅动人的自然画卷之中。红莲的开始盛放意味着Bueng Boraphet正在进入最美的时节，预计到十二月初，占地超过两千莱的红莲会全面盛开。喜欢感受自然魅力的游客和摄影爱好者可以前来观赏“红莲花海”，以及迁徙到Bueng Boraphet的候鸟。 Bueng Boraphet是泰国最大的淡水湖，覆盖那空沙旺府的三个县：Muang县、Chum Saeng县和Tha Tako县。除了红莲，Bueng Boraphet还有其它莲花，如睡莲等，大量的水鸟、留鸟和候鸟也在此栖息觅食，不少淡水鱼同样聚集在这里。社区还从湖里捕捞鱼类，加工成咸鱼和鲜鱼出售。 第12保护区负责人查雅蓬表示，“Bueng Boraphet红莲花海”将于11月15日正式开放，诚邀各地的游客前来观赏，当地的村民和社区成员热情欢迎各位游客，邀请大家一起乘船观鸟、品尝鱼类。观赏红莲的最佳时间是早上6点至11点，游客可从Bueng Boraphet水鸟公园码头、Tha Tako县Wang Mahakorn镇Ban Rang Bua村的红莲田码头登船。 （编译：KA；来源：thairath、Bueng Boraphet） The post 泰国那空沙旺府的红莲开了，景色极美！ appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 那空沙旺府Bueng Boraphet湖红莲花海正式开放
summary_cn: 泰国最大淡水湖Bueng Boraphet（那空沙旺府）的红莲于11月15日正式开放。粉红鲜艳的红莲与翠绿山水形成鲜明对比，预计12月初占地逾2000莱的红莲花海将全面盛开。最佳观赏时间为早上6至11点，游客可乘船观赏红莲、候鸟，并品尝当地鱼类特产。湖周边还有睡莲、水鸟栖息以及淡水鱼捕捞产业。

title: Pattaya-area hospital admits drilling near sick teen should not have happened
desc: Pattaya-area hospital admits drilling near sick teen should not have happened Legacy A hospital director in Bang Lamung district, Chon Buri , which includes Pattaya , has admitted that workers should not have been drilling in a ward while a seriously ill 17 year old girl was a patient there. The girl died in a Bangkok hospital on November 11, and her family wants the hospital to explain how it keeps patients safe. The director spoke to Khaosod reporters yesterday, November 13, and showed them the 11-bed semi-critical care room on the third floor of Building 5. Work of this kind should not take place while patients are there, or should only go ahead once their beds are moved away, the director said, adding that the workers came from an outside contractor and finished the job quickly. According to the girl’s family, four to five workers drilled and renovated the room in mid-October, and staff gave her only a cloth over her face to keep off dust. Her mother told Siam Rath that the drilling went on from morning until almost evening and that the workers wore no masks or gloves, an account that differs from the director’s description of a short job. Photo courtesy of Siamrath
title_cn: 芭提雅医院承认不应在患者病房进行钻孔作业
summary_cn: 芭提雅地区Bang Lamung区一家医院承认在重症17岁女孩患者病房内进行钻孔和翻新作业不当。该患者于11月11日在曼谷医院去世，家属对医院的患者安全措施提出质疑。医院主任承认此类工作不应在患者在床时进行，但10月中旬的施工中，几名外包工人在患者面部仅用布遮挡的情况下进行全天作业。患者母亲指称工人未佩戴口罩和手套，而医院主任描述该工作迅速完成。

title: 曼谷9月楼市活跃，新开盘总值增长近5倍
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月13日，泰国房地产事务代理有限公司（AREA）主席索蓬透露，曼谷及周边地区的房地产市场在9月明显回暖，共有21个新项目开盘，合计4834套，较8月增长163.1%；项目总价值380.97亿铢，增长491.7%。市场占比最高的是“公寓”，占新开盘套数的72.3%，占项目总价值的49.4%；其次是独栋别墅，套数占比16.9%，但因多为中高价位至豪华级住宅，其价值占比高达44.2%。 按售价分析，平均每套售价从8月的350.5万铢升至9月的788.1万铢，涨幅124.9%，说明本月进入市场的中高价位项目有所增多，尤其是300万至500万铢、500万至1000万铢区间，合计2339套，占新开盘套数的48.4%。 新开盘项目的平均销售率为18.9%，高于上月的16.7%。其中，300万至500万铢的公寓售出241套（总数为746套），销售率32%；200万至300万铢的公寓售出182套（总数为725套），销售率25%。不过，仍需把“开盘价增加”和“实际需求增加”区分开来，不能直接等同。 当前的市场依然主要由大型开发商推动，五家上市公司及其关联公司在套数上占比达96%，在项目价值上占比97%。新开盘地段大多位于城市延伸区（14个项目）和外围地区（6个项目），曼谷内城仅有1个项目。从房地产角度看，大型开发商在9月更加积极发力，但市场复苏仍需结合购买力和实际销售能力来看。 （编译：KA；来源：matichon） The post 曼谷9月楼市活跃，新开盘总值增长近5倍 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰中签署并交换8份合作文件，共创新经济机遇
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月13日，泰国总理兼内政部部长阿努廷与正对泰国进行正式访问的中国国务院总理李强，在总理府大楼共同见证泰中双方签署并交换8份合作文件，反映出两国致力于全面提升战略合作伙伴关系、推动合作取得具体成果的决心。这8份合作文件的要点如下： 1. 《关于在全球安全倡议框架下加强合作的谅解备忘录》：在相互尊重、相互信任的基础上，按照国际原则并兼顾共同利益，加强战略安全合作。该谅解备忘录有助于提升泰国在区域和多边层面，充分发挥维护和平、稳定与安全的作用。 2. 泰国外交部与中国驻泰国大使馆之间的交流函：取消对中国驻泰国总领事馆及泰国驻中国总领事馆人员数量的限制，以提升领事工作灵活性，提高为两国公民服务的效率，并适应泰中贸易、投资、旅游和人员往来的增长。 3. 《关于计量合作的谅解备忘录》：旨在提升计量标准与精度方面的合作，增强企业和消费者信心，支持提升泰国商品标准，使其在国际市场上更具竞争力。 4. 《关于泰国向中国出口新鲜农产品的植物检疫要求议定书》：有助于增加泰国农民和企业收入，降低国内产品过剩和价格下跌风险，同时提升种植和包装工厂标准，使其符合进口国的要求。 5. 《关于泰国向中国出口鲜榴莲的植物检疫要求议定书》：提高泰国鲜榴莲的标准与安全性，使其符合中国的进口要求，提高检验效率，降低进口暂停风险，增强中国对泰国榴莲质量的信心。 6. 《“一带一路”倡议下国家进出口食品安全合作机制框架文件》：该框架文件有助于提升泰国农产品和食品标准，增强贸易伙伴信心，减少标准障碍，为未来扩大泰国农产品和食品出口市场创造更多机会。 7. 《关于职业教育合作的谅解备忘录》：为泰国青年提供接触先进技术的机会，使他们获得实际操作经验，提高技能和就业机会，适应未来产业的发展。 8. 《关于汽车产业合作的谅解备忘录》：增加投资和技术转让机会，推动泰国零部件生产商和企业更多参与全球汽车供应链，同时维护生产基地并提升泰国汽车产业的竞争力。 除此之外，泰中双方还计划推进环境领域的合作，后续将就细节进行商讨，并准备签署《关于可持续水管理的谅解备忘录》，促进水管理方面的知识、技术与学术交流，特别是在对民众生活和生计具有重要意义的流域地区。 本次签署并交换8份的合作文件表明，泰中关系正朝着务实成果迈进，有利于双方增加贸易和投资机会，为农民、企业和工人创造就业和收入，提升国家竞争力，并为两国人民共同、可持续的互利奠定长期合作基础。 （编译：KA；来源：fm91bkk） The post 泰中签署并交换8份合作文件，共创新经济机遇 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

summary_cn: 苹果在泰国推出新一代MacBook Pro，首次在Mac上搭载PROLED XDR双层OLED屏幕，支持触摸操作，用户可直接进行点击、滑动和放大缩小。同时发布iPad mini升级版，配备OLED屏幕和A20 Pro芯片。

title: CRC sees revenue increase by 5% in third quarter
desc: Central Retail Corporation Plc (CRC), a retailer and wholesaler in Thailand and Vietnam, reported total revenue of 61.1 billion baht in the third quarter, up 5% year-on-year, while its core profit from continuing operations surged by 72% to 2.05 billion baht, exceeding 2 billion baht for the third consecutive year.
title_cn: 中央零售公司第三季度营收增长5% 核心利润激增72%
summary_cn: 泰国中央零售公司(CRC)第三季度营收达611亿泰铢，同比增长5%。核心利润激增72%，达20.5亿泰铢，连续第三年突破20亿泰铢大关，反映该公司在泰国和越南市场的零售与批发业务表现强劲。
desc_original: Central Retail Corporation Plc (CRC), a retailer and wholesaler in Thailand and Vietnam, reported total revenue of 61.1 billion baht in the third quarter, up 5% year-on-year, while its core profit from continuing operations surged by 72% to 2.05 billion baht, exceeding 2 billion baht for the third consecutive year.

title: “ยอด” ซีอีโอ LINE MAN Wongnai ยอมรับแพลตฟอร์มถูกคุมเข้ม อาจกระทบแผน IPO ปี 70
desc: LINE MAN Wongnai หวั่น กขค.คุมค่าบริการแพลตฟอร์ม ต้องขออนุญาตขึ้นราคาล่วงหน้า 180 วัน กระทบความเชื่อมั่นนักลงทุน อาจทำให้ต้องเลื่อนแผน IPO จากเดิมคาดเข้าตลาดหุ้นปี 2570
title_cn: LINE MAN Wongnai首席执行官承认平台管制趋严 恐影响2027年IPO计划
summary_cn: LINE MAN Wongnai首席执行官坦言公司平台面临监管部门更严格的管制。该公司需提前180天获得许可才能调整服务价格，这可能打击投资者信心，甚至导致原定于2027年登陆股市的计划延期。
desc_original: LINE MAN Wongnai หวั่น กขค.คุมค่าบริการแพลตฟอร์ม ต้องขออนุญาตขึ้นราคาล่วงหน้า 180 วัน กระทบความเชื่อมั่นนักลงทุน อาจทำให้ต้องเลื่อนแผน IPO จากเดิมคาดเข้าตลาดหุ้นปี 2570

title: Can Social Security reforms save the fund?
desc: The sustainability problem facing the Social Security Fund could become a ticking time bomb for Thai society. The countdown has already begun. If nothing is done, the consequences could be severe. The Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI) estimates that without a major overhaul of the Social Security Fund, its reserves could be depleted within the next 27 years.
title_cn: 社会保障基金改革能否拯救危局？
summary_cn: 泰国社会保障基金面临可持续性危机，泰国开发研究所(TDRI)警示，若不进行根本性改革，该基金储备将在未来27年内枯竭。当前形势紧迫，需立即采取行动以避免对泰国社会造成严重后果。
desc_original: The sustainability problem facing the Social Security Fund could become a ticking time bomb for Thai society. The countdown has already begun. If nothing is done, the consequences could be severe. The Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI) estimates that without a major overhaul of the Social Security Fund, its reserves could be depleted within the next 27 years.

title: Abhisit urges clarity in Shuffle probe
desc: Democrat Party leader Abhisit Vejjajiva has urged the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) to handle the Shuffle.com inquiry transparently, warning that a lack of clarity could undermine public confidence.
title_cn: 阿比昔促 Shuffle 调查透明化
summary_cn: 民主党领导人阿比昔·维集瓦表示，特别调查部门（DSI）在处理 Shuffle.com 查询案时应保持透明，强调缺乏清晰的调查流程和公开说明将严重损害公众对司法部门的信任。他呼吁相关部门提供更详细的案情进展通报。
desc_original: Democrat Party leader Abhisit Vejjajiva has urged the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) to handle the Shuffle.com inquiry transparently, warning that a lack of clarity could undermine public confidence.

title: Microsoft outage spurs cybersecurity review
desc: The government has ordered an urgent review of cybersecurity preparedness across critical sectors following a widespread global disruption to Microsoft's services.
title_cn: 微软服务中断引发网络安全审查
summary_cn: 泰国政府鉴于微软服务全球大规模中断事件，下令对金融、电力、电信、交通运输等关键基础设施部门的网络安全防范能力进行紧急全面审查，确保国家重点部门的数字安全防护体系完善。
desc_original: The government has ordered an urgent review of cybersecurity preparedness across critical sectors following a widespread global disruption to Microsoft's services.

title: Skills shortage threatens Thailand's nuclear goals
desc: Although Thailand aims to introduce small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs) by 2037, experts warn that the biggest challenge is developing the thousands of qualified specialists needed to operate and regulate them safely, a process that could take a decade.
title_cn: 专业人才短缺威胁泰国核能目标
summary_cn: 泰国计划 2037 年前引进小型模块化核反应堆（SMRs）以应对能源需求，但业界人士指出最大挑战在于须培养数千名合格专业人员来安全运营和监管核设施，这个培养过程预计需耗时十年左右。
desc_original: Although Thailand aims to introduce small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs) by 2037, experts warn that the biggest challenge is developing the thousands of qualified specialists needed to operate and regulate them safely, a process that could take a decade.

title: Asean return eyed for FM
desc: Myanmar's foreign minister should be allowed back into Asean meetings, Thailand's top diplomat said on Thursday after visiting the war-torn country.
title_cn: 缅甸外长有望重返东盟会议
summary_cn: 泰国外交部长访问战乱中的缅甸后建议，应允许缅甸外交部长重返东盟各层级会议。此举旨在加强区域外交联系和对话机制，促进东盟在应对缅甸复杂局势上的协调合作。
desc_original: Myanmar's foreign minister should be allowed back into Asean meetings, Thailand's top diplomat said on Thursday after visiting the war-torn country.

title: River pollution talks expedited
desc: Thailand and Myanmar have agreed to bring forward a joint working group meeting on cross-border river pollution to Nov 25-26, as both countries seek urgent measures to tackle worsening contamination in the Kok and Sai rivers, Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said on Friday.
title_cn: 跨界河流污染谈判加速推进
summary_cn: 泰国与缅甸协议将跨界河流污染联合工作组会议提前至 11 月 25-26 日召开，以应对廓河（Kok）和赛河（Sai）等边境河流污染恶化问题。两国外交部门宣布将采取紧急措施共同应对这一跨界环境危机。
desc_original: Thailand and Myanmar have agreed to bring forward a joint working group meeting on cross-border river pollution to Nov 25-26, as both countries seek urgent measures to tackle worsening contamination in the Kok and Sai rivers, Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said on Friday.

title: Central Embassy to develop into super-luxury landmark
desc: Central Group and Central Pattana Plc will jointly invest more than 83 billion baht to transform Central Embassy into a super-luxury mixed-use landmark in central Bangkok.
title_cn: Central Embassy 将打造超豪华地标
summary_cn: Central Group 与 Central Pattana Plc 将联合投资逾 830 亿泰铢，将位于曼谷中心商务区的 Central Embassy 改建为超豪华混合用途地标项目。该项目规模宏大，力求打造成为泰国及东南亚顶级的商业文化综合体。
desc_original: Central Group and Central Pattana Plc will jointly invest more than 83 billion baht to transform Central Embassy into a super-luxury mixed-use landmark in central Bangkok.

title: 'Thai Rath' publisher dies
desc: Khunying Praneetsilpa Vacharaphol, chair of Vacharaphol Co Ltd and publisher of Thai Rath, Thailand's largest-selling daily newspaper, has died aged 94.
title_cn: 「泰国日报」出版人去世
summary_cn: 泰国发行量最大日报「Thai Rath」的出版人及集团董事长昆英·普拉尼西尔帕·瓦查拉帕尔去世，享年 94 岁。作为泰国新闻出版业的重要人物和商业领袖，其离世对泰国媒体产业造成重大影响。
desc_original: Khunying Praneetsilpa Vacharaphol, chair of Vacharaphol Co Ltd and publisher of Thai Rath, Thailand's largest-selling daily newspaper, has died aged 94.

title: Household recycling 'won't fix crisis'
desc: Thailand's waste crisis cannot be solved by household recycling alone, experts warned, urging the government to advance comprehensive circular economy legislation that would spread responsibility for waste management beyond cash-strapped local authorities.
title_cn: 家庭回收「无法解决」垃圾危机
summary_cn: 专家警告，泰国的垃圾危机仅靠家庭回收无法彻底解决。各界呼吁政府推进全面的循环经济立法，完善垃圾分类管理体系，将环卫责任从预算困难的地方当局向生产商和企业扩展。
desc_original: Thailand's waste crisis cannot be solved by household recycling alone, experts warned, urging the government to advance comprehensive circular economy legislation that would spread responsibility for waste management beyond cash-strapped local authorities.

title: Central bank highlights uneven impact of AI boom
desc: The Bank of Thailand (BoT) is closely monitoring the global artificial intelligence (AI) investment boom, amid concerns that its benefits have yet to fully spill over into the Thai economy.
title_cn: 央行指出人工智能投资热潮影响不均
summary_cn: 泰国央行（BoT）密切关注全球人工智能投资热潮的发展，但担忧其经济效益尚未充分惠及泰国经济。泰国面临在 AI 浪潮中被边缘化的风险，需要制定相应政策确保本土企业和劳动力不被落下。
desc_original: The Bank of Thailand (BoT) is closely monitoring the global artificial intelligence (AI) investment boom, amid concerns that its benefits have yet to fully spill over into the Thai economy.

desc: Thai investigators ask Google and Apple to pull illegal loan apps Legacy Thai investigators have asked Google and Apple to remove illegal loan apps from their app stores in Thailand unless the apps belong to one of eight companies licensed by the Bank of Thailand, the agency said yesterday, November 13. The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) sent the list of the eight licensed digital personal loan providers to Google’s representative in Thailand and to Apple South Asia (Thailand) Co., Ltd. It asked both companies to check the loan apps on Google Play and the App Store against that list and to take down any app not run by one of the eight, so that more borrowers are not harmed. According to the DSI, the apps make borrowers allow access to the data on their phones, including saved phone numbers and photos, before they lend any money. Borrowers’ personal details were later posted publicly to embarrass them, while debt collectors made harassing calls to them and to other people whose numbers were on their phones. title: Senator seeks Thai PBS audit answers
desc: Senator Dr Premsak Piayura has called on Thai PBS to explain its response to an audit report detailing irregular spending and ordering the recovery of 85 million baht, more than a month after its issuance.
title_cn: 参议员促泰国公共电视台解释审计回应
summary_cn: 参议员普密萨·皮亚尤拉(Dr Premsak Piayura)呼吁泰国公共电视台(Thai PBS)说明其对审计报告的回应。审计报告揭示不规范支出，要求追回8500万泰铢。报告发布已逾一月，仍未获有效解释。此事涉及公共资金管理，关乎泰国政府财政透明度。
desc_original: Senator Dr Premsak Piayura has called on Thai PBS to explain its response to an audit report detailing irregular spending and ordering the recovery of 85 million baht, more than a month after its issuance.

title: Key economic pacts eyed at 49th summit
desc: Three major Asean economic agreements are set to advance at the 49th Asean Summit in Manila from Nov 15-17, with measures aimed at easing digital trade, reducing regional trade barriers and speeding up Thai agricultural exports to China.
title_cn: 第49届东盟峰会推进关键经济协议
summary_cn: 三项重大东盟经济协议将在11月15-17日于马尼拉召开的第49届东盟峰会上取得进展。这些措施旨在便利数字贸易、降低区域贸易壁垒，加快泰国农产品对华出口。协议涉及东盟一体化建设，对泰国贸易和经济发展具有重要推动作用。
desc_original: Three major Asean economic agreements are set to advance at the 49th Asean Summit in Manila from Nov 15-17, with measures aimed at easing digital trade, reducing regional trade barriers and speeding up Thai agricultural exports to China.

title: Protest leader Mano faces CSD complaint
desc: Political activist Sonthiya Sawasdee filed a complaint yesterday with the Crime Suppression Division (CSD) against protest leader Mano Khrueakaew for allegedly soliciting donations without permission.
title_cn: 抗议领导人玛诺遭刑事申告
summary_cn: 政治活动人士松提亚·萨瓦斯迪(Sonthiya Sawasdee)向警方刑事压制分局(CSD)提出控告，指控抗议领导人玛诺·克鲁卡卫(Mano Khrueakaew)未经许可非法募集捐款。事件反映泰国持续的政治分歧与权力纠纷，涉及法律合规问题。
desc_original: Political activist Sonthiya Sawasdee filed a complaint yesterday with the Crime Suppression Division (CSD) against protest leader Mano Khrueakaew for allegedly soliciting donations without permission.

summary_cn: 村民纷纷参加名象「色多外蒙」(Sidowaipod)的葬礼。这头象曾出演知名电影，是当地村民的精神寄托。葬礼现场洋溢哀伤氛围，象主人更是泪流满面。事件反映动物在泰国人民生活和文化中的特殊情感地位。

title_cn: 4米巨蛇潜入鸡舍捕食后「懒卧」蛋窝
summary_cn: 村民发现一条4米长的大蟒蛇潜入鸡舍捕食鸡只，随后竟懒洋洋地盘踞在鸡蛋窝里。村民报警求助，救援人员最终成功捕获。事件展现泰国乡村与野生动物的日常互动，具有典型的地方特色与趣味性。

desc: เริ่มบานรับลมหนาว ต้อนรับฤดูกาลท่องเที่ยว "ทุ่งบัวแดงบึงบอระเพ็ด" จังหวัดนครสวรรค์ เริ่มทยอยผลิบาน แต้มสีชมพูสดใสทั่วผืนน้ำแล้ว
title_cn: 「邦博拉佩红莲池塘」花开如锦，粉色清新尽染水面
summary_cn: 随着冬季降临，泰国那空沙旺府的著名景区「邦博拉佩红莲池塘」(Bueng Borraphet)迎来最佳观赏季。红莲陆续绽放，粉色清新的花朵铺满水面，构成壮观的自然景象。每年此时这处生态湿地成为国内外游客的热门目的地，是体验泰国秋冬季风景的绝佳选择。

title: FSMART reports B390 million in 9-month net profit
desc: Forth Smart Service Plc (FSMART) has reported 1.89 billion baht in total revenue and 390 million baht in net profit in the first nine months of this year.
title_cn: Forth Smart Service公司前九月净利润达3.9亿泰铢
summary_cn: Forth Smart Service Plc(FSMART)公布2026年前九个月的财务成绩，实现总营收18.9亿泰铢，净利润3.9亿泰铢。这一成绩反映公司业务保持稳定增长，盈利能力持续提升，在竞争激烈的服务行业中展现出强劲的市场竞争力和发展潜力。
desc_original: Forth Smart Service Plc (FSMART) has reported 1.89 billion baht in total revenue and 390 million baht in net profit in the first nine months of this year.

title: Drones at heart of ‘low-altitude economy’
desc: Growing drone use is creating opportunities in transport, healthcare and emergency services, as Thailand prepares to develop its low-altitude economy, according to the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT).
title_cn: 无人机成泰国「低空经济」发展核心驱动力
summary_cn: 据泰国民用航空局数据，无人机应用正在运输、医疗和应急救援等领域创造新机遇。泰国政府积极推动低空经济发展战略，充分利用无人机技术在货物运输、远程医疗和紧急救援方面的优势。这一新兴产业有望成为泰国经济转型升级的重要增长点。
desc_original: Growing drone use is creating opportunities in transport, healthcare and emergency services, as Thailand prepares to develop its low-altitude economy, according to the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT).

title: BoI reports 28% growth in investment in third quarter

desc: British holidaymaker dies in Thailand motorbike crash as family appeals for funds Legacy A 42 year old British man from Merseyside has died in a motorbike crash while on holiday in Thailand, his family said this week. Friends and relatives have started an online fundraiser to pay for his body to be flown home to the UK. Daily Mail reported that Alex Waddington, a building worker originally from Birkenhead who lived in Liverpool, had travelled to Thailand, which his family described as his “happy place”. His family has not said where in Thailand the crash happened or how it happened. Family friend Lyndsey Morton, who set up the appeal, said he died on holiday last week, while his niece, Tilly Mae, said the crash happened earlier this week. title: Chiang Mai plans to become Thailand’s astronomy capital
desc: Chiang Mai plans to become Thailand’s astronomy capital Legacy Chiang Dao district in Chiang Mai is being developed as a stargazing destination under a joint initiative by the National Astronomical Research Institute of Thailand (NARIT) and the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT), which also aims to protect local natural resources and preserve dark skies. The plan was discussed at a meeting on November 10 at the Princess Sirindhorn AstroPark in Mae Rim district, chaired by Chiang Mai Deputy Governor Bunlue Thammatharanurak. Representatives from the Chiang Mai Provincial Administrative Organisation, the provincial tourism and sports office, the TAT’s Chiang Mai office, the Chiang Dao Tourism Operators Association, local authorities and the local dark sky network also attended. Photo via Chiang Mai News Participants discussed ways to develop sustainable tourism, strengthen local communities and establish Chiang Dao as a high-quality tourist destination. One part of the initiative is to promote astronomy tourism through an upcoming event, “Chiang Dao Geminid Hunting, Lights Off, Sky Open”, scheduled to take place from the evening of December 13 until the morning of Decembe

title: Thai finance minister warns of AI investment scams using his face
desc: Thai finance minister warns of AI investment scams using his face Legacy Thailand’s finance minister has revealed that scammers used AI-generated images of his face to promote investment schemes , warning the public not to trust advertisements featuring his likeness. Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said today, November 13 that he had filed a police complaint after discovering the fake advertisements, which used deepfake technology to make it appear as though he was encouraging people to invest. Ekniti said he was startled when he first saw the advertisements because the AI-generated images looked remarkably like him. He stressed that he had never promoted an investment scheme or invited anyone to invest. Ekniti also warned about mobile loan apps claiming to have the Ministry of Finance’s endorsement, stressing that the ministry had never endorsed such apps. He explained that financial apps are subject to oversight by the Bank of Thailand, while licence applications must also be reviewed by the Ministry of Finance.
