title: Phuket waste crisis eases as landfill partially reopens
desc: Phuket waste crisis eases as landfill partially reopens Legacy Phuket ’s main waste disposal centre has partially reopened after an overflowing landfill forced it to stop accepting rubbish on November 8. Officials expect the facility to resume full operations next week . Phuket City Municipality announced the partial reopening on November 12, following a meeting chaired by Phuket Governor Chotnarin Kerdsom to address the island’s growing waste problem . Phuket City Mayor Supachok Laongphet said the landfill had been struggling with accumulated rubbish for years as waste volumes continued to rise following the Covid-19 pandemic. Waste disposal and landfill expansion projects are more than a year behind schedule due to regulatory hurdles, complaints, appeals and lawsuits. Limited machinery and heavy rain have also disrupted work at the site. The landfill stopped accepting rubbish on November 8 after trucks from several local administrations dumped waste that blocked access roads. title: Govt denies ignoring pollution concerns in Prachin Buri, Chachoengsao
desc: Govt denies ignoring pollution concerns in Prachin Buri, Chachoengsao Legacy The government denied ignoring pollution concerns in the Prachin Buri River Basin and surrounding areas, including Chachoengsao , saying it plans to propose designating affected locations as pollution control zones for further investigation and remedial measures. Dead fish floating in the Bang Pakong River in Chachoengsao prompted concern among residents and people who fish in the area. Residents fear the fish deaths could be linked to water contamination from the Prachin Buri River Basin, which is connected to the Bang Pakong River. However, no official investigation has established the cause or confirmed a connection between the two incidents. The pollution concerns in Prachin Buri date back to major flooding at the end of September. Residents noticed an oily film on the surface of floodwater . The material allegedly came from an industrial waste landfill in the province. Photo via Matichon Water test results showed contamination with petroleum hydrocarbons, excessive oil and grease, and several metals. Residents also reported developing itchy rashes and scabs after coming into contact with the water. Ri

title: Foreign booking sites face Thai airfare caps after Chiang Mai fare spike
desc: Foreign booking sites face Thai airfare caps after Chiang Mai fare spike Legacy Thailand’s aviation regulator wants foreign booking sites to register in the country and follow the legal fare caps that already bind airlines. The request follows Chiang Mai flight tickets from Bangkok appearing above 20,000 baht ahead of the Yi Peng festival, which runs from November 23 to 26. Deputy Transport Minister Siripong Angkasakulkiat said yesterday, November 12, that he hopes the rules can be in place by next year. The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) has written to the Commerce Ministry asking for legislation that would require online travel agencies to register in Thailand and would let the government enforce maximum fares on them. Siripong told the CAAT to send its request without delay and suggested that the Commerce Ministry, the Transport Ministry and the Office of the Consumer Protection Board work on the rules together. title: Swedish fraud suspect arrested in Pattaya after 352-day overstay
desc: Swedish fraud suspect arrested in Pattaya after 352-day overstay Legacy A Swedish man wanted in his home country for allegedly posing as a police officer to defraud victims was arrested in Pattaya after immigration police discovered he had overstayed his visa by 352 days . The suspect, identified as Lyon, was detained outside a hotel in central Pattaya at about 4.30pm yesterday, November 12, following a tip-off from the Nordic Police Liaison Office. Swedish officials had issued an arrest warrant for Lyon in connection with a fraud case involving the alleged impersonation of police officers. Photo via IMM Thailand According to immigration police, Lyon allegedly pretended to be a police officer to gain victims’ trust before persuading them to hand over money or valuables. Investigators said he subsequently left Sweden and travelled to Thailand, where he had been staying in Pattaya. After receiving information from the Nordic Police Liaison Office, the Immigration Bureau worked with Chon Buri Immigration Police to locate Lyon. summary_cn: 瑞典通缉诈骗嫌疑人Lyon在芭提雅 Pattaya 被捕。该男子因在瑞典冒充警官进行诈骗被通缉，后逃亡泰国。北欧警务联络办公室向泰方提供线索，泰国移民局与春武里府Chon Buri移民警察联合行动，在该市中心一酒店外将其逮捕。警方调查发现该嫌疑人已非法逗留泰国352天，严重违反签证规定。
desc_original: Swedish fraud suspect arrested in Pattaya after 352-day overstay Legacy A Swedish man wanted in his home country for allegedly posing as a police officer to defraud victims was arrested in Pattaya after immigration police discovered he had overstayed his visa by 352 days . The suspect, identified as Lyon, was detained outside a hotel in central Pattaya at about 4.30pm yesterday, November 12, following a tip-off from the Nordic Police Liaison Office. Swedish officials had issued an arrest warrant for Lyon in connection with a fraud case involving the alleged impersonation of police officers. Photo via IMM Thailand According to immigration police, Lyon allegedly pretended to be a police officer to gain victims’ trust before persuading them to hand over money or valuables. Investigators said he subsequently left Sweden and travelled to Thailand, where he had been staying in Pattaya. After receiving information from the Nordic Police Liaison Office, the Immigration Bureau worked with Chon Buri Immigration Police to locate Lyon. title: Meta launches new ad tools in Thailand
desc: Meta has rolled out homegrown Asia-Pacific solutions in Thailand, including an omnichannel advertising solution and an AI-powered creative video tool, to help businesses measure online and in-store sales while enabling merchants to produce marketing videos within minutes.
title_cn: Meta在泰国推出新广告工具
summary_cn: Meta公司在泰国推出亚太地区自主开发的解决方案，包括全渠道广告解决方案和AI驱动的创意视频工具。该工具可帮助企业测量线上和线下销售数据，商家可在数分钟内制作营销视频。此举旨在助力泰国中小企业数字化转型和在线销售。
desc_original: Meta has rolled out homegrown Asia-Pacific solutions in Thailand, including an omnichannel advertising solution and an AI-powered creative video tool, to help businesses measure online and in-store sales while enabling merchants to produce marketing videos within minutes.

title: EV charging opens doors for landowners
desc: Thailand's shortage of roughly 26,000 electric vehicle charging outlets is creating a new business opportunity for landowners to transform their properties into "EV destinations" catering to motorists seeking charging facilities, according to EV charging solutions provider Sharge Management Co.
title_cn: 电动车充电站：地产业主的新商机
summary_cn: 泰国电动车充电设施严重不足，现已短缺约26,000个充电站。这为地产业主创造了新的商业机会，可将闲置物业改造为「EV目的地」，为需要充电的电动车主提供便利。据充电方案商Sharge Management表示，这为房产所有者开辟了新的收入渠道，并有助于缓解国内电动车基础设施短缺问题。
desc_original: Thailand's shortage of roughly 26,000 electric vehicle charging outlets is creating a new business opportunity for landowners to transform their properties into "EV destinations" catering to motorists seeking charging facilities, according to EV charging solutions provider Sharge Management Co.

title: Foreign investors pull back from Thai stocks for US bonds
desc: Foreign investors' accumulated net buying in Thai equities has fallen to around 10 billion baht from a peak of 60-70 billion baht around mid-year, as higher US bond yields have prompted funds to flow back into US bonds.
title_cn: 外资撤离泰股转投美债
summary_cn: 外资对泰国股票的净购买额大幅下滑，从年中高峰的600-700亿泰铢跌至约100亿泰铢。美国债券收益率上升导致国际资金回流美债市场。这反映了全球资本流向变化，对泰国股市造成压力，影响当地投资环境和上市公司融资前景。
desc_original: Foreign investors' accumulated net buying in Thai equities has fallen to around 10 billion baht from a peak of 60-70 billion baht around mid-year, as higher US bond yields have prompted funds to flow back into US bonds.

title: Electronic waste challenge looms
desc: Thailand is stepping up efforts to tackle a looming wave of waste from end-of-life vehicles, discarded electric vehicle (EV) batteries and ageing solar panels after the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) and the Office of Industrial Economics agreed to jointly push for stronger waste management and recycling measures.
title_cn: 泰国面临电子废弃物处理危机
summary_cn: 泰国工业联合会与工业经济办公室近日达成共识，将联合推进加强废旧车辆、废旧电动汽车电池和老化太阳能面板的处理和回收措施。随着泰国电动汽车和可再生能源产业的发展，报废电池和废弃太阳能面板大量积累，处理和回收成为紧迫课题。两个机构的联手标志着泰国正在加紧完善国家废物管理体系，应对日益严峻的电子废弃物难题。
desc_original: Thailand is stepping up efforts to tackle a looming wave of waste from end-of-life vehicles, discarded electric vehicle (EV) batteries and ageing solar panels after the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) and the Office of Industrial Economics agreed to jointly push for stronger waste management and recycling measures.

title: Hiccups in Udon Thani cloud Korat expo's prospects
desc: Problems during the Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo 2026 have raised questions over whether Thailand can deliver a world-class international horticultural exhibition in Nakhon Ratchasima in 2029.
title_cn: 乌隆他尼园艺博览会受挫威胁2029年考拉城展会前景
summary_cn: 乌隆他尼国际园艺博览会2026年举办期间曝出多项问题，引发外界对泰国能否在2029年于那空叻差西玛（Nakhon Ratchasima，考拉城 Korat）成功举办世界级国际园艺博览会的质疑。这次博览会原本是泰国展示国际承办能力的重要舞台，暴露的筹备和管理漏洞让业界担忧，泰国日后举办大型国际展会的前景蒙上阴影，亟需完善相关制度和流程。
desc_original: Problems during the Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo 2026 have raised questions over whether Thailand can deliver a world-class international horticultural exhibition in Nakhon Ratchasima in 2029.

title: City moves to ease pet registration rules
desc: Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt has ordered revisions to the city's pet control ordinance to remove a major obstacle preventing renters from registering their pets.
title_cn: 曼谷放宽宠物登记规定便利租住户
summary_cn: 曼谷市长察察特·西提普（Chadchart Sittipunt）日前下令修订城市宠物管理条例，重点是移除阻碍租房者为宠物登记的主要法规障碍。此前宠物登记制度对租房户设置了诸多限制，导致许多养宠物的租房者无法完成官方登记。改革后，租房者注册宠物将更加便捷，有利于完善曼谷的宠物管理体系，也为大量租住在曼谷的外籍人士提供了生活便利。
desc_original: Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt has ordered revisions to the city's pet control ordinance to remove a major obstacle preventing renters from registering their pets.

title: PM pushes B20 fuel use to boost security
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has urged local leaders to promote wider use of B20 biodiesel to reduce Thailand's dependence on imported oil, strengthen energy security and increase incomes for domestic palm oil farmers.
title_cn: 泰国总理推动B20生物柴油助力能源独立
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷·察尔维拉库尔（Anutin Charnvirakul）敦促地方领导人扩大B20生物柴油的使用范围。B20是指含有20%生物柴油、80%传统柴油的混合燃料，推广这一燃料的目标是降低泰国对进口石油的依赖、增强国家能源安全。同时，增加生物柴油使用还将创造对国内棕榈油的需求，提升本地棕榈油农民收入。这一政策体现了泰国在能源独立、产业扶持和经济发展方面的综合考量。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has urged local leaders to promote wider use of B20 biodiesel to reduce Thailand's dependence on imported oil, strengthen energy security and increase incomes for domestic palm oil farmers.

desc: ดีอีร่อนหนังสือเตือน 5 กลุ่มอุตสาหกรรมสำคัญเร่งตรวจสอบระบบป้องกันและซ้อมแผนรับมือภัยไซเบอร์ ขณะที่หน่วยงานกำกับการบินเพิ่มมาตรการคุมเข้ม หลังผู้ให้บริการระบบจองตั๋วเครื่องบินระดับโลกถูกโจมตี
title_cn: 泰国启动网络安全联合防御 5大产业应对黑客威胁
summary_cn: 泰国工业部向5个关键产业集团发出警告信函，敦促其立即检查防护系统并制定网络威胁应对预案。与此同时，工业部联手14家大型企业建立信息共享机制，以便及时应对网络攻击威胁。此举是在全球航班订票系统服务商遭黑客攻击后的应急措施，民航管理部门也同步强化了监管措施。这一联合防御举措体现了泰国政府和企业面对日趋严峻的网络安全形势的积极应对。
desc_original: ดีอีร่อนหนังสือเตือน 5 กลุ่มอุตสาหกรรมสำคัญเร่งตรวจสอบระบบป้องกันและซ้อมแผนรับมือภัยไซเบอร์ ขณะที่หน่วยงานกำกับการบินเพิ่มมาตรการคุมเข้ม หลังผู้ให้บริการระบบจองตั๋วเครื่องบินระดับโลกถูกโจมตี

title: CKPower ได้แรงหนุนไซยะบุรี ดันส่วนแบ่งกำไรพุ่งทะลัก 18%
desc: CKPower เผยผลงาน 9 เดือนแรกปี 2569 กำไรจากการดำเนินงานลด 33% หลังโรงไฟฟ้าน้ำงึม 2 รายได้แผ่ว ต้นทุนเชื้อเพลิงพุ่ง แต่ยังได้แรงประคองจากโรงไฟฟ้าไซยะบุรีที่ทำกำไรเพิ่ม 18%
title_cn: CKPower赛亚武里（Saiyaburi）电厂利润分成飙升18%
summary_cn: CKPower前九月整体运营利润下滑33%，受部分水力发电厂收益下降及燃料成本上升影响。但该公司赛亚武里电厂表现亮眼，利润同比增长18%，成为业绩的主要亮点。
desc_original: CKPower เผยผลงาน 9 เดือนแรกปี 2569 กำไรจากการดำเนินงานลด 33% หลังโรงไฟฟ้าน้ำงึม 2 รายได้แผ่ว ต้นทุนเชื้อเพลิงพุ่ง แต่ยังได้แรงประคองจากโรงไฟฟ้าไซยะบุรีที่ทำกำไรเพิ่ม 18%

desc: รัฐบาลผลักดันอุตสาหกรรมป้องกันประเทศเป็นเครื่องยนต์เศรษฐกิจใหม่ ผ่านนโยบาย “Thai First” ส่งเสริมกองทัพและหน่วยงานรัฐใช้สินค้าไทยก่อนนำเข้า เปิดโอกาสผู้ประกอบการขยายตลาดทั้งในและต่างประเทศ
title_cn: 泰国政府力推防卫产业，「Thai First」政策优先采购国产
summary_cn: 泰国政府将国防产业列为新的经济增长引擎，推行「Thai First」政策，鼓励军方和政府机构优先采购泰国制造的防卫产品，为本土军工企业开拓国内外市场。

title: Former protest leader joins call for cuts to fuel prices
desc: Sondhi Limthongkul, a former People's Alliance for Democracy leader, joined the People's Revolutionary Alliance for the Protection of the Land (NPP) protest on Wednesday night, demanding a cut in fuel prices.
title_cn: 前抗争领导人加入游行，呼吁削减油价
summary_cn: 前人民民主联盟（PAD）领导人松迪·林通古尔（Sondhi Limthongkul）周三晚间加入「人民革命联盟保卫国家」（NPP）集会，与抗争者一同呼吁政府下调燃油价格。
desc_original: Sondhi Limthongkul, a former People's Alliance for Democracy leader, joined the People's Revolutionary Alliance for the Protection of the Land (NPP) protest on Wednesday night, demanding a cut in fuel prices.

title: New North line set for 2028 opening
desc: A new railway that will improve links between northern Thailand and Laos and southern China is 74% complete and on track to open in 2028, the Transport Ministry says.
title_cn: 北方铁路线将于2028年开通
summary_cn: 连接泰国北部与老挝和中国南方的北方新铁路线建设进展顺利，目前完成度达74%，按计划将在2028年正式开通。该铁路是提升泰国北部与周边国家运输联系的关键基础设施，将显著改善地区间的货物流通和人员往来，进一步促进泰北与老挝、中国南方的经济贸易发展。
desc_original: A new railway that will improve links between northern Thailand and Laos and southern China is 74% complete and on track to open in 2028, the Transport Ministry says.

title: Army rejects criticism of drone policy
desc: The Royal Thai Army (RTA) has defended accepting donated drones and other equipment, citing urgent needs during last year's border clashes, after lawyer Sittra Biabungkerd sought an explanation for donations from the Thailand Watch Foundation.
title_cn: 泰军为无人机捐赠政策辩护
summary_cn: 泰国陆军(RTA)为接受泰国监察基金会捐赠的无人机及相关设备进行公开辩护，声称这些设备是应对去年边境冲突的急迫需求。律师西特拉·比亚邦克德对此捐赠提出质疑，要求军方提供说明。泰军表示该政策符合国防需求，引发公众关于军事装备来源和透明度的讨论。
desc_original: The Royal Thai Army (RTA) has defended accepting donated drones and other equipment, citing urgent needs during last year's border clashes, after lawyer Sittra Biabungkerd sought an explanation for donations from the Thailand Watch Foundation.

title: Help sought amid  toxic river pollution
desc: The government is seeking cooperation from Myanmar and China while developing alternative water supplies to address toxic pollution in rivers affecting residents of Chiang Rai, government spokesman Ekkapob Pianpises said yesterday.
title_cn: 清莱河流遭毒污 三国合作谋解决
summary_cn: 清莱省(Chiang Rai)面临河流有毒污染危机，严重威胁当地居民饮用水安全。政府发言人埃卡波·皮安皮塞表示，政府正积极寻求与缅甸(Myanmar)和中国的跨境合作，共同解决该污染问题。同时政府部门在加紧开发替代水源方案，以应对这一紧迫的环保与公共卫生危机。
desc_original: The government is seeking cooperation from Myanmar and China while developing alternative water supplies to address toxic pollution in rivers affecting residents of Chiang Rai, government spokesman Ekkapob Pianpises said yesterday.

title: Police probe animal welfare foundation
desc: Police are examining more than 800 financial transactions involving the Watchdog Thailand Foundation, as an investigation into alleged misuse of donations is stepped up.
title_cn: 警方深查动物福利基金会财务
summary_cn: 警方对「看门狗泰国基金会」(Watchdog Thailand Foundation)进行深入调查，已审查超过800笔财务交易，重点查证是否存在捐款挪用行为。该基金会因疑似不当使用捐献款项引起警方关注，调查正在加强，可能涉及相关负责人的刑事责任。
desc_original: Police are examining more than 800 financial transactions involving the Watchdog Thailand Foundation, as an investigation into alleged misuse of donations is stepped up.

title: AI threats see banks bolster cybersecurity measures
desc: Banks have long treated cybersecurity as a critical business risk, but the emergence of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly agentic AI, has increased the scale and speed of potential threats, prompting financial institutions to strengthen their defences and operational resilience, says HSBC.
title_cn: AI威胁升级 泰国银行强化网络防护
summary_cn: 随着人工智能技术特别是代理型AI(agentic AI)的快速发展，网络威胁的规模和速度显著增加，泰国金融机构正在强化网络防御措施和运营韧性。汇丰银行(HSBC)警示，网络安全已成为金融业的关键商业风险，银行需要采取更加主动和完善的防护策略应对日益复杂的AI驱动型网络威胁。
desc_original: Banks have long treated cybersecurity as a critical business risk, but the emergence of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly agentic AI, has increased the scale and speed of potential threats, prompting financial institutions to strengthen their defences and operational resilience, says HSBC.

title: PP warned over aid donations
desc: The Election Commission (EC) has warned the People's Party (PP) that donations collected through personal bank accounts for disaster relief could violate several laws and potentially put the party at risk of dissolution.
title_cn: 人民党因灾难救援捐款被选委会警告
summary_cn: 泰国选举委员会(EC)警告人民党(PP)通过个人银行账户募集灾难救援捐款可能违反多项法律，该党面临被解散的风险。此举涉及捐款合规性和政党融资监管问题。
desc_original: The Election Commission (EC) has warned the People's Party (PP) that donations collected through personal bank accounts for disaster relief could violate several laws and potentially put the party at risk of dissolution.

title: British man throws cocaine from Pattaya condo during police raid
desc: British man throws cocaine from Pattaya condo during police raid Legacy A British man wanted on drug charges in the UK and his Thai girlfriend were arrested in Pattaya yesterday, November 12, after he allegedly threw a bag containing cocaine from a condominium balcony as police approached. Christopher, a 30 year old British national, and his girlfriend Kingkan, a 25 year old Thai national, were detained at a condominium in Pattaya . Police estimated the seized drugs were worth more than 2 million baht. The arrests followed a request from the UK’s National Crime Agency (NCA), which had asked Thai police to locate Christopher in connection with drug trafficking allegations in Britain. Photo via CIB He was wanted in the UK on conspiracy charges involving the supply of Class A drugs, including cocaine and methamphetamine, and the Class B drug ketamine. Investigators from Thailand’s Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) traced Christopher to a condominium where he was staying with Kingkan. title: Pattaya fireworks festival 2026: full schedule for both nights
desc: Pattaya fireworks festival 2026: full schedule for both nights Legacy Pattaya has published the programme for this year’s International Fireworks Festival, with teams from five countries set to perform over two nights on November 27 and 28. Japan, Italy, the Philippines, Malaysia and Finland will each present a display on both nights of the free event, which takes place along Pattaya Beach in Chon Buri. The main stage will be at Central Pattaya Beach. Five displays are scheduled each night, with the first at 7.45pm on both Friday and Saturday, and concerts and live music will fill the gaps between displays. title: Chinese gambling website suspect arrested at Bangkok convenience store
desc: Chinese gambling website suspect arrested at Bangkok convenience store Legacy Thai immigration police arrested a Chinese man wanted in China over an online football gambling operation at a convenience store in Bangkok on November 12, following five days of surveillance at his luxury condominium. Officers from Immigration Division 1 detained the man, identified only as 41 year old Liu, in the Sukhumvit-Ekkamai area. Police said he rarely left his condominium but occasionally visited the convenience store to buy food and other necessities. The arrest followed information from the Chinese Embassy, which was passed to the Immigration Bureau through the Royal Thai Police Foreign Affairs Division. Liu was reportedly wanted in China over an alleged gambling website called Huangguan Internet. During questioning, he told Thai police that the platform had more than 4,000 user accounts, with over 50 billion baht circulating through the operation. title: Thailand weighs deportation for foreigners importing toxic waste
desc: Thailand weighs deportation for foreigners importing toxic waste Legacy Thailand is considering tougher penalties, including deportation , for foreigners caught illegally importing toxic waste , as the government moves to strengthen its crackdown on electronic waste and illegal recycling operations . The government’s electronic waste committee is also preparing stricter controls on metal scrap imports and exports, with plans to submit the proposals to the Cabinet by December. Deputy government spokesperson Lalida Persvivatana announced the measures today, November 12, following a meeting chaired by Deputy Prime Minister and Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun. The committee agreed to focus on three areas: factory inspections and law enforcement, tighter import and export controls, and stronger penalties for environmental offences. Lalida said the government was considering deportation for foreign nationals involved in illegally importing toxic waste, alongside increased civil and criminal penalties. title: Burj Khalifa developer plans US$5 billion Bangkok project, eyes world’s tallest tower
desc: Burj Khalifa developer plans US$5 billion Bangkok project, eyes world’s tallest tower Legacy The developer behind Dubai’s Burj Khalifa revealed plans for a potential US$5 billion (approximately 160–170 billion baht) mixed-use development in Bangkok , including a landmark tower that could become the world’s tallest building . Mohamed Alabbar, founder of UAE-based Emaar Properties and Eagle Hills, is known for his involvement in developing major real estate landmarks, including the Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall. Alabbar previously met with the Thai government under former Prime Minister Srettha Thavisin in 2024 to discuss investment opportunities in the country. title: Yi Peng Festival 2026 in Chiang Mai: Everything you need to know
desc: PHOTO: Yi Peng via iStock PHOTO: Yi Peng via iStock Yi Peng 2026 runs from Monday, 23 November to Wednesday, 25 November in Chiang Mai, with sky lanterns allowed only on the nights of 24 and 25 November, from 7pm to 1am. Loy Krathong falls on the same Tuesday, 24 November, so expect the city’s busiest week of the year. Chiang Mai City Municipality is running the festival under the theme “Light of faith to honour the sky, the waters of the Ping River and the glory of the city”. The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) expects more than 350,000 visitors, and hotels were already 91% booked by mid-November. title: Chiang Mai mayor among 79 suspects in major fake ID crackdown
desc: Chiang Mai mayor among 79 suspects in major fake ID crackdown Legacy Thai officials launched a major crackdown on an alleged identity document fraud network in Chiang Mai today, November 12, with 79 arrest warrants linked to a scheme involving foreign nationals and corrupt local officials . The operation targeted a network in Fang district accused of illegally issuing civil registration documents and identification cards to foreigners who were not entitled to obtain them through the procedures used. Investigators found that government officials and local government executives, including a municipal mayor, were allegedly involved in facilitating the scheme and approving falsified documents. The identification cards involved are known as zero-prefix ID cards, which are issued to certain people without Thai nationality . Investigators believe the network exploited the registration system to obtain these documents illegally for foreign nationals. Photo via Radio Fang The Department of Provincial Administration (DOPA) launched the crackdown, working alongside police, the Public Sector Anti-Corruption Commission (PACC), the Anti-Money Laundering Office (AMLO) and the Department of Specia

title: 清迈水灯节机票一票难求 泰国民航局回应票价异常涨幅
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月12日，泰国民航局（CAAT）就近期有关水灯节期间曼谷至清迈航线机票价格异常上涨的报道作出回应，表示受节日期间出行需求增加及清迈天灯放飞活动影响，部分航班运力和座位供应紧张，部分在线售票平台显示的异常高价并非航空公司直接提供的票价。 泰国民航局表示，经调查发现，11月23日至26日期间，曼谷至清迈航线的旅客出行需求明显高于平时。同时，为配合清迈府天灯放飞活动期间的航空安全措施，航空公司对部分航班时刻进行了调整，导致航班数量及可售座位受到限制。其中，11月23日至24日曼谷飞往清迈的航班，以及11月25日至26日清迈返回曼谷的航班机票供应尤为紧张。 民航局通过航空公司官方网站核查发现，多家航空公司在上述日期的航班机票已售罄。 针对部分在线售票渠道出现机票价格异常偏高的情况，民航局解释称，相关价格主要由机票代理商或在线订票平台显示，并非航空公司直接提供的销售价格。当航班剩余座位较少或接近满座时，平台系统的定价机制可能导致票价出现异常上涨。此外，部分在线订票平台显示的剩余座位信息，可能与航空公司实际售票情况不一致。 对此，泰国民航局建议旅客在购买机票前，直接通过航空公司官方渠道核实票价及座位情况，确保所购机票真实有效，同时确认票价符合泰国法律规定的最高票价限制。 民航局还提醒，计划在水灯节期间前往清迈的旅客，应提前安排出行时间，并密切关注航空公司发布的最新航班信息。由于清迈将在天灯放飞活动期间实施航空安全限制措施，部分航班时刻仍可能根据实际情况调整。 泰国民航局强调，将持续监测相关航线机票价格变化，推动航空票价信息透明，维护市场公平竞争，并保障航空旅客的合法权益。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：ch7hd_news） The post 清迈水灯节机票一票难求 泰国民航局回应票价异常涨幅 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 清迈水灯节航班紧张 泰国民航局解释机票涨价真因
summary_cn: 水灯节期间（11月23-26日）曼谷至清迈航线机票供应紧张，部分在线平台显示异常高价。泰国民航局（CAAT）回应称高价主要源于航班座位有限和平台定价机制，非航空公司官方票价。为配合天灯放飞期间航空安全措施，航空公司调整部分航班时刻导致可售座位减少。民航局建议乘客直接通过航空公司官方渠道查询，确保交易真实有效，并提醒旅客提前安排行程。

title: 免签政策效果显著 泰国赴华游客两年激增逾12倍
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月12日，据泰国开泰研究中心发布的报告，随着中泰互免签证政策实施，中国已超越日本，成为最受泰国游客欢迎的亚洲短途出境旅游目的地。与此同时，受经济增长放缓和旅游成本上升等因素影响，预计2026年泰国居民出境旅游增速将有所放缓。 开泰研究中心预计，2026年泰国居民出境旅游规模将达到1345万人次，同比增长约3%，低于2025年12%的增幅。该统计包含同一游客多次出境或前往多个国家的情况，并非1345万名不同游客。 从出境旅游目的地来看，亚洲仍是泰国游客最主要的出行区域。如果不计入马来西亚和老挝等陆路跨境旅游目的地，中国已成为泰国游客最受欢迎的短途出境旅游目的地，排名超过日本。自2024年3月1日中泰互免签证协定正式生效以来，泰国游客赴华旅游热情持续升温。2025年，赴华泰国游客达到306万人次，较2023年的23.2万人次大幅增长约1220%，预计2026年这一增长趋势仍将延续。除中国内地外，日本、中国香港、中国台湾地区和韩国也是泰国游客青睐的主要旅游目的地。 报告指出，泰国出境旅游市场增速放缓，主要受国内经济增长乏力及旅游成本持续上涨影响。其中，机票价格、出发地及目的地收取的各类旅游税费，以及目的地当地消费支出增加，均推高了整体旅行成本。部分泰国游客减少了出境旅游频率，尤其是中等收入群体及企业奖励旅游群体，对经济形势和旅游费用上涨更加敏感。 除了交通、住宿、餐饮和购物等常规支出外，泰国游客在出境旅游过程中还需承担由出发地及目的地收取的各类税费。这些与国际旅游相关的税费平均约占每人每次旅行总支出的3.5%至9.5%。不同国家和地区的征收方式及标准存在差异，主要分为三类： 第一类是通过机票收取的税费，包括旅客服务费（PSC）及离境税（Departure Tax）。日本和中国香港等旅游目的地设有相关收费项目。泰国此前计划征收的每人1000泰铢出境税，目前已推迟实施。 第二类是需要提前通过电子系统缴纳的费用，包括旅游入境费、电子旅行授权费及环境保护费等。例如，印度尼西亚巴厘岛向游客收取的相关环境保护费用。 第三类是游客抵达目的地后缴纳的税费，例如部分国家和地区由住宿设施代收的城市税或住宿税。日本东京、京都及马来西亚等地均设有相关收费制度。 报告认为，各类税费虽然在单次旅行总支出中的占比相对有限，但随着机票、住宿及目的地消费价格上涨，其累积影响仍可能进一步增加游客的经济负担。 展望未来，开泰研究中心认为，泰国出境旅游市场仍面临多重不确定性。虽然泰国政府推迟征收出境税，有助于避免居民在现阶段承担额外的出境旅游费用，但整体市场仍将受到经济形势、旅行成本及地缘政治局势等因素影响。未来全球经济环境及地缘政治问题可能继续推高旅游相关成本，对泰国居民的出境旅游意愿及旅行频率形成压力。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：ejan） The p
title_cn: 泰国赴华游客激增 互免签证协定效果显著
summary_cn: 随着中泰互免签证协定生效，中国已超越日本成为泰国游客最热门亚洲短途出境目的地。2025年赴华泰国游客达306万人次，较2023年23.2万人次增长约1220%。开泰研究中心预计2026年泰国出境旅游1345万人次，同比增长3%，低于去年12%。增速放缓主要因国内经济增长乏力及旅游成本上升，包括机票、各类税费及目的地消费增加。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月12日，据泰国开泰研究中心发布的报告，随着中泰互免签证政策实施，中国已超越日本，成为最受泰国游客欢迎的亚洲短途出境旅游目的地。与此同时，受经济增长放缓和旅游成本上升等因素影响，预计2026年泰国居民出境旅游增速将有所放缓。 开泰研究中心预计，2026年泰国居民出境旅游规模将达到1345万人次，同比增长约3%，低于2025年12%的增幅。该统计包含同一游客多次出境或前往多个国家的情况，并非1345万名不同游客。 从出境旅游目的地来看，亚洲仍是泰国游客最主要的出行区域。如果不计入马来西亚和老挝等陆路跨境旅游目的地，中国已成为泰国游客最受欢迎的短途出境旅游目的地，排名超过日本。自2024年3月1日中泰互免签证协定正式生效以来，泰国游客赴华旅游热情持续升温。2025年，赴华泰国游客达到306万人次，较2023年的23.2万人次大幅增长约1220%，预计2026年这一增长趋势仍将延续。除中国内地外，日本、中国香港、中国台湾地区和韩国也是泰国游客青睐的主要旅游目的地。 报告指出，泰国出境旅游市场增速放缓，主要受国内经济增长乏力及旅游成本持续上涨影响。其中，机票价格、出发地及目的地收取的各类旅游税费，以及目的地当地消费支出增加，均推高了整体旅行成本。部分泰国游客减少了出境旅游频率，尤其是中等收入群体及企业奖励旅游群体，对经济形势和旅游费用上涨更加敏感。 除了交通、住宿、餐饮和购物等常规支出外，泰国游客在出境旅游过程中还需承担由出发地及目的地收取的各类税费。这些与国际旅游相关的税费平均约占每人每次旅行总支出的3.5%至9.5%。不同国家和地区的征收方式及标准存在差异，主要分为三类： 第一类是通过机票收取的税费，包括旅客服务费（PSC）及离境税（Departure Tax）。日本和中国香港等旅游目的地设有相关收费项目。泰国此前计划征收的每人1000泰铢出境税，目前已推迟实施。 第二类是需要提前通过电子系统缴纳的费用，包括旅游入境费、电子旅行授权费及环境保护费等。例如，印度尼西亚巴厘岛向游客收取的相关环境保护费用。 第三类是游客抵达目的地后缴纳的税费，例如部分国家和地区由住宿设施代收的城市税或住宿税。日本东京、京都及马来西亚等地均设有相关收费制度。 报告认为，各类税费虽然在单次旅行总支出中的占比相对有限，但随着机票、住宿及目的地消费价格上涨，其累积影响仍可能进一步增加游客的经济负担。 展望未来，开泰研究中心认为，泰国出境旅游市场仍面临多重不确定性。虽然泰国政府推迟征收出境税，有助于避免居民在现阶段承担额外的出境旅游费用，但整体市场仍将受到经济形势、旅行成本及地缘政治局势等因素影响。未来全球经济环境及地缘政治问题可能继续推高旅游相关成本，对泰国居民的出境旅游意愿及旅行频率形成压力。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：ejan） The p

title: 涉25亿串标案，泰国移民局抓获一名中国籍通缉犯
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月12日，泰国移民局突袭辉煌区一豪华酒店，依法逮捕了51岁的中国籍男子关某（MR. GUAN）。据悉，关某因涉嫌诈骗及串通投标罪，于2026年7月29日被中国广东省东莞市公安局通缉，但他在案发后潜逃至泰国，并藏匿在曼谷，总涉案金额25亿泰铢。经过确认，关某正是该案的在逃人员，泰国已依法吊销其签证，并计划将其遣返回国接受法律制裁。 根据中国提供的调查信息，广东省东莞市公安局于2026年4月16日对关某涉嫌串通投标罪立案及展开刑事侦查。在详细分析证据后警方查明，关某在2023年3月伙同他人，通过广东某建设工程有限公司谋取不正当利益。涉案人员向评标专家行贿，以此操控评标结果，使该公司顺利中标东莞市某区一项住宅建设项目，总金额高达5亿元人民币，折合约25亿泰铢。 鉴于这一违法行为对招投标制度及其他参与投标的企业造成了极其严重的损害，中国驻泰国大使馆向泰国国家警察总署发函请求协助追查并遣返关某。移民局通过追踪其出入境和行程信息，最终锁定关某的位置。随后，移民局执法人员前往核查，当场宣布依法吊销其在泰居留许可，并将其移交至移民局第三分局暂时拘留，等待后续遣返回中国。 （编译：KA；来源：naewna） The post 涉25亿串标案，泰国移民局抓获一名中国籍通缉犯 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 中泰汽车产业五大领域合作再升级！拟于11月签署备忘录
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月10日，泰国总理府办公室副发言人拉丽达表示，泰国内阁会议批准了泰国工业部与中国工业和信息化部之间的汽车产业合作谅解备忘录草案，旨在深化两国现代汽车产业合作，促进投资、贸易和技术创新，重点推动电动汽车、智能网联汽车及电池产业发展，进一步加强两国汽车产业供应链合作。 拉丽达表示，此次合作旨在提升泰国汽车产业的国际竞争力，推动产业可持续发展。根据备忘录草案，双方将在五个重点领域深化合作： 1.在投资方面，双方将鼓励两国企业扩大相互投资，合作范围涵盖汽车及零部件制造、电动汽车、电池生产与回收等领域，并为两国企业投资项目提供便利。 2.在贸易方面，双方将加强汽车市场动态、贸易政策及生产需求等信息交流，在公平、平等和开放的贸易环境下，为两国汽车及零部件产业创造更多贸易机会。 3.在标准与法规方面，双方将通过研讨会、培训及联合活动等形式，加强汽车技术标准和相关法规的信息交流，推动标准协调及检测结果互认。 4.在产业管理方面，双方将交流汽车产业战略规划、行业监管及产业发展障碍分析等方面的经验，共同探索解决方案，提升汽车产业管理效率。 5.在政策措施方面，双方将加强汽车产业扶持政策的信息和经验交流，推动产业政策适应技术变革及未来汽车产业发展趋势。 根据合作安排，双方还将成立中泰汽车产业合作工作组，负责协调合作事宜、跟踪项目进展并制定年度工作计划。工作组将重点推动双方在产业政策、技术标准、法律法规及科研成果等方面的信息交流，同时促进两国汽车企业、高等院校及科研机构开展合作。 在具体执行机制方面，泰方主要协调机构为工业部工业经济办公室，中方则为工业和信息化部装备工业一司。双方将共同确定合作方向、组织相关会议，并监督合作项目落实，推动合作取得实际成效。 拉丽达进一步表示，该合作备忘录自签署之日起有效期为5年，计划于2026年11月中国国务院总理李强访问泰国期间签署。 泰国内阁已授权工业部长或其指定代表签署备忘录。根据有关安排，合作框架下具体活动的实施及经费分配将由双方根据实际情况逐项协商确定，不对泰国国家财政预算构成约束，备忘录也不产生具有国际法约束力的义务。 拉丽达强调，泰国政府高度重视汽车产业转型升级，希望增强本土汽车产业的长期适应能力和国际竞争力。此次与中国开展汽车产业合作，将成为促进投资、知识共享及技术交流的重要机制，特别是在电动汽车、动力电池和智能汽车等领域，有助于扩大泰国企业参与汽车产业供应链的机会，推动泰国汽车产业实现可持续增长。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：fm91bkk） The post 中泰汽车产业五大领域合作再升级！拟于11月签署备忘录 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 中泰汽车产业五大领域合作再升级！拟于11月签署备忘录
summary_cn: 泰国与中国计划11月签署汽车产业合作备忘录，有效期5年。双方将在投资、贸易、标准、产业管理和政策五个领域深化合作，重点推动电动汽车、智能汽车及电池产业发展。合作旨在提升泰国汽车产业国际竞争力、扩大两国企业投资和产业供应链合作。两国将成立工作组，推进产业政策、技术标准和科研成果的交流与合作，预计总理李强访泰期间正式签署。

title_cn: 可爱成对的「瓦培-古玛」 政府推介乌汶世界花园博览会吉祥物
summary_cn: 政府推介乌汶世界花园博览会的两个明星吉祥物「瓦培」和「古玛」，设计灵感源于红莲花与传统民间文化。观众可在3个特定地点与巨型吉祥物合影打卡。
desc_original: น่ารักแพ็กคู่! รัฐบาลชวนรู้จัก 2 ดาวเด่น “วาปี-กุมภะ” มาสคอตสุดคิวต์มหกรรมพืชสวนโลกอุดรฯ เปิดที่มาจากบัวแดงถึงบ้านเชียง พร้อมปักหมุดเจอมาสคอตยักษ์ 3 จุด

title: More investors look to professionals
desc: Growing market volatility and increasingly complex investment choices are prompting more investors to entrust portfolio management to professionals rather than manage their investments themselves, according to Bualuang Securities (BLS).
title_cn: 市场波动加大 投资者转向专业人士管理投资
summary_cn: 根据 Bualuang Securities 数据，随着市场波动性增加和投资选择日趋复杂，越来越多的投资者倾向于将投资组合管理托付给专业人士，而不是自行管理。
desc_original: Growing market volatility and increasingly complex investment choices are prompting more investors to entrust portfolio management to professionals rather than manage their investments themselves, according to Bualuang Securities (BLS).

title: ราคาน้ำมันวันนี้ 12 พฤศจิกายน 2569 อัปเดตล่าสุด น้ำมัน "เบนซิน-ดีเซล" ลิตรละกี่บาท
desc: อัปเดตราคาน้ำมันวันนี้ 12 พฤศจิกายน 2569 เช็กราคาน้ำมันทุกชนิด กลุ่มเบนซิน, แก๊สโซฮอล์, ดีเซล จากปั๊มน้ำมัน ปตท., บางจาก, พีที, คาลเท็กซ์, ซัสโก้ และเชลล์ ล่าสุดราคาลิตรละกี่บาทแล้ว
title_cn: 11月12日油价最新行情 汽油、柴油等多油种价格更新
summary_cn: 更新11月12日最新油价，涵盖汽油、汽油混合燃料、柴油等多种油品。价格来自 PTT、中华、BP、卡尔特克斯、SUSCO、壳牌等主要油站最新报价。
desc_original: อัปเดตราคาน้ำมันวันนี้ 12 พฤศจิกายน 2569 เช็กราคาน้ำมันทุกชนิด กลุ่มเบนซิน, แก๊สโซฮอล์, ดีเซล จากปั๊มน้ำมัน ปตท., บางจาก, พีที, คาลเท็กซ์, ซัสโก้ และเชลล์ ล่าสุดราคาลิตรละกี่บาทแล้ว

title: Finance Ministry agencies to beef up preparedness
desc: All agencies under the Finance Ministry have been instructed to step up their preparedness against potential cyber-attacks.
title_cn: 财政部所属机构加强网络安全防御准备
summary_cn: 财政部已指示所属所有机构加强对潜在网络攻击的防御准备工作。
desc_original: All agencies under the Finance Ministry have been instructed to step up their preparedness against potential cyber-attacks.

title: ประกอบไทย หัวใจไฟฟ้า NEX รถโดยสารไฟฟ้าผลิตในไทย
desc: NEX รถโดยสารไฟฟ้าผลิตในไทย พร้อมอะไหล่และศูนย์บริการ ดูแลตลอดอายุการใช้งาน เปิดรับลูกค้าและพันธมิตรทั้งภาคการศึกษา ภาครัฐ และธุรกิจขนส่ง รถในสต็อกหลายรุ่นพร้อมส่งมอบภายใน 1 เดือน
title_cn: 泰国制造NEX电动客车开启销售 提供全周期维护服务
summary_cn: NEX是泰国本土生产的电动客车，配备完整的配件供应体系和终身维护网络。目前面向教育机构、政府部门和运输企业正式开放销售，多个车型库存充足，承诺一个月内完成交付。
desc_original: NEX รถโดยสารไฟฟ้าผลิตในไทย พร้อมอะไหล่และศูนย์บริการ ดูแลตลอดอายุการใช้งาน เปิดรับลูกค้าและพันธมิตรทั้งภาคการศึกษา ภาครัฐ และธุรกิจขนส่ง รถในสต็อกหลายรุ่นพร้อมส่งมอบภายใน 1 เดือน

title: เบทาโกร รับอานิสงส์ตลาดส่งออกโตแรง ดันกำไรไตรมาส 3 เพิ่ม 11.5% เร่งผลิตรับออเดอร์ปลายปี
desc: เบทาโกร เผยกำไรไตรมาส 3 โต 11.5% แตะ 1,300 ล้านบาท รายได้ส่งออกพุ่ง 25.5% เร่งเพิ่มกำลังผลิตไก่ปรุงสุก 10% รับออเดอร์ยุโรป-ญี่ปุ่นยาวถึงสิ้นปี
title_cn: Betagro第三季度利润增长11.5% 出口收入创新高
summary_cn: 泰国肉制品龙头企业Betagro第三季度表现抢眼，净利润增长11.5%至13亿泰铢，出口收入增幅达25.5%。企业正加速熟鸡肉产能扩张10%，以应对欧洲与日本市场年底前的大额订单需求。
desc_original: เบทาโกร เผยกำไรไตรมาส 3 โต 11.5% แตะ 1,300 ล้านบาท รายได้ส่งออกพุ่ง 25.5% เร่งเพิ่มกำลังผลิตไก่ปรุงสุก 10% รับออเดอร์ยุโรป-ญี่ปุ่นยาวถึงสิ้นปี

title: Amlo seeks B320m asset seizures
desc: The Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) is seeking to forfeit 320 million baht in assets belonging to a former municipal official and associates following high-profile local government exam fraud.
title_cn: 泰国反洗钱部门申请没收3.2亿泰铢资产
summary_cn: 泰国反洗钱部门(AMLO)正式申请没收涉及前市政官员及其关联人士的3.2亿泰铢资产。此举源于近日曝光的地方政府考试舞弊案，是当局加强反腐和打击非法收入的重要行动。
desc_original: The Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) is seeking to forfeit 320 million baht in assets belonging to a former municipal official and associates following high-profile local government exam fraud.

title: Thailand ranks 43rd in global digital and AI competitiveness
desc: Thailand was ranked 43rd among 70 economies in the 2026 World Digital and AI Competitiveness Ranking (WDAIR), reflecting low scores in three sub-factors: regulatory framework, digital and AI governance, and public leadership.
title_cn: 泰国数字与AI竞争力排名第43 三大领域待加强
summary_cn: 根据2026年全球数字与人工智能竞争力指数(WDAIR)，泰国在70个经济体中排名第43。评估显示泰国在监管框架、数字及人工智能治理、公共领导力等三个关键领域表现较弱，反映产业数字化转型与AI发展规划的明显短板。
desc_original: Thailand was ranked 43rd among 70 economies in the 2026 World Digital and AI Competitiveness Ranking (WDAIR), reflecting low scores in three sub-factors: regulatory framework, digital and AI governance, and public leadership.

title: Ministry questions Apple over iPhone notifications
desc: The Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry on Wednesday held talks with Apple over cyberthreat notifications sent to iPhone users in more than 150 countries, seeking further information on the issue.
title_cn: 泰国数字部就iPhone安全提醒与苹果协商
summary_cn: 泰国数字经济和社会部与苹果公司进行对话，讨论iPhone用户接收的网络威胁警告通知。该通知已发送至全球150多个国家，泰国部门希望获取更多信息了解其内容与苹果数据处理方式，以保护本地用户权益。
desc_original: The Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry on Wednesday held talks with Apple over cyberthreat notifications sent to iPhone users in more than 150 countries, seeking further information on the issue.

title: Consumer confidence falls in October
desc: The Consumer Confidence Index (CCI) fell for the second time in five months to 50.9 in October, but the Center of Economic and Business Forecasting at the University of the Thai Chamber of Commerce (UTCC) says the situation is still temporary.
title_cn: 十月消费者信心指数回落
summary_cn: 泰国消费者信心指数（CCI）在十月下滑至50.9，这是近五个月来第二次下降。泰国商业总会（UTCC）经济商业预测中心认为此轮下滑为暂时现象。尽管指数下跌反映消费者信心疲软，但专家预期局面仍可逆转。
desc_original: The Consumer Confidence Index (CCI) fell for the second time in five months to 50.9 in October, but the Center of Economic and Business Forecasting at the University of the Thai Chamber of Commerce (UTCC) says the situation is still temporary.

title: Reports of river pollution hit Chiang Rai tourism prospects
desc: Tourism in Chiang Rai could be affected by reports of contamination in local rivers, including the Kok, which have undermined tourist confidence, although daily water consumption in most areas remains unaffected.
title_cn: 清莱河流污染报道打击旅游前景
summary_cn: 清莱地区河流（包括克河 Kok River）污染的报道冲击当地旅游业，打击游客信心。不过多数地区日常用水未受影响，风险相对可控。该事件对外来游客和旅游从业者关注度较高。
desc_original: Tourism in Chiang Rai could be affected by reports of contamination in local rivers, including the Kok, which have undermined tourist confidence, although daily water consumption in most areas remains unaffected.

title: Government pledges to speed up investment
desc: The government has vowed to accelerate investment, aiming to increase public investment by a further 1–2 percentage points while promoting private investment to grow by an additional 5–6 percentage points over the next four years.
title_cn: 政府承诺加快投资步伐
summary_cn: 泰国政府誓言未来四年加快投资，公共投资将增加1-2个百分点，私人投资预期增长5-6个百分点。这是政府刺激经济增长的重要举措，对在泰投资企业和经营者意义重大，预期带动产业就业和基建发展。
desc_original: The government has vowed to accelerate investment, aiming to increase public investment by a further 1–2 percentage points while promoting private investment to grow by an additional 5–6 percentage points over the next four years.

title: Central bank frets over prolonged low rates
desc: The Bank of Thailand is concerned that keeping interest rates low for an extended period could undermine financial stability and slow the country's economic recovery.
title_cn: 央行担忧长期低利率风险
summary_cn: 泰国央行（Bank of Thailand）表示，长期维持低利率政策可能威胁金融稳定，阻碍经济复苏。央行在刺激增长与防范风险间面临平衡抉择。这一立场变化对储蓄者理财和投资决策有参考意义。
desc_original: The Bank of Thailand is concerned that keeping interest rates low for an extended period could undermine financial stability and slow the country's economic recovery.

title: BEV tax hike set to lure foreign auto firms
desc: Thailand's plan to raise excise tax on imported battery electric vehicles (BEVs) is expected to encourage foreign automakers to shift production to the country, although the benefits for local suppliers and government revenue remain uncertain, pundits say.
title_cn: 提高电动车进口税或吸引外资整车企业
summary_cn: 泰国计划上调进口电动汽车（BEV）消费税，旨在激励海外汽车制造商将生产转向泰国。此举意在强化泰国电动汽车产业竞争力。不过专家指出本地供应商获益与政府税收效果仍存不确定性。
desc_original: Thailand's plan to raise excise tax on imported battery electric vehicles (BEVs) is expected to encourage foreign automakers to shift production to the country, although the benefits for local suppliers and government revenue remain uncertain, pundits say.

title: Gasohol changes spark industry debate
desc: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) supports the government's plan to make E20 gasohol the country's primary fuel and gradually phase out gasohol 91 and 95, but urges authorities to address potential impacts on motorists, fuel retailers and state revenue.
title_cn: E20汽油改革激发行业争议
summary_cn: 泰国工业联合会（FTI）支持政府计划将E20汽油作为国家主要燃料，逐步淘汰91和95号汽油。但该组织敦促当局关注对驾驶人、燃油零售商及政府税收的潜在影响，以制定平衡的过渡政策。
desc_original: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) supports the government's plan to make E20 gasohol the country's primary fuel and gradually phase out gasohol 91 and 95, but urges authorities to address potential impacts on motorists, fuel retailers and state revenue.

title: Prasit gets 20 years for tour scam
desc: The Criminal Court has sentenced businessman Prasit Jiewkok to 1,244 years in prison for defrauding 311 people through bogus tour-package investment schemes, although his actual jail term is capped at 20 years by law.
title_cn: 商人普拉西特旅游诈骗案获刑20年
summary_cn: 刑事法院判处商人普拉西特（Prasit Jiewkok）1244年监禁，因其通过虚假旅游投资计划诈骗311人。虽然法律上限为20年，但刑期反映了案情严重程度，对游客和投资者形成警示。
desc_original: The Criminal Court has sentenced businessman Prasit Jiewkok to 1,244 years in prison for defrauding 311 people through bogus tour-package investment schemes, although his actual jail term is capped at 20 years by law.

title: Western section of Orange Line makes progress
desc: Construction of the Orange Line's western section is 38.5% complete, with the Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) using a pipe-roof technique to minimise traffic disruption.
title_cn: 曼谷地铁橙色线西段施工进展加快
summary_cn: 大众运输管理局（MRTA）推进橙色线（Orange Line）西段建设，目前完成度达38.5%。采用管幕技术最小化对地面交通的影响，进展符合预期。
desc_original: Construction of the Orange Line's western section is 38.5% complete, with the Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) using a pipe-roof technique to minimise traffic disruption.

title: Govt mulling fuels phase-out
desc: The government is considering phasing out Gasohol 91 and 95 to promote E20 gasohol and B20 biodiesel to reduce reliance on imported fossil fuels and support domestic agricultural producers as part of a long-term energy transition plan.
title_cn: 泰国推进能源转型 逐步淘汰传统汽油
summary_cn: 泰国政府计划逐步淘汰91和95号汽油，推广E20汽油和B20生物柴油。此举旨在减少对进口化石燃料的依赖、支持本土农业生产者，是长期能源转型战略的重要组成部分。
desc_original: The government is considering phasing out Gasohol 91 and 95 to promote E20 gasohol and B20 biodiesel to reduce reliance on imported fossil fuels and support domestic agricultural producers as part of a long-term energy transition plan.

title: Attacks in three provinces spur border policy review
desc: The government is concerned about a wave of attacks in Yala, Songkhla and Satun, prompting heightened security measures and a review of its southern border policies, according to the Foreign Affairs Ministry.
title_cn: 泰南三府遭袭 边境政策面临审查
summary_cn: 泰国南部雅拉（Yala）、宋卡（Songkhla）和沙敦（Satun）三府接连遭攻击，外交部称政府已加强安保措施并启动南部边境政策评估，以应对安全态势变化。
desc_original: The government is concerned about a wave of attacks in Yala, Songkhla and Satun, prompting heightened security measures and a review of its southern border policies, according to the Foreign Affairs Ministry.

title: MP Nikorn revises draft on House panel regulations
desc: Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) MP Nikorn Chamnong has withdrawn his proposed amendments to House meeting regulations and submitted a revised draft, dropping provisions concerning committee powers in an attempt to defuse a growing political dispute.
title_cn: 议员尼空修订众议院委员会规则草案
summary_cn: 人民党议员尼空·查姆农原本提议修改众议院会议规则，包括对委员会权力的调整，但在面临政治争议升级后，他选择战略性退步，撤回了原提案，转而提交了修订幅度较小的新草案，删除了涉及委员会权力的条款。这一举措旨在缓解当前日益升级的政治纷争，体现了泰国政治圈在制度完善中的妥协与调整。
desc_original: Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) MP Nikorn Chamnong has withdrawn his proposed amendments to House meeting regulations and submitted a revised draft, dropping provisions concerning committee powers in an attempt to defuse a growing political dispute.

title: Thailand, Canada eye stronger trade ties
desc: Thailand and Canada are seeking closer economic ties in strategic industries, including clean energy and advanced technology, as the two countries begin free trade agreement (FTA) negotiations amid growing global uncertainty.
title_cn: 泰国与加拿大致力加强贸易联系
summary_cn: 面对全球经济不确定性加剧的挑战，泰国与加拿大两国决定建立更紧密的经济伙伴关系。双方聚焦清洁能源和先进技术等战略产业，正式启动自由贸易协定（FTA）谈判，以期实现互利共赢。此举对泰国意义重大，有助于拓宽出口市场、吸引高端产业投资、推动经济多元化发展。
desc_original: Thailand and Canada are seeking closer economic ties in strategic industries, including clean energy and advanced technology, as the two countries begin free trade agreement (FTA) negotiations amid growing global uncertainty.

title: คลัง ประกาศแผนทรานส์ฟอร์มประเทศด้วย STI ขับเคลื่อนเศรษฐกิจไทยเติบโตทั่วถึง
desc: กระทรวงการคลัง ประกาศแผน MOF Transformation ทรานส์ฟอร์มประเทศด้วย STI ทรานส์ฟอร์มคลังให้ DEE มั่นใจช่วยขับเคลื่อนเศรษฐกิจไทยเติบโตอย่างทั่วถึง และช่วย SMEs ให้เติบโตและแข่งขันได้
title_cn: 财政部宣布STI改革计划推动泰国经济全面增长
summary_cn: 泰国财政部正式宣布实施MOF改革转型计划，通过推动科技创新和产业升级（STI）的国家战略，致力于推动泰国经济实现全面、可持续的增长。该计划将强化财政部的数字化建设，同时支持中小企业的发展壮大与国际竞争力提升，是泰国政府推进经济创新驱动和数字化转型的重要举措。
desc_original: กระทรวงการคลัง ประกาศแผน MOF Transformation ทรานส์ฟอร์มประเทศด้วย STI ทรานส์ฟอร์มคลังให้ DEE มั่นใจช่วยขับเคลื่อนเศรษฐกิจไทยเติบโตอย่างทั่วถึง และช่วย SMEs ให้เติบโตและแข่งขันได้

title: ปลัดมท. สั่ง จัดพิธีถวายดอกไม้จันทน์งานพระราชพิธีถวายพระเพลิงพระบรมศพฯ ต้องสมพระเกียรติ
desc: ปลัดมหาดไทย นำประชุมติดตามความคืบหน้าการจัดงานพระราชพิธีถวายพระเพลิงพระบรมศพ สมเด็จพระนางเจ้าสิริกิติ์ พระบรมราชินีนาถ พระบรมราชชนนีพันปีหลวง ต้องสมพระเกียรติอย่างสูงสุด
title_cn: 内政部常秘部署已故女王火葬仪式 礼仪需彰显皇家尊严

title: Sihasak to visit Myanmar for talks on conflict, border issues
desc: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow will visit Myanmar on Thursday for talks with the country’s leaders about the ongoing conflict, border security, trade and cross-border pollution.
title_cn: 西哈萨克 Sihasak Phuangketkeow 访缅就冲突与边界问题进行磋商
summary_cn: 泰国外交部长西哈萨克将于周四访问缅甸，与缅甸领导人就该国正在进行的武装冲突、边境安全、贸易往来和跨境污染等问题进行磋商。此访涉及多个双边议题，尤其是边境安全问题对泰国有重要意义。这是泰国推进地区外交、维护边界稳定的重要举措。
desc_original: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow will visit Myanmar on Thursday for talks with the country’s leaders about the ongoing conflict, border security, trade and cross-border pollution.

title: Airport operator stresses safe skies for Loy Krathong
desc: Airports of Thailand (AoT) has urged people living near its six airports to refrain from releasing lanterns, smoke lanterns, fireworks, rockets and balloons, or flying drones during the Loy Krathong festival from Nov 23-25 to ensure aviation safety.
title_cn: 机场运营方力推水灯节航空安全
summary_cn: 泰国机场管理部(Airports of Thailand, AoT)发布通知，要求居住在其辖下六个机场周边的民众，在11月23-25日水灯节(Loy Krathong)期间禁止放天灯、烟火、火箭、气球和驾驶无人机，以确保航空安全。此举旨在防止这些物体对航班造成威胁，维护空中交通安全。
desc_original: Airports of Thailand (AoT) has urged people living near its six airports to refrain from releasing lanterns, smoke lanterns, fireworks, rockets and balloons, or flying drones during the Loy Krathong festival from Nov 23-25 to ensure aviation safety.

title: Animal welfare foundation alleges B13 million embezzled
desc: The president of the Watchdog Thailand Foundation (WDT), a non-profit animal welfare organisation, has accused her predecessor of embezzling about 13 million baht in public donations for personal use.
title_cn: 动物福利基金会指控前任贪污1300万泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国动物福利非营利组织「看门狗泰国基金会」(Watchdog Thailand Foundation, WDT)现任主席指控其前任挪用约1300万泰铢的公众捐款用于私人用途。此事涉及对非营利机构财务透明度和监管机制的严肃质疑，引发对慈善组织资金管理的关注。
desc_original: The president of the Watchdog Thailand Foundation (WDT), a non-profit animal welfare organisation, has accused her predecessor of embezzling about 13 million baht in public donations for personal use.

The TikTok user, who posts under the account @davidkast93 , shared the video on November 10, describing it as “The racism in Thailand”. In the caption, he said it was only his fourth day in the country. In the video, the man said racism was the only thing he disliked about Thailand before showing a half-eaten sandwich that he claimed had not been heated properly. He accused a female employee of ignoring him because she disliked him. The footage then showed him returning to the convenience store to complain about the food. Photo via TikTok/ @davidkast93 The employee, who was alone at the counter in the footage, reheated the sandwich. title: 中国总理李强即将访泰！泰方将重点争取恢复中国游客信心，深化经贸合作
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月10日，泰国副总理兼外交部长西哈萨在总理府接受采访时表示，中国国务院总理李强将于11月13日至14日访问泰国，双方将就多项重要议题展开讨论，重点包括增强中方对泰国旅游安全的信心、打击网络诈骗犯罪、扩大贸易与投资合作，以及改善泰中贸易失衡问题。 西哈萨表示，泰中两国关系总体发展良好，但双方仍需进一步加强各领域合作。针对近期中方对赴泰旅游安全的关注，泰方将向中方说明泰国旅游安全状况，强调泰国整体上是安全的，近期出现问题的相关人员并非普通游客，希望以此增强中方对泰国旅游环境的信心。 西哈萨还表示，双方将讨论打击网络犯罪及电信诈骗团伙问题。泰方希望与中方加强执法合作，共同打击相关犯罪活动，并追查涉案人员。 在经贸合作方面，双方将重点讨论扩大贸易与投资合作。西哈萨指出，目前泰国对华贸易仍存在较大逆差，希望通过加强合作，进一步扩大双边贸易规模，改善贸易失衡状况。此外，双方还将讨论电动汽车产业及新兴产业领域合作机会，推动两国在新产业方面的投资与发展。 西哈萨透露，泰中双方计划讨论2027年举行的“2+2”部长级对话机制框架。该机制将由两国外交部长和国防部长共同参与，围绕外交及国防领域合作展开交流。 此次李强访泰被视为进一步深化泰中全面战略合作伙伴关系的重要契机。旅游安全、跨境犯罪治理及经贸投资合作预计将成为双方关注的重点议题。 （编译：Wan；来源：泰国外交部、Thairath） The post 中国总理李强即将访泰！泰方将重点争取恢复中国游客信心，深化经贸合作 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

desc: Why study hospitality management at AIHM? Swiss Educational Excellence with two internships Legacy If you’re comparing hospitality degrees in Bangkok, start with where the classrooms are. The Asian Institute of Hospitality & Management (AIHM) holds its classes on the ninth floor of Avani+ Riverside Bangkok Hotel, a fully operating hotel on the Chao Phraya River, connected to Anantara Riverside Bangkok Resort. That’s where your first semester, Practical Arts, takes place. It’s also one of several reasons to look closely at AIHM’s BBA in Global Hospitality Management. title: Russian woman arrested in Phuket over 2,379 day visa overstay
desc: Russian woman arrested in Phuket over 2,379 day visa overstay Legacy A Russian woman was arrested at a condominium in Patong, Phuket , after overstaying her visa by 2,379 days, or more than six years. Immigration officers launched the operation after receiving information that a Russian national whose permission to stay in Thailand had expired was living at a condominium on Sirirat Road. According to Immigration Bureau records, the woman’s permission to stay expired on October 12, 2020. Her full name was not disclosed in the report. Officers visited the condominium and arrested the woman inside her room. She reportedly admitted to overstaying and was taken to Patong Police Station for further legal proceedings. Photo via Facebook/ Phuket Hotnews Immigration officials said the operation was part of a nationwide enforcement campaign ordered by Royal Thai Police chief Samran Nualma. title: Tomorrowland Thailand braces for loss despite sold-out debut
desc: Tomorrowland Thailand braces for loss despite sold-out debut Legacy Tomorrowland Thailand’s organiser expects to lose money on the festival’s first edition next month, even though every ticket has sold out , after the cost of staging the debut rose from 1.6 billion baht to about 2 billion baht. The three-day electronic dance music festival runs from December 11 to 13 at Wisdom Valley in Khao Mai Kaeo subdistrict, Bang Lamung district, Chon Buri, with capacity for 50,000 people a day. Rachata Thunyavuthi, an executive board member of organiser WEAREONE.WORLD (Thailand) Co Ltd, told Bangkok Biznews and The Nation that the inaugural event would decide whether the Belgian partners stay in Thailand for the full five years. Thailand will become the third country to host a full-scale Tomorrowland , after Belgium and Brazil, following more than a decade in which the Belgian team searched for a Thai venue. The executive blamed the higher budget on December being peak season for outdoor events across Asia, which left Thailand short of staging equipment and forced the organiser to import supplies from Singapore and Malaysia. Wisdom Valley in Chon Buri, pictured in 2023 | Photo via Facebook/Wi

summary_cn: 电子舞曲音乐节 Tomorrowland 泰国版将于12月11-13日在春武里府考迈开 Khao Mai Kaeo 的智慧谷 Wisdom Valley 举办，日容量5万。尽管门票售罄，主办方仍预计首届活动将亏损，成本从16亿铢增至20亿铢。原因是12月为亚洲户外活动旺季，导致设备短缺，需从新加坡和马来西亚进口供应。这是 Tomorrowland 继比利时和巴西后的第三个举办国。

title: 2 teenagers held over murder of 51 year old man in Phuket
desc: 2 teenagers held over murder of 51 year old man in Phuket Legacy Two Thai teenagers aged 16 and 17 were arrested in Phuket yesterday, November 10, for fatally attacking a 51 year old man following a financial dispute. Thalang Police Station officers were alerted by medical staff at Thalang Hospital at around 1am that the injured man, identified as 51 year old Kittisak, had been admitted for emergency treatment following an assault. He died shortly afterwards. Police examined Kittisak and found injuries to his head, neck and arms. His body was subsequently transferred to Vachira Phuket Hospital for a forensic examination. The attack took place outside a house in Thep Krasattri subdistrict, Thalang district. According to police, Kittisak was standing in front of the property when two teenagers arrived on a motorcycle. They attacked him with a baseball bat and a knife before fleeing. Photo via Khao Phuket Investigators identified the suspects as two boys aged 16 and 17. Police traced and arrested them at around 3am, approximately two hours after the hospital notified officers. Police also seized the motorcycle and weapons allegedly used in the attack. title: 泰美互惠谈判达成实质性结论，阿努廷将与特朗普联合签署
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月11日，泰国总理府办公室发言人埃卡波透露，总理兼内政部部长阿努廷将于下周与相关部长前往菲律宾出席东盟领导人会议，随后转赴中国参加亚太经合组织会议。期间，阿努廷计划与各国领导人、外国投资者和企业家们会面，并签署泰美关税谈判的联合文件。另外，经济合作与发展组织（OECD）秘书长将于11月底访问泰国，政府已就相关讨论议题做好准备。 昨天（11月10日），内阁会议已批准商业部提交的《泰美互惠贸易协定联合声明》草案，同意由总理宣布并/或签署该草案，同时规定，若仅对草案的非实质内容进行文字修改且不损害泰国利益，签署人可自行酌情处理，无需再次提请内阁批准。 联合声明的宣布和签署仪式将于11月15日至17日菲律宾马尼拉东盟峰会期间进行。阿努廷与美国总统特朗普将共同确认，泰美双方已就互惠贸易协定（ART）谈判达成实质性结论，作为1966年《友好和经济关系条约》以及2002年《贸易与投资框架协定》的延续。 美国对泰国征收的关税税率原定于2026年7月2日到期，导致之前的泰美关税谈判较为紧迫，内阁还曾在2025年8月1日批准了一份关于协议框架的联合声明草案，初步约定美国对泰国维持19%的互惠税率，以避免被征收36%的高税率。将于2026年11月宣布的联合声明草案，其内容仅确认泰美双方已在内容上达成实质性结论，并未详细列出具体结论，但有助于降低谈判前景的不确定性，增强贸易伙伴和投资者的信心，为企业在整条供应链上规划生产、采购和投资提供重要参考。在宣布联合声明后，双方将启动各自国内必要程序，为正式签署和协定生效做准备。 就法律地位而言，这份联合声明草案只是一份表达政治意愿、公布谈判进展的文件，形式上或措辞上并不产生国际法义务，因此不属于泰国宪法第178条所称的条约或协议，而是对泰国政府具有约束力的国际关系事项，所以必须先提交内阁批准后再实施。据悉，相关政府部门在审议该草案后，一致表示没有异议。 （编译：KA；来源：bangkokbiznews） The post 泰美互惠谈判达成实质性结论，阿努廷将与特朗普联合签署 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰美互惠贸易谈判达成实质性进展，总理阿努廷将与特朗普联合签署

title: 泰国年轻人兴起“夜骑”热潮
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月11日，泰国年轻人和骑行爱好者近期兴起夜骑打卡热潮，在晚上10点至12点之间，骑行者们骑着自行车，探寻曼谷各大知名地标的夜间氛围，如大皇宫、玉佛寺、皇家田广场和国防部大楼前等区域。据悉，晚上10点后，马路上的汽车相对较少，骑行的人很多，他们约着骑车前往各个景点，并拍照留念，记录夜间的美好。 目前，曼谷提供Anywheel和HelloRide两款共享单车租赁服务，计费标准为每30分钟10泰铢。但现场走访发现，共享单车存在供应量不足的问题，在MRT Sanam Chai站、Saphan Phut和Tha Tien等借还车点，晚上6点后几乎整晚都有不少人排队等着租车。 另一个问题是，在卧佛寺码头周边停靠观光时，有车辆丢失的情况发生。由于共享单车必须在指定的借还车点才能锁车，而且如果没有锁好，其他人可以直接骑走。除此之外，部分骑行者在骑行时未能给予足够的安全重视，存在发生意外事故的风险。 为此，有关部门借此呼吁骑行者们共同配合，遵守交通规则，有序骑行，不给他人造成困扰，让这种旅游新趋势不断成熟完善，逐渐成为一种新型旅游模式，并实现可持续发展。 （编译：KA；来源：Brickinfo Channel） The post 泰国年轻人兴起“夜骑”热潮 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国年轻人兴起「夜骑」热潮

title: 泰国调整网购商品进口关税，最高30%
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月10日，泰国副总理兼财政部部长艾尼提透露，泰国内阁已批准了海外网购商品进口关税征收的新规定，新的税率基于海关税则分类设定，最高不超过30%。这次税率调整的目的是为泰国企业创造更公平的竞争环境，特别是中小企业，同时加强对消费者的保护。新规定将在政府公报网站公布次日生效。 海关厅厅长表示，修订后的进口关税征收规则适用于通过快递和国际邮政进入泰国的商品。海关厅将利用电商平台的数据作为货物申报和关税征收的依据之一，目标是提高进口数据管理的准确性和效率，使海关程序与当前的实际在线交易保持一致。海关厅将联合财政部与各平台合作，准备必要的系统和流程，海关厅也将与其他机构协调，确保新规实施顺利、透明、高效，并兼顾对消费者和企业的影响。 艾尼提补充说，电商的快速发展让外国商品更容易进入泰国消费者手中，但也加剧了价格竞争，泰国企业需要承担税收、用工、法律合规和产品标准等相关成本，这些差异可能导致不对等的贸易条件，所以政府做出税率调整的决定，希望国内外卖家在一致的规则下竞争。 消费者安全是另一个关注要点。部分通过线上渠道进口的低价商品可能不符合标准或存在安全风险，如食品饮料、化妆品和膳食补充剂、电子设备、充电宝以及汽车相关部件等。这次进口关税的新规定有助于减少廉价商品的进口，因为这些商品在泰国没有企业对其产品标准负责。政府强调，税率调整是为了让税收和贸易规则适应数字经济时代，保持在线贸易开放，并保留消费者的选择权。 （编译：KA；来源：nationthailand） The post 泰国调整网购商品进口关税，最高30% appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国调整网购商品进口关税，最高30%
summary_cn: 泰国内阁批准了海外网购商品进口关税新规，根据海关税则分类设定最高不超过30%。此举旨在为泰国中小企业创造公平竞争环境，保护消费者权益。新规适用于通过快递和国际邮政入境商品，海关将利用电商平台数据作为征收依据。政府指出外国廉价商品冲击本地企业，导致竞争不对等。部分进口低价商品可能不符合安全标准如食品、化妆品、电子设备等，税率调整有助于减少此类商品进口，维护消费者权益。

title: 泰国民航局通报：泰航乘客数据泄漏系服务商系统遭入侵，不影响航班运行
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月10日，泰国民航局（CAAT）就泰国国际航空公司乘客数据在未经授权的情况下被非法访问一事做出解释称，CAAT已与泰航对接并了解初步信息，同时正在密切跟进事实调查和相关应对措施。此次泄漏的泰航乘客数据共60,529条，均为自2023年以来的出行数据。 根据CAAT收到的报告，该事件与Amadeus IT Group S.A.（Amadeus）公司的系统遭遇未授权访问有关，其为一家向全球多家航空公司提供客票预订和乘客服务的供应商。Amadeus已陆续向涉事航空公司通报了事件的相关情况，以便各方按照流程采取必要的应对措施，其中包含了泰航。 在后续处置方面，CAAT已督促泰航妥善照料并保护受影响的乘客，目前泰航计划直接与受影响的个人数据所有者取得联系，并逐一进行通知。此举是为了让乘客及时了解事态，并针对其个人数据可能面临的风险及时采取防范或管理措施，尽管这次数据泄漏并非由泰航系统直接引发。 CAAT请广大乘客放心，就收到的报告信息来看，该事件没有对航空公司的航班运行安全或各项服务造成任何影响，泰航仍照常为乘客提供服务并支持航班正常起降。CAAT将继续密切跟踪事件进展，以及航空公司在个人数据保护和网络信息安全方面采取的各项防范措施，确保乘客获得应有的保障，维护公众对泰国民航服务系统的信任。 （编译：KA；来源：thansettakij） The post 泰国民航局通报：泰航乘客数据泄漏系服务商系统遭入侵，不影响航班运行 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国民航局通报：泰航乘客数据泄漏源于服务商系统被入侵，航班运行不受影响
summary_cn: 泰国民航局（CAAT）通报泰航乘客数据泄漏事件。约6万条2023年以来出行数据因全球航空服务供应商 Amadeus 系统遭未授权访问而泄露。CAAT已督促泰航妥善保护受影响乘客，泰航将直接联系相关人士进行通知。民航局强调此事未对泰航航班安全或服务造成影响，航班照常运营。CAAT 将继续跟踪事件进展，监督航空公司的数据保护和网络安全防范措施，维护公众对泰国民航系统的信任。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月10日，泰国民航局（CAAT）就泰国国际航空公司乘客数据在未经授权的情况下被非法访问一事做出解释称，CAAT已与泰航对接并了解初步信息，同时正在密切跟进事实调查和相关应对措施。此次泄漏的泰航乘客数据共60,529条，均为自2023年以来的出行数据。 根据CAAT收到的报告，该事件与Amadeus IT Group S.A.（Amadeus）公司的系统遭遇未授权访问有关，其为一家向全球多家航空公司提供客票预订和乘客服务的供应商。Amadeus已陆续向涉事航空公司通报了事件的相关情况，以便各方按照流程采取必要的应对措施，其中包含了泰航。 在后续处置方面，CAAT已督促泰航妥善照料并保护受影响的乘客，目前泰航计划直接与受影响的个人数据所有者取得联系，并逐一进行通知。此举是为了让乘客及时了解事态，并针对其个人数据可能面临的风险及时采取防范或管理措施，尽管这次数据泄漏并非由泰航系统直接引发。 CAAT请广大乘客放心，就收到的报告信息来看，该事件没有对航空公司的航班运行安全或各项服务造成任何影响，泰航仍照常为乘客提供服务并支持航班正常起降。CAAT将继续密切跟踪事件进展，以及航空公司在个人数据保护和网络信息安全方面采取的各项防范措施，确保乘客获得应有的保障，维护公众对泰国民航服务系统的信任。 （编译：KA；来源：thansettakij） The post 泰国民航局通报：泰航乘客数据泄漏系服务商系统遭入侵，不影响航班运行 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

desc_original: Thailand has seen a sharp increase in biofuel consumption following the government's aggressive excise tax cuts on blended fuels, with the policy rapidly changing motorists' fuel-purchasing behaviour and providing support for the country's agricultural sector, says Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.

title: Ex-monk leads convoy demanding cheaper fuel
desc: Mano Khrueakaew, a former monk turned village headman, has led a convoy from southern Thailand to Bangkok, demanding cheaper fuel and relief from rising living costs.
title_cn: 前僧侣率车队进京 呼吁降低燃油价格
summary_cn: 前僧侣、现任村长曼诺·克鲁阿凯（Mano Khrueakaew）率领来自泰国南部的车队进入曼谷，向政府提出降低燃油价格的诉求，并呼吁采取措施缓解日益上升的生活成本压力。此举充分反映了基层民众对油价上涨和物价高企的普遍关切。
desc_original: Mano Khrueakaew, a former monk turned village headman, has led a convoy from southern Thailand to Bangkok, demanding cheaper fuel and relief from rising living costs.

title: Deluge leaves more than water damage
desc: Protecting homes from flooding is no longer sufficient as increasingly unpredictable weather poses growing risks to both property and mental well-being, experts said on Wednesday, calling for stronger flood prevention measures, psychological preparedness and community cooperation.
title_cn: 洪灾威胁超乎想象 专家呼吁加强防洪和心理建设
summary_cn: 专家指出气候变化日益不可预测，传统的住宅防洪措施已不足以保护民众的财产和心理健康。洪灾造成的风险和影响远超单纯的水灾损失，需要更强有力的防洪措施、心理防备训练和社区合作等多管齐下应对。
desc_original: Protecting homes from flooding is no longer sufficient as increasingly unpredictable weather poses growing risks to both property and mental well-being, experts said on Wednesday, calling for stronger flood prevention measures, psychological preparedness and community cooperation.

title: KBank targets current clients for growth
desc: Kasikornbank (KBank) has focused its lending expansion primarily on existing customers, who account for 99% of new loan bookings, as it seeks to control credit risks amid mounting economic challenges.
title_cn: 开泰银行聚焦现有客户拓展业务
summary_cn: 开泰银行（KBank）为应对日益恶化的经济形势带来的信贷风险，采取保守策略，将贷款扩张重心集中于现有客户。数据显示新增贷款中99%来自既有客户，这一审慎的客户政策反映银行对当前经济前景的谨慎态度和风险管理思维。
desc_original: Kasikornbank (KBank) has focused its lending expansion primarily on existing customers, who account for 99% of new loan bookings, as it seeks to control credit risks amid mounting economic challenges.

title: Flood defences 'may fail' in future disasters
desc: Bangkok's flood defences face mounting pressure from extreme rainfall and shrinking water-retention areas, raising concerns over the capital's ability to withstand future disasters.
title_cn: 曼谷防洪设施面临失效风险
summary_cn: 曼谷的防洪防卫系统正面临来自极端降雨事件和水源涵养区萎缩的多重压力，引发外界对首都应对未来灾难能力的担忧。在气候变化加剧背景下，现有防洪设施的有效性备受质疑。
desc_original: Bangkok's flood defences face mounting pressure from extreme rainfall and shrinking water-retention areas, raising concerns over the capital's ability to withstand future disasters.

title: FTI welcomes pickup trade-in scheme
desc: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) has welcomed the government's planned pickup trade-in programme, saying it could help revive domestic vehicle sales, which have suffered a prolonged downturn, once the scheme receives cabinet approval, expected in 2027.
title_cn: 泰国工业联盟力挺皮卡以旧换新计划
summary_cn: 泰国工业联合会（FTI）支持政府推出的皮卡以旧换新计划，认为这将有助于拉动长期不景气的国内汽车销售。该计划预计将在2027年获内阁批准，有望成为提振泰国汽车产业的重要政策工具。
desc_original: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) has welcomed the government's planned pickup trade-in programme, saying it could help revive domestic vehicle sales, which have suffered a prolonged downturn, once the scheme receives cabinet approval, expected in 2027.

title: Kingdom goes on cyber alert
desc: Thailand is preparing its highest-level response to an escalating cyber threat, with the government ordering telecom operators to strengthen their defences and seeking intelligence from major technology companies, including Apple, Google and Line.
title_cn: 泰国启动最高级别网络安全警戒
summary_cn: 泰国政府发布最高级别网络威胁应对预案，要求电信运营商加强防御措施，同时向Apple、Google、Line等科技巨头征求情报。此举反映泰国正面临日益严峻的网络安全挑战，政府与私营部门携手应对威胁。
desc_original: Thailand is preparing its highest-level response to an escalating cyber threat, with the government ordering telecom operators to strengthen their defences and seeking intelligence from major technology companies, including Apple, Google and Line.

title: Analysts welcome stricter data centre regulations
desc: Stock market analysts have welcomed the cabinet's approval of stricter regulations for data centre operations, saying clearer rules should ease investor concerns over potential project delays and pave the way for fresh capital inflows to support the stock market and the wider economy.
title_cn: 监管机构批准数据中心运营新规
summary_cn: 股票市场分析师欢迎政府内阁批准的数据中心运营新规，认为更清晰的监管框架将缓解投资者对项目延期的忧虑，促进资本流入，进而支撑股市和经济发展。这一政策调整体现了泰国优化商业环境、吸引外资的努力。
desc_original: Stock market analysts have welcomed the cabinet's approval of stricter regulations for data centre operations, saying clearer rules should ease investor concerns over potential project delays and pave the way for fresh capital inflows to support the stock market and the wider economy.

title: Bang Na set to become a key economic hub
desc: In the next two years, Bang Na district is poised to become one of the most prominent economic areas in the South Sukhumvit corridor, driven by large-scale mixed-use projects such as Bangkok Mall, which will offer approximately 1 million square metres of space, as well as the expansion of existing major players such as Mega Bangna.
title_cn: 邦纳地区将成曼谷南部经济中心
summary_cn: 未来两年内，邦纳（Bang Na）区将凭借大型综合体项目——包括提供约100万平方米空间的Bangkok Mall和Mega Bangna的扩建——成为苏坤逸（Sukhumvit）南走廊最重要的经济区域之一，吸引大量商业和地产投资。
desc_original: In the next two years, Bang Na district is poised to become one of the most prominent economic areas in the South Sukhumvit corridor, driven by large-scale mixed-use projects such as Bangkok Mall, which will offer approximately 1 million square metres of space, as well as the expansion of existing major players such as Mega Bangna.

title: Scam losses reach B65.8bn in Thailand
desc: Thais suffered estimated losses of US$1.85 billion, or around 65.8 billion baht, from scams, averaging $335 per victim over a 12-month period, with phone calls, Meta social media platforms and Line remaining the most common channels used by fraudsters, according to the latest report by the Global Anti-Scam Alliance (GASA).
title_cn: 泰国诈骗损失达658亿泰铢
summary_cn: 根据全球反诈骗联盟（GASA）最新报告，泰国民众在过去12个月中因诈骗蒙受的经济损失高达约185亿美元，折合658亿泰铢，平均每名受害者个人损失达335美元。研究表明，电话、Meta社交媒体平台以及Line应用是诈骗分子使用最频繁的作案工具，这些渠道对在泰外国人和本地居民都构成重大安全隐患。
desc_original: Thais suffered estimated losses of US$1.85 billion, or around 65.8 billion baht, from scams, averaging $335 per victim over a 12-month period, with phone calls, Meta social media platforms and Line remaining the most common channels used by fraudsters, according to the latest report by the Global Anti-Scam Alliance (GASA).

title: Fuel protest poses security headache ahead of Li visit
desc: A month-long protest outside Government House has raised security concerns ahead of Chinese Premier Li Qiang's visit on Friday, with authorities seeking to reopen roads blocked by demonstrators demanding a 10-baht-per-litre cut in fuel prices.
title_cn: 燃油抗议成为李强访泰前的安保隐患
summary_cn: 政府大楼外发生的燃油价格抗议已持续一个月，示威者强烈要求政府将每升燃料价格下调10泰铢。抗议导致多条道路被占据阻塞，在中国总理李强定于本周五访问泰国前夕，给当局带来严峻的安保压力和外交挑战。政府已启动应急措施，试图重新开放被占据的道路以确保访问顺利进行。
desc_original: A month-long protest outside Government House has raised security concerns ahead of Chinese Premier Li Qiang's visit on Friday, with authorities seeking to reopen roads blocked by demonstrators demanding a 10-baht-per-litre cut in fuel prices.

title: NACC flags B50m sports equipment scam
desc: The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) has found grounds for criminal proceedings in a 50.5-million-baht procurement scheme involving outdoor fitness and recreational equipment approved by the late former director-general of the Department of Physical Education, Saengchan Worasuman, in fiscal 2013.
title_cn: 反腐委发现5000万泰铢体育设备采购舞弊案
summary_cn: 泰国国家反腐败委员会（NACC）调查发现一起重大体育设备采购腐败案，涉案金额达5050万泰铢。该项目由已故体育教育部处长尚昌·沃拉素曼在2013财年时批准。NACC已掌握充分证据，决定推进刑事诉讼程序，涉案人员和相关责任方面临严肃法律追究。
desc_original: The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) has found grounds for criminal proceedings in a 50.5-million-baht procurement scheme involving outdoor fitness and recreational equipment approved by the late former director-general of the Department of Physical Education, Saengchan Worasuman, in fiscal 2013.

title: Special holiday for cremation
desc: The cabinet has declared Dec 16 a special public holiday to allow people to attend or observe the royal cremation ceremony of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother.
title_cn: 12月16日定为诗丽吉皇后太后火化仪式特别假期
summary_cn: 泰国内阁宣布将12月16日定为全国特别公众假期，以便全国民众能够参加或观礼诗丽吉皇后太后的皇家火化仪式。此举充分体现政府对这一重要王室活动的重视，同时为民众参与皇家庆典预留了充足的时间。此特别假期是国家对王室的敬礼。
desc_original: The cabinet has declared Dec 16 a special public holiday to allow people to attend or observe the royal cremation ceremony of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother.

title: Gender gaps persist across Thai society
desc: Gender-based violence, unequal care responsibilities and limited political representation continue to restrict women's opportunities in Thailand despite progress in education and healthcare, according to a United Nations report.
title_cn: 性别不平等问题继续困扰泰国社会
summary_cn: 联合国最新报告指出，尽管泰国在教育和医疗领域取得显著进展，但性别不平等问题依然广泛存在。性别暴力、不平等的家庭照护责任分配、以及妇女在政治决策中的代表权不足，继续严重限制了妇女的各方面发展机会。报告强调，解决这些根深蒂固的性别差距仍是泰国社会发展的关键任务。
desc_original: Gender-based violence, unequal care responsibilities and limited political representation continue to restrict women's opportunities in Thailand despite progress in education and healthcare, according to a United Nations report.

title: Honouring 3 top CEOs
desc: The Bangkok Post today publishes the third instalment of its "Bangkok Post CEO of the Year 2026" series, profiling three more award winners.
title_cn: 表彰三位年度杰出CEO
summary_cn: 曼谷邮报今日公布「2026年度最佳CEO」系列报道的第三期，介绍三位新获奖的CEO人选，涵盖企业领袖的杰出贡献和成就。
desc_original: The Bangkok Post today publishes the third instalment of its "Bangkok Post CEO of the Year 2026" series, profiling three more award winners.

title: Federation slashes SET index year-end target
desc: The Federation of Thai Capital Market Organizations (Fetco) has cut its year-end target for the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) index to 1,550-1,600 points from 1,700, following a sharper-than-expected market decline, but noted that earnings and potential foreign inflows could limit further losses.
title_cn: 泰国资本市场联合会下调SET指数年底目标
summary_cn: 泰国资本市场组织联合会(Fetco)因市场跌幅超出预期，将泰国证券交易所(SET)指数年底目标从1700点下调至1550-1600点。联合会指出经济基本面和潜在外资流入可望限制进一步下跌空间。
desc_original: The Federation of Thai Capital Market Organizations (Fetco) has cut its year-end target for the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) index to 1,550-1,600 points from 1,700, following a sharper-than-expected market decline, but noted that earnings and potential foreign inflows could limit further losses.

title: NT strengthens network cybersecurity, resilience
desc: National Telecom (NT) has assured the public that Thailand's telecommunications infrastructure is prepared to withstand potential cyber-attacks and other disruptions, pledging to maintain uninterrupted communications through enhanced network surveillance, backup systems and strengthened cybersecurity measures.
title_cn: 泰国国家电信公司加强网络安全防御能力
summary_cn: 泰国国家电信公司(NT)宣布该国电信基础设施已做好应对网络攻击和其他中断事件的准备，将通过增强网络监控、备份系统和强化网络安全措施来确保通信服务不中断。
desc_original: National Telecom (NT) has assured the public that Thailand's telecommunications infrastructure is prepared to withstand potential cyber-attacks and other disruptions, pledging to maintain uninterrupted communications through enhanced network surveillance, backup systems and strengthened cybersecurity measures.

title: Thai bourse likely to remain range-bound
desc: Thailand's stock market is likely to remain range-bound as external pressures, particularly US interest rates and bond yields, weigh on global capital flows and investor sentiment, says global asset and wealth manager Aberdeen Investments.
title_cn: 泰国股市料将维持区间整理
summary_cn: 全球资产和财富管理公司Aberdeen Investments认为，泰国股市受美国利率和债券收益率等外部压力影响，全球资本流向和投资者情绪疲弱，股市可能继续维持区间震荡态势。
desc_original: Thailand's stock market is likely to remain range-bound as external pressures, particularly US interest rates and bond yields, weigh on global capital flows and investor sentiment, says global asset and wealth manager Aberdeen Investments.

title: “สมปอง นครไธสง” พร้อมภรรยาแจ้งอาการป่วยของลูกในครรภ์ แฟนคลับแห่ให้กำลังใจ
desc: “สมปอง นครไธสง” พร้อมภรรยา แจ้งข่าวอาการป่วยของลูกในครรภ์ หลังหมอบอกเป็นปากแหว่งเพดานโหว่ แฟนคลับแห่ให้กำลังใจล้นหลาม
title_cn: 泰国演员สมปอง นครไธสง和妻子透露孩子先天性腭裂诊断
summary_cn: 知名泰国演员สมปอง นครไธสง和妻子公开了腹中胎儿先天性腭裂的诊断结果，医生发现婴儿患有腭裂。他们希望获得社会的关心和祈福，大量粉丝纷纷留言表示鼓励和支持。

title_cn: 2569年洪灾补偿金：灾害救济委员会追加转账7,381户
summary_cn: 泰国灾害救济委员会(ปภ.)继续发放2026年洪灾救济金，昨日追加转账给7,381户，总额4,800万泰铢。该轮补偿已覆盖170多万受灾户。政府在灾后持续推进赔偿进度。

title_cn: 11月11日油价调整：柴油下降1泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国石油(PTT)和Bangchak加油站宣布油价下调，自2026年11月11日凌晨5点起，柴油每升下调1泰铢，汽油(E20、91、95号)及其他燃油下调50沙通。

title: New joint venture looking to revive Robinhood
desc: The SET-listed tech company SKY ICT and the shipping conglomerate Thoresen Thai Agencies (TTA) are joining forces to secure the intellectual property of the homegrown food delivery app Robinhood in a 100-million-baht deal.
title_cn: SKY ICT与Thoresen合作复兴Robinhood外卖应用
summary_cn: 泰国科技公司SKY ICT与运输集团Thoresen Thai Agencies (TTA)成立合资企业，以1亿泰铢收购本土外卖应用Robinhood的知识产权，意在重振这款曾活跃的本地服务平台。
desc_original: The SET-listed tech company SKY ICT and the shipping conglomerate Thoresen Thai Agencies (TTA) are joining forces to secure the intellectual property of the homegrown food delivery app Robinhood in a 100-million-baht deal.

title: “จิ๊บ ไคลน์” คนไทยนำทัพกองทุน VC ในซิลิคอนแวลลีย์ เปิดทางนักลงทุนเข้าถึง Deep Tech ระดับโลก
desc: Raisewell Ventures เชื่อมนวัตกรรม "ซิลิคอนแวลลีย์-ไทย" เปิดโมเดลเชื่อมโยงการลงทุนระดับสากล พร้อมขับเคลื่อนการนำเทคโนโลยีขั้นสูงมาปรับใช้เพื่อยกระดับเศรษฐกิจในประเทศ
title_cn: 泰籍创业者领导硅谷VC基金 连接全球深科技与泰国
summary_cn: Raisewell Ventures由泰籍创业者吉卜·克莱恩(Jib Klein)在硅谷创立，连接硅谷与泰国的创新生态，为泰国投资者开放全球顶级深科技项目投资渠道，推动高端技术在泰国经济中的应用。
desc_original: Raisewell Ventures เชื่อมนวัตกรรม "ซิลิคอนแวลลีย์-ไทย" เปิดโมเดลเชื่อมโยงการลงทุนระดับสากล พร้อมขับเคลื่อนการนำเทคโนโลยีขั้นสูงมาปรับใช้เพื่อยกระดับเศรษฐกิจในประเทศ

title: ส่อง 6 หุ้นท่องเที่ยวไทยฟื้นช่วงไฮซีซัน จับตา Tomorrowland ส่งท้ายปี 2569
desc: ท่องเที่ยวไทยส่งสัญญาณฟื้นตัวช่วงไฮซีซัน จับตา TOMORROWLAND ชลบุรี ดันเงินสะพัด 5 พันล้านบาท ที่พักพัทยาจองล้น 99% ด้าน บล.เอเซีย พลัส ชี้เป้าหุ้นเด่นรับทรัพย์ AOT, CENTEL, ERW, AWC, BA, AAV
title_cn: 泰国旅游业旺季复苏：Tomorrowland推动芭提雅经济
summary_cn: 泰国旅游业进入旺季，呈现明显复苏迹象。Tomorrowland音乐节将在芭提雅(Pattaya)举办，预计带动消费5,000万泰铢；当地酒店预订率达99%。亚洲基金推荐AOT、CENTEL、ERW、AWC、BA、AAV等旅游相关股票作为投资标的。

title: 泰国内阁批准数据中心行业监管新规：0.5兆瓦及以上项目纳入审批许可管理
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月10日，泰国副总理兼财政部长艾尼提在内阁会议后表示，泰国内阁已批准数据中心行业监管政策，明确数据中心经营标准及审批许可制度，监管范围覆盖用电功率0.5兆瓦及以上的数据中心。内阁责成数字经济与社会部设立一站式服务中心（OSS），并成立审核委员会，统筹项目审批和制定各部门执行规则。获批企业须达到最低标准，并为泰国创造最大利益。 艾尼提表示，数据中心是人工智能和数字经济的重要基础设施，近两三年快速兴起，但消耗大量电力和水资源，也可能影响周边社区。此前泰国缺乏明确监管规则，各部门分别审批，出现投资促进申请、提前圈占电力配额后转售，以及提前申请设立和施工许可等问题。为此，泰国总理成立专门委员会，负责制定统一规则。 统一规则，加强行业监管 该政策有两大目标：一是为投资者提供确定性，让真正为国家创造利益的企业能够持续经营；二是通过环境、社区及选址监管，让公众安心。 内阁要求数字经济与社会部建立“TH-DC数据看板”，公开泰国数据中心的数量及位置，并依据国际标准，以用电功率作为分类依据。过去，银行、企业、应用程序及社交媒体的数据存储设施，均被统称为数据中心。 对于新增投资，审批将不再仅看投资金额，还将考虑就业创造、泰国劳动力技能提升、泰国民众收入增长、与本国产业供应链的衔接，以及清洁能源使用情况。政府将参考新加坡做法，要求投资者就创造就业、引进科技和人工智能供应链等提出竞争性方案。新项目须接受全面评估，包括环境影响、水电使用效率以及对整体经济的贡献。 按用电功率划分七级 泰国国家经济与社会发展委员会秘书长、数据中心经营政策委员会秘书达努查介绍，监管范围涵盖用电功率0.5兆瓦及以上的项目。低于这一规模的设施通常设于机构或银行内部，影响范围较小。具体分为七级： 第1级：低于0.5兆瓦 第2级：0.5兆瓦至低于5兆瓦 第3级：5兆瓦至低于10兆瓦 第4级：10兆瓦至低于20兆瓦 第5级：20兆瓦至低于50兆瓦 第6级：50兆瓦至低于200兆瓦 第7级：200兆瓦及以上 达努查表示，20兆瓦及以上项目将受到更严格监管。低于20兆瓦的第2至第4级项目，须遵守环境操作规范（CoP），包括噪声、温度及用电效率等要求，具体细则将进一步公开征求意见。选址方面，低于20兆瓦的项目可设于商业用地；20兆瓦及以上项目只能设于工业用地。 规范环境操作，明确过渡安排 关于环境影响评价报告（EIA），达努查解释，一般数据中心主要是在建筑内安装服务器、计算机及空调系统，按照EIA判定原则，不属于产生严重环境影响的项目，因此通常无须单独开展EIA。不过，CoP将规定：停电时启用备用发电机，项目围栏边界处噪声不得超过70分贝；建筑周边温度升幅不得超过约1至2摄氏度；循环冷却系统排水前须控制水质；如项目位于工业园区内，须遵守该园区EIA要求。 过渡期内，对2026年8月14日相关规定刊登
title_cn: 泰国内阁批准数据中心行业监管新规：0.5兆瓦及以上项目纳入审批许可管理
summary_cn: 泰国内阁批准了数据中心行业监管政策，覆盖0.5兆瓦及以上项目。政策旨在规范快速增长的数据中心行业，解决此前各部门分散审批导致的问题。新监管框架包括一站式服务中心、审核委员会，按用电功率分为七级，实行差异化管理。20兆瓦及以上项目需设于工业用地并接受更严格审查，涉及环保、社区影响等多方面评估。政府希望通过统一规则，既为投资者提供确定性，又通过监管保护公众利益。

title_cn: 泰国人储蓄能力强但退休后难以富足？低息存款陷阱与职业年金困境
summary_cn: KKP研究所指出，泰国人退休后面临的核心问题不仅是储蓄不足，更重要的是缺乏投资理财技能以应对通胀压力。随着国民平均寿命延长，单纯依靠储蓄和职业年金 PVD 基金可能难以维系晚年生活，因为银行存款利率极低、基金增值幅度有限。这提示泰国民众需要学习更多投资知识。

title: Khon Kaen University first-year student recognised by NASA for cybersecurity work
desc: Khon Kaen University first-year student recognised by NASA for cybersecurity work Legacy A first-year Thai cybersecurity student at Khon Kaen University received a letter of recognition from NASA after identifying and responsibly reporting a security vulnerability in the US space agency’s information systems. Khon Kaen University announced that Thanaphon Butsrisicha, a student in the Cybersecurity programme at its College of Computing, had received an official letter of appreciation dated November 5, 2026. He is also known online by the alias nullbyt3z. According to the university, NASA recognised Thanaphon’s contribution to maintaining the integrity and availability of its space information systems. Thanaphon identified a Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability, a type of security weakness that can allow malicious code to be inserted into web pages. He reported the issue through NASA’s Vulnerability Disclosure Policy (VDP). The university’s College of Computing described his approach as responsible disclosure, a standard practice in cybersecurity that involves reporting vulnerabilities directly to the system owner in accordance with established procedures.
title_cn: 孔敬大学 Khon Kaen 一年级学生因网络安全工作获NASA表彰
summary_cn: 孔敬大学网络安全专业一年级学生 Thanaphon Butsrisicha（网名 nullbyt3z）因发现并负责任地报告美国航空航天局 NASA 信息系统中的跨站脚本 XSS 安全漏洞而获得官方表扬信。该学生通过 NASA 漏洞披露政策进行了规范的负责任披露，体现了专业的安全伦理。此成就对于同龄学生而言属罕见，展现了泰国年轻人的技术潜力。

title: Chinese tourists skip Thailand as safety concerns persist
desc: Chinese tourists skip Thailand as safety concerns persist Legacy Chinese tourist arrivals in Thailand fell in October despite China’s Golden Week holiday , with concerns over safety and recent flooding in Bangkok cited as possible reasons for the decline. Thailand welcomed 308,942 Chinese visitors during the month, down 13.6% from October 2025 and below the 349,182 arrivals recorded in September 2026, according to Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) figures. The decline came despite China’s National Day holiday, known as Golden Week, which is traditionally one of the busiest periods for Chinese residents travelling overseas. Safety concerns were identified as one factor affecting travel sentiment after the Chinese Embassy in Thailand issued an advisory on October 16, urging Chinese nationals to plan their journeys carefully and take precautions when travelling and using transport services. The warning followed several reported kidnappings involving Chinese nationals . The embassy also advised influencers and entertainers to be cautious of high-paying job offers in Thailand that could be linked to transnational criminal networks. Photo via Magnific The South China Mornin
title_cn: 中国游客因安全顾虑减少赴泰，同比下跌逾一成
summary_cn: 10月中国游客赴泰人数同比下降13.6%至约31万人，虽逢中国「国庆黄金周」期间仍未见增长。下滑与中国驻泰使馆10月16日发布的安全提醒相关，该提醒针对多起涉中国公民的绑架案件发出警告，并提醒赴泰者防范跨国犯罪网络。曼谷近期洪水也被列为可能影响游客出行意愿的因素。

title: Thai Airways faces complaints after Munich-Bangkok flight operated without running water
desc: Thai Airways faces complaints after Munich-Bangkok flight operated without running water Legacy Thai Airways drew mixed reactions online after a passenger experienced a flight from Munich to Bangkok without running water in the aircraft’s lavatory. International aviation blog LoyaltyLobby shared a photograph of a drinking water bottle placed on a lavatory counter yesterday, November 9, claiming that a reader had encountered another Thai Airways flight without running water on the Munich-Bangkok route. The bottle appeared to have been provided by cabin crew for passengers to wash their hands after using the toilet. A handwritten note was attached, although its message was difficult to read. LoyaltyLobby did not provide the flight date or number, and the extent of the reported water outage was unclear. Thai Airways had not publicly commented on the incident at the time of reporting. Photo via Facebook/ LoyaltyLobby The photograph prompted mixed reactions from social media users. title: Thailand puts 10 border provinces on alert over Myanmar fighting
desc: Thailand puts 10 border provinces on alert over Myanmar fighting Legacy Thailand has ordered 10 provinces along the Myanmar border to step up security and preparations after bullets and shell fragments from fighting in Myanmar crossed into Mae Sot district, Tak, damaging homes and property. The Interior Ministry announced the measures yesterday, November 9, as clashes between Myanmar military forces and resistance groups continued near Phalu village on the Myanmar side of the border. Unsit Sampuntharat, permanent secretary of the Interior Ministry, said governors had been told to work with the military, police and local officials to monitor the situation and protect residents. The order covers Kanchanaburi, Chumphon, Chiang Rai, Chiang Mai, Prachuap Khiri Khan, Phetchaburi, Tak, Mae Hong Son, Ranong and Ratchaburi. Governors have been instructed to coordinate through provincial border command centres and report any serious incidents or significant developments to the ministry for further action. title_cn: 泰国10个边境省份因缅甸交战进入警戒状态
summary_cn: 泰国内政部11月9日下令10个缅甸边境省份提高安全防备。此前缅甸军队与反抗组织在坦克府(Tak)边界附近交战，子弹和炮弹碎片穿过国境，击中民居和财产。各府长被指示与军警协调，监控局势、保护居民，并通过省级边境指挥中心报告重大事件。防备措施覆盖北碧、春蓬、清莱等战略位置。
desc_original: Thailand puts 10 border provinces on alert over Myanmar fighting Legacy Thailand has ordered 10 provinces along the Myanmar border to step up security and preparations after bullets and shell fragments from fighting in Myanmar crossed into Mae Sot district, Tak, damaging homes and property. The Interior Ministry announced the measures yesterday, November 9, as clashes between Myanmar military forces and resistance groups continued near Phalu village on the Myanmar side of the border. Unsit Sampuntharat, permanent secretary of the Interior Ministry, said governors had been told to work with the military, police and local officials to monitor the situation and protect residents. The order covers Kanchanaburi, Chumphon, Chiang Rai, Chiang Mai, Prachuap Khiri Khan, Phetchaburi, Tak, Mae Hong Son, Ranong and Ratchaburi. Governors have been instructed to coordinate through provincial border command centres and report any serious incidents or significant developments to the ministry for further action. title: Thai news anchor calls for probe into Watchdog Thailand finances
desc: Thai news anchor calls for probe into Watchdog Thailand finances Legacy A Thai television news anchor called for an investigation into the finances of the animal welfare foundation Watchdog Thailand (WDT) , alleging that some members may have used donations for personal benefit. A former WDT president filed a defamation complaint against the anchor, denying the allegations. The news anchor, Narakorn Tiyayon, raised the issue in a Facebook post on November 9, calling for an examination of the foundation’s financial transactions. She said she had heard allegations that the president, board members and treasurer had used donations for personal purposes. Her post followed the arrest of former beauty queen Panadda Wongphudee and her husband over allegations that they misused donations to the Ongkorn Tham Dee Foundation for personal benefit. The case involving Ongkorn Tham Dee is separate from the allegations concerning WDT. Narakorn’s post attracted comments from social media users, some of whom called for WDT’s spending to be examined. Others shared accounts of their experiences seeking assistance from the foundation. Narakorn | Photo via Facebook/ นารากร ติยายน A wom
title_cn: 泰国新闻主播呼吁调查「泰国看门狗」基金会财务
