title: Game industry act faces major revisions
desc: The draft amendment of the Game Industry Promotion Act is back to square one as it faces major revisions, raising concerns over further delays to the law's implementation.
title_cn: 泰国游戏产业促进法面临重大修订
summary_cn: 泰国《游戏产业促进法》修订草案进度受阻，需进行重大调整，现已回到立法初期阶段。法律多次延期实施引发业界担忧。该法案目的是规范游戏产业发展、促进泰国数字产业增长。反复修订反映出政府、产业和监管部门在法案细节上存在分歧。
desc_original: The draft amendment of the Game Industry Promotion Act is back to square one as it faces major revisions, raising concerns over further delays to the law's implementation.

title: Luxury travel demand boosts hotels in Southeast Asia
desc: Southeast Asia remains a growth pillar for luxury travel amid the ongoing Middle East crisis as more travellers shift to the region, including Thailand, viewing it as a safe haven, according to global hospitality brand Accor.
title_cn: 奢华旅游需求推动东南亚酒店业增长
summary_cn: 全球酒店集团雅高(Accor)数据显示，受中东地缘政治局势影响，国际游客转向东南亚，将该地区视为安全旅游目的地。泰国作为东南亚主要旅游枢纽，因高端游客涌入而酒店业受益明显。这一趋势为泰国旅游业、酒店和相关服务业带来增长机遇，也反映出国际社会对泰国安全稳定的认可。
desc_original: Southeast Asia remains a growth pillar for luxury travel amid the ongoing Middle East crisis as more travellers shift to the region, including Thailand, viewing it as a safe haven, according to global hospitality brand Accor.

title: Eppo advances EV use in state sector
desc: The Energy Policy and Planning Office (Eppo) has laid out a roadmap to introduce electric vehicles (EVs) and charging stations across government agencies, describing it as a crucial step towards clean energy and the country's net-zero emissions target.
title_cn: 泰国推进政府部门电动车普及计划
summary_cn: 泰国能源政策规划办公室(Eppo)制定路线图，计划在全国政府机构推广电动汽车和充电基础设施。这被列为泰国实现清洁能源转型和碳中和目标的关键举措。政府部门率先采购电动车，不仅推动公共交通绿色升级，还将带动汽车产业链发展，扩大本地新能源产业规模。
desc_original: The Energy Policy and Planning Office (Eppo) has laid out a roadmap to introduce electric vehicles (EVs) and charging stations across government agencies, describing it as a crucial step towards clean energy and the country's net-zero emissions target.

title: Industrial depth anchors Thailand's edge
desc: Thailand's industrial systems and seasoned workforce are its strongest competitive advantages as companies look to diversify production across Southeast Asia.
title_cn: 泰国产业深度成就区域竞争优势
summary_cn: 跨国企业在东南亚寻求生产多元化之际，泰国完善的产业体系和技能娴熟的劳动力成为其最强竞争力。泰国制造业产业链完整、产业配套齐全、技术积累深厚，是跨国公司理想的生产基地。这一优势有利于吸引制造业投资，巩固泰国作为东南亚制造业枢纽的地位。
desc_original: Thailand's industrial systems and seasoned workforce are its strongest competitive advantages as companies look to diversify production across Southeast Asia.

title: Ageing Thais put pressure on creaking pension system
desc: Thailand's social security system is becoming increasingly inadequate to support its rapidly ageing population, with people over 60 projected to account for a third of the population over the next 25 years, according to Kiatnakin Phatra Financial Group (KKP).
title_cn: 老龄化挑战泰国养老金制度
summary_cn: 泰国人口老龄化加剧，社会保障体系不堪重负。根据 Kiatnakin Phatra 金融集团预测，未来25年内60岁以上人口将占全国人口三分之一，现有养老金制度将面临巨大财政压力。这一人口结构变化对国家养老金体系的可持续性构成严峻挑战，需要启动系统性改革。
desc_original: Thailand's social security system is becoming increasingly inadequate to support its rapidly ageing population, with people over 60 projected to account for a third of the population over the next 25 years, according to Kiatnakin Phatra Financial Group (KKP).

title: Committee greenlights TAT's proposals
desc: The National Tourism Policy Committee has approved the Tourism Authority of Thailand's (TAT) proposal to seek visa exemptions for Mexican and Colombian visitors staying for under 30 days, while also endorsing the fourth National Tourism Development Plan, which targets 4 trillion baht in tourism revenue in 2032 and a top-30 ranking in the global Travel & Tourism Development Index (TTDI).
title_cn: 泰国旅游局提案获批，墨西哥等国将享免签待遇
summary_cn: 国家旅游政策委员会批准泰国旅游局 (TAT) 的两项重要提案。其一为墨西哥和哥伦比亚游客提供30天内免签便利；其二通过第四个国家旅游发展计划，目标2032年旅游收入达4万亿泰铢，力争跻身全球旅游竞争力排名前30。这些举措旨在吸引更多国际游客和提升泰国旅游产业竞争力。
desc_original: The National Tourism Policy Committee has approved the Tourism Authority of Thailand's (TAT) proposal to seek visa exemptions for Mexican and Colombian visitors staying for under 30 days, while also endorsing the fourth National Tourism Development Plan, which targets 4 trillion baht in tourism revenue in 2032 and a top-30 ranking in the global Travel & Tourism Development Index (TTDI).

title: Analysts see benefits from US midterms
desc: Today's US midterm elections could benefit Thailand and global trade, as stronger checks and balances between Congress and President Donald Trump could reduce US policy uncertainty and ease market volatility, analysts say.
title_cn: 美国中期选举利好全球贸易
summary_cn: 经济分析师普遍看好美国中期选举对泰国和全球贸易的拉动作用。国会制衡下的政策不确定性有望大幅下降，市场波动相应缓解，为出口导向的泰国提供更加稳定清晰的国际贸易预期，利好东南亚新兴市场的经济增长。
desc_original: Today's US midterm elections could benefit Thailand and global trade, as stronger checks and balances between Congress and President Donald Trump could reduce US policy uncertainty and ease market volatility, analysts say.

title: Solar scheme promises savings, but at what cost?
desc: The government's Solar for the People scheme offers households subsidies of up to 50,000 baht to install solar power systems, but consumers should weigh installation costs, eligibility requirements and potential savings before signing up.
title_cn: 「人民太阳能」计划补贴丰厚但需谨慎评估
summary_cn: 泰国政府推出「人民太阳能」补贴计划，为合格家庭最高补助5万泰铢用于太阳能系统安装。尽管该计划承诺长期电费节省，消费者在报名前仍需谨慎评估实际安装成本、个人资格要求和本地真实节能收益等因素，避免盲目跟风。
desc_original: The government's Solar for the People scheme offers households subsidies of up to 50,000 baht to install solar power systems, but consumers should weigh installation costs, eligibility requirements and potential savings before signing up.

title: Graft claims cast doubt on solar scheme
desc: The People's Party has called for an investigation into alleged irregularities in the government's 50-billion-baht household solar scheme, including suspected collusion among contractors and alleged kickbacks of 30,000 baht per installation.
title_cn: 「人民太阳能」计划被指贪腐，人民党要求彻查
summary_cn: 泰国人民党要求调查政府500亿泰铢「人民太阳能」方案涉嫌的贪腐问题，包括承包商之间可能存在的勾结串通以及每个安装项目涉嫌3万泰铢的回扣。该事件引发外界对计划合规性、廉政建设和资金去向的广泛关注和质疑。
desc_original: The People's Party has called for an investigation into alleged irregularities in the government's 50-billion-baht household solar scheme, including suspected collusion among contractors and alleged kickbacks of 30,000 baht per installation.

title: Roblox chooses Thailand for AI game developer launch
desc: Thailand is one of four countries selected by Roblox for the initial rollout of Build, an artificial intelligence-powered game creation tool, as the company taps local creativity to help more users develop games and pursue commercial opportunities on its platform.
title_cn: Roblox 在泰国启动 AI 游戏开发者工具
summary_cn: 泰国成为 Roblox 选中的四个国家之一，将推出 AI 游戏创作工具 Build，帮助更多用户开发游戏并在平台上获取商业机会。该项目将发掘本地创意，促进游戏产业发展。
desc_original: Thailand is one of four countries selected by Roblox for the initial rollout of Build, an artificial intelligence-powered game creation tool, as the company taps local creativity to help more users develop games and pursue commercial opportunities on its platform.

title: Cabinet to weigh B78.5bn development plan for Isan
desc: The mobile cabinet meeting in Udon Thani on Tuesday will consider 170 development projects worth more than 78.5 billion baht, covering agriculture, border trade, tourism and drug suppression across five northeastern provinces.
title_cn: 泰国政府审议伊桑地区 78.5 亿泰铢发展计划
summary_cn: 泰国政府流动内阁将在乌隆府 Udon Thani 召开会议，审议涉及 170 个发展项目的 78.5 亿泰铢投资计划。该计划覆盖农业、边境贸易、旅游和毒品防控等领域，涵盖东北地区五个省份，旨在推动区域经济发展。
desc_original: The mobile cabinet meeting in Udon Thani on Tuesday will consider 170 development projects worth more than 78.5 billion baht, covering agriculture, border trade, tourism and drug suppression across five northeastern provinces.

title: Amnesty clause may aid Thaksin's bid for B46bn
desc: A clause in the new amnesty law could give former prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra a route to challenge convictions and seek the return of 46 billion baht in seized assets, a political scientist has warned.
title_cn: 新大赦法条款可能助他信追回 46 亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国新颁大赦法中的某项条款可能为前总理他信 Thaksin Shinawatra 创造法律途径，质疑既有定罪并寻求追回被冻结的 46 亿泰铢资产。政治学家就此提出警告，指出法律漏洞可能产生的政治影响。
desc_original: A clause in the new amnesty law could give former prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra a route to challenge convictions and seek the return of 46 billion baht in seized assets, a political scientist has warned.

title: Experts urge deeper ties with Japan

title: Kanchanaburi Power coach and player report racist remarks
desc: Kanchanaburi Power coach and player report racist remarks Legacy Kanchanaburi Power’s South Korean head coach and Madagascan striker faced racist remarks after their Thai League 2 match against Pattaya United on September 1. The match, held at Nong Prue Municipal Stadium in Pattaya, ended in a 2-2 draw. The result left Kanchanaburi Power, also known as Palang Kan, in sixth place, while Pattaya United remained 15th and at risk of relegation. The alleged incident happened as Kanchanaburi Power coach Park Han-seo was walking towards the dressing room after the match. A group of fans, believed to support Pattaya United, reportedly shouted insults at him, including “kimchi” and other rude words in Thai and English. Photo via Facebook/ ASEAN FOOTBALL The Madagaskan player, John Baggio, also reported being insulted after the game. The striker said people shouted “monkey” and “short” at him. Videos shared by Thai news agencies showed the two Kanchanaburi Power members appearing angry and moving towards the group. Other team members and stadium staff intervened and escorted them into the dressing room. The incident did not escalate further. Baggio later addressed the incident on social medi

title: Thailand’s EV boom makes cars easier to buy, harder to insure
desc: Thailand’s EV boom makes cars easier to buy, harder to insure Legacy Thailand’s switch to electric vehicles (EVs) is moving fast, but insuring them is becoming more complex, according to the founder of Roojai Group. Nicolas Faquet, CEO and founder of Roojai Group, says rising fuel prices, geopolitical uncertainty and changing consumer priorities are driving the shift. title: Chinese passenger caught with 8,900 weight loss pens at Suvarnabhumi Airport
desc: Chinese passenger caught with 8,900 weight loss pens at Suvarnabhumi Airport Legacy Customs officers at Suvarnabhumi International Airport seized 8,900 illegal weight-loss injection pens from a Chinese passenger arriving from Bangladesh on October 31. The Customs Department reported the arrest on its official Facebook page on November 1. Officials said the pens were found in two suitcases, with the estimated value being more than 5.34 million baht. Santhani Phairattanakorn, an officer at the airport’s passenger inspection office, said the pens contained GLP-1 injections, which are controlled in Thailand as a special-category drug. She said the products were not registered and had no approval from the Food and Drug Administration. Photo via Facebook/ กรมศุลกากร : The Customs Department The department said bringing the items into Thailand violated the Customs Act and the Drug Act. The passenger was reportedly in police custody for legal proceedings. The Facebook post did not specify the charges or possible penalties. title: 泰警方截获超3万发AK-47步枪子弹 逮捕5名泰柬籍嫌疑人
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月2日，泰国中央调查警察局（CIB）下属水警指挥部联合泰国海军情报局，在达叻府Khao Saming县Welu河附近展开行动，抓获5名嫌疑人，其中4人为泰国籍，1人为柬埔寨籍。 警方同时查获多项涉案物品，具体如下： AK-47步枪子弹（7.62毫米）31880发，装在44个铁箱内，每箱装有720发。 AK-47步枪子弹（7.62毫米）200发，以及3根疑似发射药柱的物品。相关物品装在一个铁箱内。疑似发射药柱的物品为绿色PVC管状物，宽约2英寸、长约12英寸。 船只1艘：白色无名、无登记编号的快艇，配备两台本田（HONDA）115马力舷外发动机。 手机2部。 初步讯问中，负责驾驶船只的嫌疑人供称，他受一名男子雇用，对方要求他驾驶船只前往接载柬埔寨籍人员及货物，接载的具体物品是什么，他并不知情。届时会有一艘来自柬埔寨一侧的长尾木船，将人员和货物运送过来。双方约定的接头地点位于达叻府阁骨岛附近的海域中央，处于泰国领海范围内。 完成人员和货物接收后，他需要将船只驶往达叻府考沙明县Welu河沿岸的一处天然码头停靠。随后，执法人员对船只进行检查，并将涉案人员抓获。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：pptvhd36） The post 泰警方截获超3万发AK-47步枪子弹 逮捕5名泰柬籍嫌疑人 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: JAYLERR、BILLKIN再度合作！全新单曲《Golden Retriever》上线
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 泰国歌手JAYLERR与BILLKIN时隔六年再度携手合作，推出全新单曲《Golden Retriever》。歌曲于10月28日正式上线各大音乐平台，官方音乐录影带（MV）也同步在JAYLERR的YouTube官方频道首播。这是JAYLERR个人专辑《JLR》推出的第四支单曲。 两人上一次合作是在六年前。当时，JAYLERR为BILLKIN的歌曲《กอดในใจ》（《心中的拥抱》）担任合作演唱嘉宾，以音乐传递思念与牵挂。此次新作则以更加轻快、活泼的风格，描绘恋爱中的陪伴与依恋，展现两人不同于以往的音乐表达。 《Golden Retriever》由Achariya Dulyapaiboon与Prateep Siriissranan共同创作词曲，融合流行音乐与R&B元素，以轻快的节奏和朗朗上口的旋律，营造出轻松甜蜜的氛围。 歌曲以金毛犬对主人的忠诚与依恋为灵感，将恋爱中的一方比作热情、黏人又毫无保留付出的金毛犬，表达爱上一个人后，即使是平凡的日常，也会因为对方的存在而变得特别。作品通过这一充满亲和力的意象，传递关于陪伴、思念与纯粹情感的主题。 此次MV由泰国电影《天才枪手》导演Baz Nattawut Poonpiriya与新生代MV导演Prang联合执导，在视觉呈现上融入幽默、浪漫与超现实元素。 MV以“金毛系男友”为创意核心。JAYLERR与BILLKIN在宣传视觉中分别穿上浅奶白色和深棕色的金毛犬玩偶服，以夸张可爱的造型呈现角色设定。另一组宣传画面中，JAYLERR手持写有“MISSING YOU SO MUCH”（非常想念你）的手写纸牌，生动呈现恋爱中因思念而产生的情绪。 MV正片则通过一系列生活化场景，展现角色在等待与重逢之间的情绪变化。从主人离开后的失落、独自等待时的落寞，到听见熟悉的声音后瞬间兴奋，以及重逢时难以掩饰的喜悦，作品借鉴金毛犬对主人依恋的行为特征，将恋爱中的思念与亲密感转化为直观的视觉表达。 在镜头设计上，导演将电影感的画面与夸张幽默的表现方式相结合。部分画面采用鱼眼镜头效果，呈现两人在卧室自拍、草地上玩飞盘以及窝在沙发里吃零食等日常场景，营造出轻松随性的氛围。 整体而言，《Golden Retriever》以明快的音乐风格和充满趣味的MV创意，将金毛犬忠诚、热情的特质与恋爱中的陪伴需求相结合。歌曲既延续了JAYLERR与BILLKIN合作时的默契，也通过更加轻松俏皮的表达，为听众带来一首关于亲密关系与纯粹情感的流行作品。 目前，《Golden Retriever》已在Apple Music、Spotify、QQ音乐等音乐平台上线，MV可通过JAYLERR的YouTube官方频道观看。 收听与观看渠道： 歌曲收听： Apple Music、Spotify、QQ音乐等音乐平台 MV观看： YouTube搜索JAY

title: Food delivery rider sets off fire alarm after getting stuck inside condo
desc: Food delivery rider sets off fire alarm after getting stuck inside condo Legacy A food delivery rider reportedly set off a condominium’s fire alarm after being unable to leave the building following a late-night delivery, prompting residents to evacuate in the middle of the night. A resident, who posts on TikTok as @kanitta0402 , shared footage of people gathered outside the building in their pyjamas. She said the incident happened at about 12.45am on Friday, October 30. Kanitta said the rider entered the condominium to deliver an order, despite a table being available outside for deliveries. The building’s entrance and exit require a keycard, but the rider was able to enter because the door had been left open, she said. Photo via TikTok/ @kanitta0402 According to Kanitta, the rider could not get out and was unable to contact the customer. He then pressed the fire alarm, waking residents and prompting them to leave the building. title: Thai motorists may get cash to scrap ageing vehicles
desc: Thai motorists may get cash to scrap ageing vehicles Legacy Thailand’s Excise Department is seeking 6 billion baht for a pickup trade-in scheme offering 40,000 baht to eligible motorists who scrap older vehicles , aiming to reduce PM2.5 pollution and revive the struggling domestic automotive market . The proposed nationwide programme would support the replacement of 150,000 ageing vehicles with new, locally manufactured pickups or pickup-based passenger vehicles (PPVs). According to Thansettakij, which cited a Finance Ministry source today, November 2, the department has requested funding under the government’s 2026 borrowing programme to begin implementing the scheme in 2027. Under the proposal, only Thai nationals aged 20 or above would qualify. Each participant could surrender one eligible vehicle in exchange for financial assistance towards one new vehicle. The old vehicle must have been registered before 2012 and may be a private passenger car, a passenger vehicle carrying more than seven people or a privately registered goods vehicle. title: Sublime Samui Villas pairs island stays with local concierge team
desc: Sublime Samui Villas pairs island stays with local concierge team Legacy Holidaymakers looking for private villas in Koh Samui can choose from a collection managed by Sublime Samui Villas, with local staff on hand from airport arrival to departure. title: Former boy band singer drives pickup into Chai Nat walking street
desc: Former boy band singer drives pickup into Chai Nat walking street Legacy A former member of the boy band group, BKK, drove a pickup truck through a crowded walking street in Chai Nat, injuring three people and damaging vehicles and shops, before leaving the scene. Footage shared on Thai social media showed vendors and visitors on Chai Narong Road in Nai Mueang subdistrict looking on in alarm as the pickup moved through the walking street. Several parked vehicles appeared damaged. Channel 7 reported that the incident happened at about 6.30pm on October 30. The pickup first hit a parked vehicle near the residence of the Chai Nat provincial governor before continuing into the walking street, where it struck visitors and parked vehicles. Three people were injured. Six vehicles were damaged, including one pickup truck, two sedans and three motorcycles. Shops along the street were also damaged. Volunteers from the Ruamkatanyu Foundation took the injured to Chai Nat Narenthorn Hospital. Photo via Matichon The pickup left the scene and was later found at a petrol station about 15 kilometres away. Its front end was badly damaged. The driver was identified as 45 year old former BKK singer Je
title_cn: 前男团成员驾皮卡冲进拍耶府夜市 致3人伤
summary_cn: 一名45岁的前BKK男团成员于10月30日傍晚6时30分左右，驾驶皮卡车在拍耶府 Chai Nat 的纳伊穆安 Nai Mueang 区夜市冲撞，造成3人受伤，6辆车及多家商铺受损。该皮卡先撞击拍耶府省长官邸附近停泊的车辆，随后冲入夜市继续造成碰撞。肇事车辆随后逃离现场，于约15公里外的加油站被发现，前端严重受损。

title: 中国驻泰国大使馆回应赴泰安全提醒：系预防性保护措施，并非针对泰国
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 中国驻泰国大使馆就近期发布的《提醒赴泰国中国公民提高安全防范意识》作出回应：该提醒属于预防性保护措施，并非针对泰国。使馆方面称，发布提醒的背景是近期有多名中国公民在泰国失踪或受到伤害，相关情况在中国国内社交媒体上引发广泛担忧。 使馆介绍，其每天接到超过十通来自失踪人员家属或滞留在泰中国公民的求助电话，保护本国公民安全与合法权益是使馆无法回避的职责。使馆因此提醒中国公民提高警惕、采取防范措施，避免成为犯罪分子的受害者。 中国驻泰国大使张建卫表示，中方了解这些案件与复杂的跨国犯罪网络有关，并赞赏泰国政府和警方在协助滞留中国公民方面所作的大量努力，以及泰国打击电信诈骗等跨国犯罪的决心和行动。中方愿与泰方进一步加强合作，共同打击跨国犯罪，维护良好旅游氛围和两国民众安全。 他还表示，在双方共同努力下，中泰一定能够共同打击犯罪，为中国游客赴泰旅游安全提供更有力的保障；中方乐见更多中国游客赴泰旅游，同时也欢迎更多泰国游客前往中国。他认为，两国民众密切往来将增进相互理解与友谊，使“中泰一家亲”的情谊代代相传。 （来源：The Nation Thailand） The post 中国驻泰国大使馆回应赴泰安全提醒：系预防性保护措施，并非针对泰国 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 中国驻泰大使馆澄清安全警示：属预防性措施，并非针对泰国
summary_cn: 中国驻泰大使馆就近日发布的赴泰安全提醒作出说明。使馆指出，该提醒属于预防性保护措施，并非针对泰国。近期多名中国公民在泰国失踪或受害，使馆每日接收数十通求助电话。大使张建卫表示，相关案件与跨国犯罪网络有关，中方赞赏泰国政府的配合努力。两国将进一步加强协作，共同打击跨国犯罪，为游客提供更安全的环境，促进「中泰一家亲」的民间往来。

title: 从非法减肥针到毒品走私 10月底泰海关非法进口涉案超1252万泰铢
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷与副总理兼财政部长艾尼提宣布，政府将加快推进海关部门与执法机构的协作，加强执法力度，严厉打击各类非法进口行为，包括走私违禁商品、不符合标准的商品以及毒品等，重点加强对航空口岸、民营快递运输渠道及边境口岸的监管，维护国家经济安全和公众健康。 泰国海关厅厅长潘通与海关系统管控发展顾问南莉素达、海关税收管理发展与行政顾问育塔纳及海关厅副厅长顺丽雅等海关厅高管，已指示各地海关工作人员加强巡查和检查。2026年10月下旬，海关部门共查获4起案件，涉案金额超过1252万泰铢。 10月31日，素万那普机场旅客海关检查办公室主任颂妮透露，海关工作人员在一名从孟加拉国首都达卡抵达泰国的中国籍男性旅客携带的2件行李中发现大量减肥针，共计8900支，估值534万泰铢。上述减肥针属于需要特别管制的药品，涉案人员未经药品登记，也未取得泰国食品药品监督管理局许可，擅自将其带入泰国。其行为涉嫌违反《海关法（2017）》《药品法（2015）》及相关修订法律。海关部门已依法查扣相关物品，并将案件移交进一步处理。 另外，在东北部地区，海关厅第二地区海关办公室主任拉丽达表示，10月29日至31日，第二地区海关办公室联合东北部地区打击犯罪调查部门、警察第二地区调查部门及第一边境巡逻警察部队，对呵叻府境内民营运输公司的货物进行检查。 检查人员发现一批外国来源的香烟，未粘贴消费税税票，也没有合法进口至泰国的相关证明，共计3270条，即65.4万支，涉案金额超过327万泰铢。执法人员已将相关香烟扣押，作为走私货物案件的证据，并将依法追究责任。 在打击跨国毒品走私方面，泰国海关调查与打击犯罪部门负责人埃卡乌迪透露，10月30日，海关调查与打击犯罪部门联合AITF行动小组，对一批从英国运往泰国的紧急进口货物进行检查。该批货物申报为膳食补充剂，具体为必需氨基酸补充剂。 经详细检查，执法人员在补充剂胶囊内发现一类第一类毒品MDMA，总重量为485克，估值约291万泰铢。该批毒品涉嫌未经许可非法进口泰国，违反泰国毒品相关法律及《海关法（2017）》。海关部门已依法查扣货物，并将其移交调查人员，进一步追究法律责任。 在南部边境管控方面，Padang Besar海关口岸关长纳林透露，10月31日，在第四地区海关办公室主任披猜的监督下，Padang Besar海关与泰国陆军第二地区边境巡逻警察部队第5021连联合行动，对从泰马边境进入泰国的私人车辆进行检查。 检查人员在车辆尾部发现6台网络交换机，设备原产地为外国，价值超过100万泰铢。相关物品涉嫌未经海关手续申报而进口，违反《海关法（2017）》第242条及第252条。执法人员已依法扣押设备，并将涉案人员移交巴东勿刹海关进一步处理。 泰国海关部门表示，未来将继续开展持续性执法行动，严厉打击各类非法商品走私活动，同时
title_cn: 泰国海关严打走私 10月查获非法减肥针、毒品等涉案超1252万泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国政府加强海关与执法部门协作，严厉打击非法进口和走私活动。10月下旬，海关在四项执法行动中查获大量违禁品：素万那普机场查出8900支非法减肥针（534万泰铢）；东北部发现65.4万支无消费税票香烟（327万泰铢）；海关调查部门在来自英国的进口货物中查获485克一级毒品MDMA（291万泰铢）；南部边境查获6台走私网络交换机（100万泰铢）。泰国政府表示将继续开展执法，严打各类非法商品走私。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷与副总理兼财政部长艾尼提宣布，政府将加快推进海关部门与执法机构的协作，加强执法力度，严厉打击各类非法进口行为，包括走私违禁商品、不符合标准的商品以及毒品等，重点加强对航空口岸、民营快递运输渠道及边境口岸的监管，维护国家经济安全和公众健康。 泰国海关厅厅长潘通与海关系统管控发展顾问南莉素达、海关税收管理发展与行政顾问育塔纳及海关厅副厅长顺丽雅等海关厅高管，已指示各地海关工作人员加强巡查和检查。2026年10月下旬，海关部门共查获4起案件，涉案金额超过1252万泰铢。 10月31日，素万那普机场旅客海关检查办公室主任颂妮透露，海关工作人员在一名从孟加拉国首都达卡抵达泰国的中国籍男性旅客携带的2件行李中发现大量减肥针，共计8900支，估值534万泰铢。上述减肥针属于需要特别管制的药品，涉案人员未经药品登记，也未取得泰国食品药品监督管理局许可，擅自将其带入泰国。其行为涉嫌违反《海关法（2017）》《药品法（2015）》及相关修订法律。海关部门已依法查扣相关物品，并将案件移交进一步处理。 另外，在东北部地区，海关厅第二地区海关办公室主任拉丽达表示，10月29日至31日，第二地区海关办公室联合东北部地区打击犯罪调查部门、警察第二地区调查部门及第一边境巡逻警察部队，对呵叻府境内民营运输公司的货物进行检查。 检查人员发现一批外国来源的香烟，未粘贴消费税税票，也没有合法进口至泰国的相关证明，共计3270条，即65.4万支，涉案金额超过327万泰铢。执法人员已将相关香烟扣押，作为走私货物案件的证据，并将依法追究责任。 在打击跨国毒品走私方面，泰国海关调查与打击犯罪部门负责人埃卡乌迪透露，10月30日，海关调查与打击犯罪部门联合AITF行动小组，对一批从英国运往泰国的紧急进口货物进行检查。该批货物申报为膳食补充剂，具体为必需氨基酸补充剂。 经详细检查，执法人员在补充剂胶囊内发现一类第一类毒品MDMA，总重量为485克，估值约291万泰铢。该批毒品涉嫌未经许可非法进口泰国，违反泰国毒品相关法律及《海关法（2017）》。海关部门已依法查扣货物，并将其移交调查人员，进一步追究法律责任。 在南部边境管控方面，Padang Besar海关口岸关长纳林透露，10月31日，在第四地区海关办公室主任披猜的监督下，Padang Besar海关与泰国陆军第二地区边境巡逻警察部队第5021连联合行动，对从泰马边境进入泰国的私人车辆进行检查。 检查人员在车辆尾部发现6台网络交换机，设备原产地为外国，价值超过100万泰铢。相关物品涉嫌未经海关手续申报而进口，违反《海关法（2017）》第242条及第252条。执法人员已依法扣押设备，并将涉案人员移交巴东勿刹海关进一步处理。 泰国海关部门表示，未来将继续开展持续性执法行动，严厉打击各类非法商品走私活动，同时

title_cn: 泰国内贸部严审平台卖家资格 防止外商冒充本地商户
summary_cn: 泰国内贸部出台严格审查措施，规范在线商务平台商户准入，防止海外卖家冒充本地商户骗取中小企业扶持政策。符合条件的泰国商户可申请在三大电商平台获得费用优惠，截止日期为 11 月 1 日。此举旨在确保扶持政策精准惠及本地 SME。
desc_original: กรมการค้าภายใน ออกเกณฑ์เข้ม สกัดผู้ค้าและสินค้าต่างชาติ สวมสิทธิ์ ยื่นขอรับสิทธิ์ได้ส่วนลดค่าธรรมเนียมขายสินค้าบน 3 แพลตฟอร์มยักษ์ หวังให้ SME ไทยได้ประโยชน์ ดีเดย์ลงทะเบียน 1 พ.ย. นี้

title: Thailand eyes status as AI medical hub
desc: Thailand wants to become a regional artificial intelligence (AI) medical hub by developing AI models tailored to Southeast Asian populations and turning decades of clinical research into advances in precision medicine, drug discovery and cancer treatment.
title_cn: 泰国瞄准 AI 医疗枢纽地位
summary_cn: 泰国计划开发针对东南亚人群特征的 AI 医学模型，充分利用数十年临床研究积累的数据和经验，在精准医学、新药发现和癌症治疗等领域取得突破。此举旨在将泰国打造为东南亚 AI 医疗创新枢纽，强化国家在医疗产业中的竞争力。
desc_original: Thailand wants to become a regional artificial intelligence (AI) medical hub by developing AI models tailored to Southeast Asian populations and turning decades of clinical research into advances in precision medicine, drug discovery and cancer treatment.

title: Rice exports face mounting headwinds
desc: Thailand's rice exports are expected to miss the target of 7 million tonnes this year, even as shipments to Asian markets surge.
title_cn: 泰国稻米出口面临增长压力
summary_cn: 泰国今年稻米出口预计将低于 700 万吨的年度目标，尽管亚洲市场订单保持增长势头。这反映了全球供应链重组、国际市场竞争加剧以及价格波动等多重因素对泰国农业出口的冲击。作为全球最大稻米出口国，此数据表明泰国农业面临的严峻挑战。
desc_original: Thailand's rice exports are expected to miss the target of 7 million tonnes this year, even as shipments to Asian markets surge.

title: Small firms look for state assistance in AI campaign
desc: Small businesses have called for subsidies, clinics to help them adopt small versions of artificial intelligence (AI), and preventive measures to mitigate potential risks.
title_cn: 泰国小企业寻求政府助力推进 AI 应用
summary_cn: 泰国中小企业纷纷呼吁政府出台扶持政策，包括提供 AI 采购补贴、建立技术咨询服务机构，帮助企业采用小型 AI 解决方案。同时企业界建议政府制定风险防控措施，应对 AI 应用可能带来的法律和安全隐患。这反映了企业界对政府支持的迫切需求。
desc_original: Small businesses have called for subsidies, clinics to help them adopt small versions of artificial intelligence (AI), and preventive measures to mitigate potential risks.

title: Betting big on small AI
desc: Thailand is keen to leverage small artificial intelligence (AI) to create a big impact in many sectors.
title_cn: 泰国力推小型 AI 创造大效能
summary_cn: 泰国政府将小型 AI 技术视为推动多个行业产业变革的关键动力，计划在制造、农业、服务、医疗等领域广泛应用，以实现显著的经济效益和社会效益。这一战略体现了泰国加快数字化转型步伐、抢占 AI 发展先机的坚定决心，也是泰国 4.0 发展计划的重要组成部分。
desc_original: Thailand is keen to leverage small artificial intelligence (AI) to create a big impact in many sectors.

title: Foundation faces B1m query
desc: The Be One Foundation is facing scrutiny over allegations that about 1 million baht was transferred from its accounts to personal accounts belonging to its founder, Chalida Phalamat, and her family.
title_cn: Be One 基金会面临百万泰铢资金审查
summary_cn: 慈善机构 Be One 基金会正面临严重的财务监管审查，创始人 Chalida Phalamat 及其家族成员涉嫌将约 100 万泰铢从基金会账户非法转移至个人账户。此案涉及财务透明度、法律责任和公益资金使用规范，引发对泰国慈善组织监管的广泛关注。
desc_original: The Be One Foundation is facing scrutiny over allegations that about 1 million baht was transferred from its accounts to personal accounts belonging to its founder, Chalida Phalamat, and her family.

title: Fresh crackdown on illegal dumping
desc: The government has launched a coordinated crackdown on illegal electronic and industrial waste disposal, deploying 50 inspection teams to examine factories while tightening import controls and reviewing penalties for offenders.
title_cn: 打击非法废弃物倾倒 泰政府部署50支检查队
summary_cn: 泰国政府正式启动针对电子及工业废物非法处置的协调打击行动，部署50支检查队伍对工厂进行全面检查，同时加强进口管制，并审查现有的违法处罚措施。这一举措旨在防止有害废物对环境造成污染，保护生态环保。
desc_original: The government has launched a coordinated crackdown on illegal electronic and industrial waste disposal, deploying 50 inspection teams to examine factories while tightening import controls and reviewing penalties for offenders.

title: Robot used in new heart surgery
desc: Rajavithi Hospital has become the first hospital under the Ministry of Public Health to perform minimally invasive, multi-vessel coronary artery bypass surgery using robotic assistance.
title_cn: 曼谷医院首次采用机器人进行心脏搭桥手术
summary_cn: 拉查维蒂医院（Rajavithi Hospital）成为泰国公共卫生部辖下首家采用机器人辅助进行微创多血管冠状动脉搭桥手术的医院。该手术技术突破为患者提供了更安全、更微创的治疗方案，代表泰国心脏外科技术的重要进步。
desc_original: Rajavithi Hospital has become the first hospital under the Ministry of Public Health to perform minimally invasive, multi-vessel coronary artery bypass surgery using robotic assistance.

title: Nation slips in rule of law rank
desc: Thailand fell three places to 80th in the 2026 World Justice Project Rule of Law Index, with corruption and weak law enforcement among its primary concerns.
title_cn: 泰国法治指数排名下滑至第80位
summary_cn: 泰国在2026年世界正义项目法治指数中的排名下滑3名至第80位。腐败现象严重和执法力度不足被确认为泰国法治建设面临的主要问题，这一排名变化反映了泰国在法律体系建设方面仍需进一步改进。
desc_original: Thailand fell three places to 80th in the 2026 World Justice Project Rule of Law Index, with corruption and weak law enforcement among its primary concerns.

title: Anutin invites Thais to invest in Bhutan
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul is urging Thai businesses to help develop Bhutan's Gelephu Mindfulness City (GMC), a planned economic hub, as Thailand seeks to expand trade and investment ties with the Himalayan kingdom.
title_cn: 总理邀请泰商投资不丹开发正念城
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷（Anutin Charnvirakul）邀请泰国企业参与投资不丹的格雷芬达正念城（Gelephu Mindfulness City），这是不丹的重点经济枢纽项目。泰国希望通过参与该项目来扩大与喜马拉雅山区王国的贸易和投资联系，促进两国经济合作与发展。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul is urging Thai businesses to help develop Bhutan's Gelephu Mindfulness City (GMC), a planned economic hub, as Thailand seeks to expand trade and investment ties with the Himalayan kingdom.

title: No 'secret deal' for Thaksin
desc: Pheu Thai Party leader Julapun Amornvivat has firmly denied rumours of a secret political deal exchanging an amnesty for former premier Thaksin Shinawatra for votes of confidence in the upcoming censure debate.
title_cn: 为泰党否认他信大赦的「秘密交易」传言
summary_cn: 为泰党（Pheu Thai）领导人朱拉蓬（Julapun Amornvivat）严厉否认了关于该党与政府进行秘密政治交易的传言，传言称他们将支持不信任动议的投票权作为筹码来换取对前总理他信（Thaksin Shinawatra）的大赦。此举旨在澄清党派立场。
desc_original: Pheu Thai Party leader Julapun Amornvivat has firmly denied rumours of a secret political deal exchanging an amnesty for former premier Thaksin Shinawatra for votes of confidence in the upcoming censure debate.

title: Govt gets low marks on  drugs, graft
desc: The Thai Political Index fell slightly to 3.52 points out of 10 in October, down from 3.56 in September, with opposition performance receiving the highest rating and the government's handling of drugs and influential figures scoring the lowest, according to a Suan Dusit Poll survey.
title_cn: 政府毒品和反腐问题评分走低
summary_cn: 根据宣素德民调，泰国政治指数10月下滑至3.52分（9月为3.56分），环比略有下降。其中，反对派的表现获得了最高评分，而政府在毒品治理和处理有影响力人物方面的评分最低。这反映了民众对政府毒品政策执行力和反腐工作成效的质疑。政治指数的下滑表明民众对政府施政的满意度有所下降。
desc_original: The Thai Political Index fell slightly to 3.52 points out of 10 in October, down from 3.56 in September, with opposition performance receiving the highest rating and the government's handling of drugs and influential figures scoring the lowest, according to a Suan Dusit Poll survey.

title: Govt eyes high-income  economy status 'by 2037'
desc: Thailand aims to become a high-income economy by 2037, with a new five-year science and innovation strategy targeting annual GDP growth of 5%.
title_cn: 政府目标2037年跻身高收入国家
summary_cn: 泰国政府制定了新的五年科技创新战略，目标是在2037年前将国家升级至高收入经济体地位。新战略将年均GDP增长率定为5%，通过加大科技创新投入，推动产业升级和经济结构优化。此举反映了泰国政府对经济转型升级的重视，力图通过创新驱动发展突破现有的中等收入水平，进入发达经济体行列。
desc_original: Thailand aims to become a high-income economy by 2037, with a new five-year science and innovation strategy targeting annual GDP growth of 5%.

title: Suvarnabhumi to shrink duty-free shops for pick-up counters, premium service
desc: Suvarnabhumi to shrink duty-free shops for pick-up counters, premium service Legacy Airports of Thailand (AOT) plans to cut the floor space given to duty-free shops in Suvarnabhumi International Airport , moving more sales to pick-up counters and handing part of the area to automated gates . The airport operator also expects to announce details of a new paid Premium Service for arriving and departing passengers this month. AOT President Paweena Jariyathitipong said the duty-free model had not performed as well as it should have, so the company would review how it uses the space to match what passengers actually do and want. Duty-free sales will continue, but more of them will go through pick-up counters, and some of the freed space could serve other airport services, she told Thai PBS . AOT is still in talks with King Power, its main duty-free partner, about changing how the business runs. Paweena explained that duty-free carries high costs for infrastructure, stock management and logistics inside the airport, so both sides need a deal that works for each of them. Anniversary promotion at King Power Rangnam in Bangkok, Nov. 1, 2026 | Photo via Facebook/King Power Currently, King Po

title: Thailand weather today, 2 November: thundershowers in 46 provinces, Bangkok showers
desc: Thailand weather today, 2 November: thundershowers in 46 provinces, Bangkok showers Legacy The Thai Meteorological Department forecasts heavy to very heavy rain in 46 provinces today, with the North, Northeast, Central and South regions hit hardest. Bangkok can expect scattered thundershowers with gusts, with lows of 24-26°C and highs of 32-34°C. People across the upper country should steer clear of thundershowers, outdoor areas, large trees and unsecured billboards. A high-pressure system from China extends to upper Vietnam and is expected to cover the upper Northeast and the South China Sea today, while easterly wind prevails over the Gulf, Thailand and the Andaman Sea. Bangkok Bangkok sees scattered thundershowers with gusts through the forecast period. Lows of 24-26°C and highs of 32-34°C are expected, with southeasterly winds of 10 to 20km/h. North Isolated thundershowers with gusts are forecast mostly in Mae Hong Son, Chiang Mai, Chiang Rai, Phayao, Nan and Uttaradit. Tak, Kamphaeng Phet, Phitsanulok, Phichit and Phetchabun are also affected. Lows of 24-26°C and highs of 32-34°C are expected regionally, though the bulletin gives 22-25°C minimum and 34-37°C maximum for the Nor

title_cn: 国王和王后观看皇家职艺促进基金会泰剧首演「西达」
summary_cn: 泰国国王和王后在曼谷（Bangkok）国家文化中心亲临视察，观看皇家职艺促进基金会举办的泰剧首演「西达」。这是该基金会在促进传统泰国艺术与职业发展方面的重要演出。国王和王后的出席充分体现了泰国王室对传统文化艺术的重视与支持，推动了泰国非遗文化的传承与发展。

summary_cn: 泰国政治人士苏哈萨瓦（Suhasavat）呼吁政府采取行动，防止缅甸军政府欺压和剥削在泰国工作的劳工。他强调在泰国从事劳动产生的经济效益应当流向泰国经济，而不是被外国政权压榨。此议题涉及跨国劳工权益保护与泰缅边境地区的安全稳定。泰国政府在保护本国劳工合法权益、防止经济被掠夺方面面临重要挑战。

title: Smugglers caught with 32,400 assault rifle cartridges
desc: TRAT – Authorities seized 32,400 rounds of 7.62mm assault rifle ammunition and arrested four Thais and a Cambodian on a speedboat at the mouth of a canal in this eastern province bordering Cambodia on Sunday morning.
title_cn: 走私贩在达叻府被捕 缉获逾3万发步枪弹药
summary_cn: 达叻府（Trat）海关部门在周日上午于靠近柬埔寨（Cambodia）边界的运河口查获走私快艇，逮捕四名泰国籍走私贩和一名柬埔寨籍嫌疑人，缉获32400发7.62毫米步枪弹药。这是一起重大跨境武器走私案件，表明泰柬边界的地下武器走私网络仍然活跃。军火走私威胁到区域安全与泰国的社会稳定，执法部门对边境走私的打击力度持续加强。

title: Thailand tightens checks on cash deposits over 5 million baht
desc: Thailand tightens checks on cash deposits over 5 million baht Legacy Thailand has introduced stricter checks on cash deposits of 5 million baht or more at bank branches, under new Bank of Thailand rules that took effect today, November 1. The rules apply to cash transactions made within a single day. They do not apply to transactions made through electronic banking channels. Bank of Thailand governor Vitai Ratanakorn said the measures are intended to tackle illicit funds and improve transparency in Thailand’s financial system . Under the new requirements, banks must carry out enhanced due diligence on customers making large cash transactions. The checks will depend on the customer’s risk profile and may include questions about the source and purpose of the funds, as well as requests for supporting documents. Photo via Magnific The Thailand cash deposit rules also cover several other types of transactions at bank branches when their value reaches 5 million baht. These include cheque and bank draft deposits, exchanging Thai banknotes, and receiving cash to issue cheques or bank drafts. Buying, selling and exchanging foreign currency are also covered. title: Mae Hong Son buildings damaged after Myanmar bombs Karen positions
desc: Mae Hong Son buildings damaged after Myanmar bombs Karen positions Legacy Myanmar military airstrikes on a Karen National Union (KNU) position near the Thai border damaged 17 buildings in Mae Hong Son province, including homes and public facilities. Two bombs were dropped across the Salween River from Ban Mae Sam Laep, with shrapnel and shockwaves reaching the Thai side. Officials in Sop Moei district inspected the damage on November 1. The explosions shattered windows, damaged roofs, cracked walls and caused ceilings to collapse. Photo via สำนักข่าวTWONews77ทั่วไทย Affected buildings included homes, a local health centre, a childcare centre, a tourist information centre, a mosque, a Buddhist temple and a Christian church. The local council chief called on the Thai government to hold talks with Myanmar about preventing military operations near the border from affecting Thai communities . He urged measures to stop bombing close to the frontier, saying residents on both sides should not have to fear further attacks. title: 热带泰国的“冷”门玩法：茵他侬山步道重开，气温仅12℃
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月1日，据泰媒报道，清迈茵他侬山国家公园正式重新开放Kew Mae Pan自然步道，迎接冬季旅游旺季。当天山区天气晴朗、气候凉爽，步道附近气温仅12摄氏度，茵他侬山山顶更降至11摄氏度。大批游客一早便来到现场，欣赏高山草甸、原始森林及壮观的云海景色。 当天，清迈府宗通县县长主持步道开放仪式。Kew Mae Pan自然步道位于海拔2157米的高山地区，全长约3.2公里，步行一圈平均需要2至3小时。沿途穿越生长着苔藓、蕨类植物及高大树木的山地常绿森林，随后进入全年气候寒冷、风力较强的亚高山草甸。步道最受欢迎的景点是高山观景台，游客可以俯瞰连绵起伏的山峦及辽阔云海。开放首日，大片云雾覆盖山林，尤其是草甸中央观景台附近，云海景观格外壮观，吸引众多游客驻足拍照。 宗通县县长表示，清迈凭借独特的文化、历史及自然风光，一直是泰国国内外游客喜爱的旅游目的地。其中，茵他侬山作为泰国最高峰，更是冬季热门景点。Kew Mae Pan步道重新开放，不仅让游客有机会体验泰国少见的高山凉爽气候，也能近距离认识山地森林生态系统，推动生态旅游及自然环境保护。 根据旅游统计，2025年清迈府共接待游客超过1190万人次，其中泰国游客约850万人次、外国游客超过350万人次。茵他侬山国家公园全年接待游客超过80万人次，山顶观景区及Kew Mae Pan自然步道是最受欢迎的景点之一。 值得一提的是，茵他侬山国家公园近日还入选了2026年全球绿色旅游目的地百大故事榜单。该榜单于10月28日在斯洛文尼亚举行的全球绿色旅游目的地大会上公布，泰国共有16处旅游目的地入选。此次入选得到了泰国国家旅游局的支持，也是清迈可持续旅游发展示范项目的一部分。该国际榜单主要表彰在环境保护、文化传承及负责任旅游管理方面具有代表性的实践案例，进一步提升了茵他侬山作为泰国重要生态旅游目的地的国际知名度。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：matichon、mgronline） The post 热带泰国的“冷”门玩法：茵他侬山步道重开，气温仅12℃ appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Thailand unveils 100 baht travel vouchers for Thai, foreign residents
desc: Thailand unveils 100 baht travel vouchers for Thai, foreign residents Legacy Thailand’s Tourism Authority (TAT) is preparing to launch a 100 baht travel voucher scheme for Thais and foreigners living in Thailand , with sales starting on December 15. The scheme, called “100 Baht Travel Across Thailand”, is intended to encourage travel outside weekends and public holidays. Deputy government spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana said TAT is working with more than 170 businesses to prepare the scheme, covering hotels, restaurants, tourist attractions, activities, health and beauty services, and other tourism-related businesses. Photo via Thaigov The programme has two parts: discounts and other offers from participating businesses, and an online voucher sale called “SHOCK DEALS”, with vouchers priced at 100 baht each. The voucher sale is scheduled to run over eight rounds, all held on Tuesdays, between December 15, 2026, and February 9, 2027. Vouchers purchased during these sales can only be used for travel or services from Monday to Thursday. The sale dates and the dates on which vouchers can be redeemed are therefore different. title: 他信申请特赦遇阻，4起案件被指不符条件
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，泰国前总理他信此前已委托律师向泰国社会和平促进委员会提交申请，希望依据2026年《社会和平促进法案》获得特赦，免除其涉及政治相关案件的法律责任。不过，有消息称，委员会一名成员近日已向总理阿努廷非正式表达意见，认为他信涉及的4起案件均不符合该法规定的特赦条件。 据报道，他信此前授权律师维尼亚向社会和平促进委员会递交申请，请求委员会主席审查其是否符合《社会和平促进法案》规定的特赦及免责资格，以消除相关案件对其造成的法律影响。目前，该申请仍处于初步审查阶段，由泰国司法部次长皮亚西担任主席的审查小组负责审核。小组将召开会议讨论申请内容，完成初步审查后，再提交社会和平促进委员会全体会议进一步审议，尚未作出正式决定。 消息人士透露，委员会一名成员近日曾非正式向兼任内政部长的总理阿努廷表示，他信涉及的4起案件不符合特赦条件，原因在于这些案件属于政治职务人员刑事案件，涉及利用公职权力为本人或他人谋取不正当利益，并非一般政治集会或政治表达相关案件。 这4起案件分别为：泰国进出口银行提供40亿泰铢低息贷款案、政府推出地下彩票合法化项目涉及的两位数及三位数彩票案、电信及卫星特许经营费调整案，以及涉及460亿泰铢资产的没收案。 据该成员的意见，相关案件已由法院作出涉及公职腐败行为的裁判，其性质符合泰国1999年及2018年《预防和打击腐败组织法》有关滥用职权、谋取不正当利益的规定，因此不属于此次特赦法律拟处理的案件范围。 此外，该成员认为，他信的案件也不符合2026年《社会和平促进法案》第7条的规定。该法的立法宗旨主要是对参与政治意见表达集会活动的人员给予特赦，而他信涉及的案件并非此类行为。同时，该法也未将涉及请求法院判令财产归国家所有的案件纳入特赦范围。 目前，以上判断仍属于委员会成员向总理提出的非正式意见，并非社会和平促进委员会的最终裁决。他信的申请仍须经过审查小组及委员会全体会议的法定审议程序。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：mgronline） The post 他信申请特赦遇阻，4起案件被指不符条件 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Police raid Bangkok cannabis gummy shop after family hospitalised
desc: Police raid Bangkok cannabis gummy shop after family hospitalised Legacy Police raided a cannabis shop in Bangkok today, November 1, and seized 90 unlabelled cannabis gummies following reports that a family of three became seriously ill after eating cannabis sweets in Chanthaburi. The Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) carried out the raid with the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and the Department of Thai Traditional and Alternative Medicine. The investigation began after social media reports emerged about a father, mother and their two year old son falling ill after eating sweets later found to contain cannabis in Khlung district, Chanthaburi province. Photo via Facebook: Thaipolice The adults reportedly suffered severe symptoms , including muscle stiffness, convulsions and loss of consciousness, and required ventilator support. The boy became drowsy and was believed to have consumed a smaller amount. All three were taken to hospital for urgent treatment. title: 因不冲马桶遭索赔150泰铢？中国游客与泰国人打成一团
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，10月30日晚，泰国芭堤雅一处夜市发生中国游客与泰国工作人员群殴事件。起因疑似为中国游客使用公共厕所后未保持卫生，遭工作人员要求支付150泰铢清洁罚款，双方随后爆发肢体冲突。事件造成多人受伤，其中两名中国游客头部被枪柄击伤。警方赶到现场后，将5名中国游客及2名泰国男子带回警局调查，并查获一把未装子弹的改装枪支。 据报道，事件发生于当晚23时15分左右，地点位于春武里府芭堤雅二路旁的一处街头美食夜市。双方发生冲突后，附近民众及娱乐场所保安人员上前劝阻，随后芭堤雅警察局警员赶到现场控制局面。 事后，记者前往事发夜市采访。30岁的厕所管理员纳塔甘表示，事发当晚，他与朋友正在厕所附近值班，约5名明显醉酒的中国游客前来使用厕所，分别进入不同隔间。几人离开后，他发现厕所地面有尿液、马桶未冲水，马桶盖上还有踩踏痕迹。纳塔甘称，按照厕所管理规定，使用者若造成环境脏乱，须支付150泰铢清洁罚款。因此，他叫住几名中国游客，希望他们返回查看厕所情况，不料对方对此表示不满，其中一人将他推向墙壁，双方随即发生拳脚冲突。 据纳塔甘描述，冲突随后蔓延至厕所外，现场参与围殴的中国游客可能增加至七八人，他与朋友遭多人殴打受伤。其朋友随后取出一把没有子弹的BB枪威吓对方，并用枪柄击打中国游客头部，试图阻止对方继续攻击。附近娱乐场所的保安人员赶来制止冲突，并报警求助。 警方到场后，将涉事的5名中国游客及2名泰国男子带回警局，双方均因涉嫌共同参与斗殴而受到处理。其中，两名中国游客被枪柄击中头部，造成头部破裂受伤。警方对5名中国游客进行讯问后，依法提出共同斗殴指控，并在调查阶段处以罚款。 至于涉事泰国男子所使用的枪支，警方调查发现，该枪原为BB枪，但经过改装，可使用真实弹药，因此被认定属于受枪支法律管制的自制改装枪。持枪男子除涉及斗殴案件外，还因涉嫌违反《枪支法》受到起诉，目前已获准保释，但由于此前遭多人围殴，身体多处受伤，仍在家中休养。 另一名60岁的厕所管理员蓬姨（化名）表示，夜市经常有中国游客前来使用厕所，其中既有遵守规定的游客，也有人存在不冲马桶、踩踏马桶盖或随意丢弃垃圾等行为。她称，工作人员过去曾因要求违规使用者支付清洁罚款而遭到辱骂甚至殴打，此次事件则是因为其侄子与中国游客发生冲突，最终演变成此次群殴事件。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：ch7） The post 因不冲马桶遭索赔150泰铢？中国游客与泰国人打成一团 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Thailand-Cambodia border to stay shut until demands met
desc: Thailand-Cambodia border to stay shut until demands met Legacy Thailand will not reopen its border crossings with Cambodia until key security and territorial concerns are addressed, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul confirmed yesterday, October 31. Speaking on the third episode of his programme, ‘Talk with Prime Minister Anutin’, Anutin said the border crossings had been closed for some time, and there was no indication that the government would change its position. He explained that Cambodia had yet to address Thailand’s main concerns, making it premature to restore relations to their previous level. “I still don’t know when we will reopen them. Not until Thailand gets what we believe it deserves,” Anutin said. The prime minister said discussions with Cambodia involve more than reopening border crossings and restoring trade. Photo via FC Anutin Outstanding issues include disputed land and maritime areas containing important natural resources. He said the government must carefully protect Thailand’s interests rather than rush to rebuild relations before those matters are settled. title_cn: 泰国坚守立场：柬埔寨未解决纠纷前，泰柬边界保持关闭
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷(Anutin Charnvirakul)10月31日确认，泰国不会重新开放与柬埔寨的边界通道，除非柬埔寨解决关键的领土和海上争议问题。双方分歧不仅涉及贸易恢复，还包括有重要自然资源的陆地和海洋争议区域。泰国政府必须保护国家利益，跨境犯罪也是主要关切，目前无明确重开时间表。

title: 泰国警方查处非法人民币兑换平台，一年资金流水超1.7亿泰铢
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月1日，据泰媒报道，泰国中央调查局联合经济犯罪打击部门近日查处一家涉嫌非法经营人民币兑换及跨境支付业务的公司。警方调查发现，该公司通过网站提供人民币兑换、支付宝转账及中国电商平台购物充值等服务，在未获得泰国央行许可的情况下开展支付和外汇业务，相关银行账户一年内资金流水超过1.7亿泰铢，其中部分账户还与网络犯罪案件存在资金关联。目前，警方已对涉案公司及一名泰国籍男子依法采取行动。 此次行动由抑制经济犯罪司负责，警方在曼谷一栋三层联排住宅内展开搜查，查扣4台笔记本电脑、5部手机及1份文件档案，并对一家法人公司及一名泰国籍男性立案调查。 案件起因于泰国央行向警方通报，发现有网站公开宣传提供支付服务及人民币和其他外币兑换业务，但经营者并未取得必要许可。根据泰国法律，此类支付服务、外汇兑换及跨境汇款业务均属于受央行监管的金融业务，经营者必须依法取得相应许可。警方调查发现，相关网站提供人民币兑换、向支付宝账户转入人民币，以及为消费者通过中国购物网站购买商品提供充值和支付服务。消费者需先在网站注册会员，系统随后建立专属账户及电子钱包，用户可通过电子钱包进行充值、存款、提款及支付操作，并使用账户余额购买中国电商平台商品。该网站以涉案公司名义运营，实际服务已涉及电子支付、外币兑换及跨境资金转移等受监管业务。 在进一步调查资金流向时，警方发现与该业务有关的5个银行账户一年内累计资金流水超过1.7亿泰铢。其中两个账户主要用于人民币兑换及人民币资金收付，并被发现与涉及网络犯罪的银行账户存在关联。根据泰国国家警察总署反网络诈骗中心提供的信息，上述两个账户涉及的相关可疑交易金额合计超过27万泰铢。警方表示，这些资金关联仍有待进一步调查，以确认是否涉及其他网络犯罪活动及相关人员。 警方经核查确认，涉案公司从未获得泰国央行颁发的支付服务经营许可，也未取得外汇兑换业务所需的相关许可，其经营行为涉嫌违反泰国金融监管法律。在掌握相关证据后，经济犯罪打击局第五调查组向法院申请搜查令，并前往涉案经营场所展开搜查。警方进入现场时，发现有5名员工正在工作，随后对办公设备、电子资料及相关文件进行检查，并查扣上述证据。 警方最终对涉案公司及一名泰国籍男性共两个涉案主体提出指控，涉嫌共同未经许可经营受监管支付服务业务，以及未经许可经营外汇兑换和国际汇款业务，案件将依法进入后续调查及司法程序。对于涉嫌用于人民币兑换、且与网络犯罪案件存在关联的银行账户，警方表示将继续追查相关资金流向，调查是否涉及其他违法活动，并进一步确认相关账户与网络犯罪案件之间的具体联系。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：fm91bkk） The post 泰国警方查处非法人民币兑换平台，一年资金流水超1.7亿泰铢 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 中泰联合追查跨国毒品网络，3名中国籍嫌疑人落网
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，10月31日，泰国移民局联合麻醉品管制局展开跨国毒品犯罪打击行动，根据中国有关部门提供的线索，在曼谷及春武里府成功逮捕3名涉毒嫌疑人。调查发现，部分嫌疑人涉嫌利用泰国零食及食品作为掩护，将冰毒藏匿其中，再通过国际快递公司运往中国北京、天津、秦皇岛等地。目前，警方已查获冰毒81.70克，以及手机、电脑等多项涉案物品。 本次行动由泰国移民局局长诺帕辛警中将指挥，警方通过生物识别系统核查及进一步调查，确认3名嫌疑人均已进入泰国境内并在当地居留，随后制定抓捕计划，分别在曼谷和春武里府展开搜查行动，最终成功将3人全部逮捕。 第一名嫌疑人为33岁的温某（WEN，音译），警方在曼谷一处公寓内将其抓获，现场查扣一部iPhone 17 Pro Max手机及信用卡。根据中国方面的通缉信息，温某涉嫌多次与跨国贩毒网络合作，将冰毒藏匿在泰国零食及其他食品中，再通过国际快递公司寄往中国多个城市。 第二名嫌疑人为35岁的方某（FANG，音译），警方在春武里府芭堤雅市一家咖啡店内将其逮捕。据调查，方某此前曾从曼谷地区逃离，随后藏身芭堤雅。警方在行动中查扣电脑、手机及多件可疑物品，目前正在进一步检验。方某同样是中国毒品案件通缉嫌疑人，涉嫌在国际贩毒网络中负责管理和组织毒品加工活动。 第三名嫌疑人为33岁的张某（ZHANG，音译），警方根据温某的相关线索扩大调查，最终在曼谷沙吞区一处豪华公寓内将其抓获。搜查过程中，警方发现11袋冰毒，总重量81.70克，同时查获大量吸毒工具及毒品分装设备。警方因此指控张某以商业贩卖为目的持有第一类毒品甲基苯丙胺，即冰毒。 进一步调查显示，温某与张某是同一跨国贩毒网络的重要嫌疑人，两人涉嫌多次参与从泰国向中国走私冰毒的活动。该团伙的主要手法是将毒品藏入泰国零食及食品包装中，以普通食品包裹作为掩护，再通过国际快递公司将毒品运往中国北京、天津、秦皇岛及其他地区，以逃避运输过程中的检查。 此次行动共涉及3处搜查地点，警方累计查扣3部手机、2台电脑、信用卡、多件可疑物品，以及总重量81.70克的冰毒。警方估计，查获冰毒的价值超过10万泰铢。 目前，警方已将3名嫌疑人及相关证物移交调查人员，依法开展后续调查及司法程序。同时，泰国移民局正与麻醉品管制局及中国禁毒执法部门保持联系，进一步追查涉案贩毒网络、其他参与人员及相关犯罪活动。 诺帕辛警中将强调，此次行动是落实泰国政府及国家警察总署打击跨国犯罪和外国人在泰违法活动政策的一部分。泰国执法部门将继续加强与国内外安全机构的合作，追查跨国犯罪网络，并依法严厉打击相关违法行为。他表示，泰国绝不会成为国际通缉嫌疑人及跨国犯罪分子的藏身之地。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：mgronline） The post 中泰联合追查跨国毒品网络，3名中国籍嫌疑人落网 appeared first
title_cn: 中泰联手破获跨国毒品网络，3名中国籍嫌疑人在泰落网

title: 泰国过境贸易破万亿泰铢！中国稳居最大市场，科技产品成主力
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月1日，据泰媒报道，2026年前9个月，泰国边境贸易与过境贸易保持增长势头，贸易总额达到1.76万亿泰铢，同比增长18.8%。其中，过境贸易表现尤为突出，贸易额突破1万亿泰铢，同比增长39.3%。随着海外市场对科技及电子产品的需求持续增加，泰国对中国、新加坡及越南等市场的过境贸易明显增长，成为推动整体贸易扩张的重要动力。 泰国商业部对外贸易厅厅长阿拉达近日公布，2026年9月，泰国边境贸易与过境贸易总额达到2209.08亿泰铢，同比增长50.8%。其中，出口额1137.70亿泰铢，同比增长51.8%；进口额1071.38亿泰铢，同比增长49.7%，实现贸易顺差66.32亿泰铢。受9月强劲增长带动，今年1月至9月，泰国边境贸易与过境贸易累计总额达到约1.76万亿泰铢，同比增长18.8%。其中，出口额9781.05亿泰铢，同比增长16.6%；进口额7862.07亿泰铢，同比增长21.6%，累计实现贸易顺差1918.98亿泰铢。 在与周边国家的边境贸易方面，9月泰国与马来西亚、老挝、缅甸及柬埔寨四国的边境贸易总额为807.41亿泰铢，同比增长24.4%。其中，出口额430.72亿泰铢，进口额376.69亿泰铢，实现贸易顺差54.03亿泰铢。从主要贸易伙伴来看，马来西亚仍是泰国最大的边境贸易市场，9月双边边境贸易额达到399.72亿泰铢，同比增长49.6%；其次为老挝，贸易额245.39亿泰铢，同比增长1%；缅甸排名第三，贸易额162.30亿泰铢，同比增长16.8%。与此同时，泰国与柬埔寨之间的边境贸易额仍为零。边境出口商品方面，柴油是主要出口产品，9月出口额达到38.21亿泰铢；其他成品油出口额18.64亿泰铢；其他工业产品出口额16.52亿泰铢。 尽管9月边境贸易实现增长，但从前9个月累计表现来看，泰国与周边国家的边境贸易仍有所萎缩。1月至9月，边境贸易总额为6721.24亿泰铢，同比下降4.2%。其中，出口额3752.50亿泰铢，同比下降9.3%；进口额2968.73亿泰铢，同比增长3.2%，显示边境出口仍面临一定压力。 与边境贸易相比，泰国面向第三国的过境贸易增长更为显著。9月过境贸易总额达到1401.67亿泰铢，同比增长71.7%。其中，出口额706.98亿泰铢，同比增长79.7%；进口额694.68亿泰铢，同比增长64.4%。中国继续保持泰国最大过境贸易市场地位。9月泰国与中国的过境贸易总额达到593.65亿泰铢，同比增长37.5%。新加坡排名第二，贸易额370.23亿泰铢，同比增长150.8%；越南位居第三，贸易额155.56亿泰铢，同比增长102.5%。其中，新加坡和越南市场的增速尤为突出。 从商品结构来看，科技及电子产品成为推动泰国过境贸易增长的重要力量。9月主要过境出口商品包括电话机及相关设备，出口额159.77亿泰铢；计算

summary_cn: 泰国家庭债务规模庞大、压力持续高企，引发金融系统关注。债务管理部门（BAM）调整不良资产管理策略，强化优质资产甄选，通过扩充投资组合、与大型银行携手设立资产管理公司等创新举措，有针对性地化解社会债务风险，维护金融系统稳健运行。
desc_original: ท่ามกลางปัญหาหนี้ NPL ในไทยทั้งระบบที่มีอยู่หลักแสนล้านบาท BAM ซึ่งเป็นหนึ่งในกลไกจัดการหนี้จะมีแผนธุรกิจเพื่อชะลอหรือลดความรุนแรงของปัญหาหนี้ครัวเรือนไทยอย่างไร

title: Thap Lan land dispute 90% resolved, says minister Suchart
desc: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has ordered officials to speed up efforts to resolve the long-running land dispute in Thap Lan National Park, saying the process is 80-90% complete as the government seeks to balance residents' rights with forest conservation.
title_cn: 他帮兰国家公园（Thap Lan）地权纠纷解决进度近九成 环保部长素察表示
summary_cn: 泰国自然资源与环保部长素察·乍姆克林已下令加快解决他帮兰国家公园（Thap Lan）的长期地权纠纷，该纠纷解决进度已达80-90%。政府正致力于平衡当地居民的权益与森林保护需求。该国家公园的地权问题由来已久，涉及多方利益关系。
desc_original: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has ordered officials to speed up efforts to resolve the long-running land dispute in Thap Lan National Park, saying the process is 80-90% complete as the government seeks to balance residents' rights with forest conservation.

title: 'Kamnan Nok' gets 3 years in jail for bid-rigging
desc: The Central Criminal Court for Corruption and Misconduct Cases has sentenced Praween Chankhlai, also known as "Kamnan Nok", and other defendants to prison terms and hefty fines for bid-rigging involving a road project worth nearly 45 million baht in Nakhon Pathom.
title_cn: 「甘南诺」因路项招标舞弊被判监禁3年
summary_cn: 泰国中央反腐败与失职犯罪法院对普拉温·占克莱（外号「甘南诺」）及其他被告判刑，涉及纳空帕托姆（Nakhon Pathom）省一条价值约4500万泰铢的道路工程招标舞弊案。被告获刑并被罚以巨额罚款。此案涉及政府采购程序腐败，属于严重经济犯罪。
desc_original: The Central Criminal Court for Corruption and Misconduct Cases has sentenced Praween Chankhlai, also known as "Kamnan Nok", and other defendants to prison terms and hefty fines for bid-rigging involving a road project worth nearly 45 million baht in Nakhon Pathom.

title: More evidence filed in Panadda case
desc: Influencer Boonyanuch Saengsri has urged police to investigate current and former board members of the Good Deeds Foundation over allegations of donation misuse involving its suspended chairwoman, Panadda "Bum" Wongphudee.
title_cn: 巴娜达案新添证据 网红促查善行基金会成员
summary_cn: 泰国网红布尼亚努奇敦促警方调查慈善机构「善行基金会」（Good Deeds Foundation）现任及前任董事会成员，涉及该基金会主席巴娜达·翁普德（昵称「宝姆」）的捐款挪用指控。巴娜达已被停职，案件正在深入调查，新证据被提交。此案涉及慈善组织的资金监管问题，引发公众关注。
desc_original: Influencer Boonyanuch Saengsri has urged police to investigate current and former board members of the Good Deeds Foundation over allegations of donation misuse involving its suspended chairwoman, Panadda "Bum" Wongphudee.

title: PM says he's not dodging censure
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed accusations that his government is avoiding a no-confidence debate, insisting he is ready to face parliament in December and the coalition remains stable.
title_cn: 总理阿努廷否认躲避问责 称12月准备迎战议会
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷·查尔维拉库尔驳斥政府回避不信任动议的指控，表示已做好12月在议会进行辩论的准备。他强调政府联盟保持稳定，对处理议会质询充满信心。此举直接回应了外界对政府稳定性和政治诚意的疑虑，反映出当前泰国政治局势的复杂性。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed accusations that his government is avoiding a no-confidence debate, insisting he is ready to face parliament in December and the coalition remains stable.

title: Thailand, Bhutan sign three deals
desc: Thailand and Bhutan have signed three cooperation agreements covering healthcare, agricultural finance and clean energy as the countries seek to deepen economic ties, expand investment opportunities and promote sustainable development.
title_cn: 泰国与不丹签署三项合作协议 涵盖医疗农业和清洁能源
summary_cn: 泰国与不丹（Bhutan）签署三项合作协议，分别涵盖医疗卫生、农业融资和清洁能源领域。双方力求深化经济联系，拓展投资机遇，推动可持续发展。此举旨在加强两国在关键经济和环保领域的战略伙伴关系。
desc_original: Thailand and Bhutan have signed three cooperation agreements covering healthcare, agricultural finance and clean energy as the countries seek to deepen economic ties, expand investment opportunities and promote sustainable development.

title: Anutin defends govt solar rooftop loan plan
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has defended the government's household solar rooftop scheme against opposition criticism of its proposed 200-billion-baht loan package, insisting that the initiative is not a "blank cheque".
title_cn: 阿努廷为政府太阳能屋顶贷款计划辩护
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷（Anutin Charnvirakul）为政府提议的家庭太阳能屋顶计划进行辩护，该计划拟投入200亿泰铢的贷款资金。阿努廷反驳了反对派批评，强调这并非「空白支票」，而是经过审慎设计的能源转型举措，旨在促进可再生能源在家庭层面的推广，支持泰国绿色能源发展目标。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has defended the government's household solar rooftop scheme against opposition criticism of its proposed 200-billion-baht loan package, insisting that the initiative is not a "blank cheque".

title: Groups warn on deportation of two Uyghurs
desc: Human rights groups have called on the government to uphold the principle of non-refoulement and respect the wishes of two Uyghur refugees seeking resettlement in a third country. The call was made on Saturday by the Coalition for the Rights of Refugees and Stateless Persons (CRSP), the Migrant Working Group (MWG) and the Thailand Migration Reform Consortium (TMR).
title_cn: 人权组织警示两名维吾尔人遣返风险
summary_cn: 难民权利联盟等多个人权组织周六发出呼吁，敦促泰国政府坚守「不遣返原则」，尊重寻求第三国安置的两名维吾尔难民的意愿。涉及难民权利、移民工作组等多方倡议，反映了国际人道主义关切与泰国难民政策的交界点，涉及法律和外交问题。
desc_original: Human rights groups have called on the government to uphold the principle of non-refoulement and respect the wishes of two Uyghur refugees seeking resettlement in a third country. The call was made on Saturday by the Coalition for the Rights of Refugees and Stateless Persons (CRSP), the Migrant Working Group (MWG) and the Thailand Migration Reform Consortium (TMR).

title: Police prepare to call in Rukchanok, operator of Godd Dam FB page
desc: Police are preparing to summon People's Party list-MP Rukchanok Srinork and the operator of the Godd Dam Facebook page to acknowledge defamation charges over an allegedly forged bank transfer slip purporting to show a 7-million-baht "tea money" payment to Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.
title_cn: 警方传唤人民党议员及社交媒体账号因涉嫌伪造证据诽谤
summary_cn: 泰国警方准备传唤人民党不分区议员陆克查诺克及社交媒体Godd Dam页面操作者，因涉嫌通过伪造银行转账单进行诽谤。虚假文件声称向总理阿努廷支付700万泰铢的「茶钱」。事件涉及虚假信息传播、诽谤罪和政治争议，反映泰国当前政治紧张局势与社交媒体监管问题。
desc_original: Police are preparing to summon People's Party list-MP Rukchanok Srinork and the operator of the Godd Dam Facebook page to acknowledge defamation charges over an allegedly forged bank transfer slip purporting to show a 7-million-baht "tea money" payment to Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.

title: Border with Cambodia to remain shut amid concerns
desc: Thailand will not reopen its border checkpoints with Cambodia until its key concerns are addressed, Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said.
title_cn: 泰柬边境保持关闭，泰国表示有关切需解决
summary_cn: 泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷宣布，在解决关键关切问题前，泰国将继续关闭与柬埔寨的边境检查站。虽具体关切未详细阐述，但反映两国边境关系的敏感性，可能涉及边境安全、走私或两国政治关系等问题。此举对从事跨境贸易、物流或旅游的外国人有直接影响。
desc_original: Thailand will not reopen its border checkpoints with Cambodia until its key concerns are addressed, Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said.

title: 'Public-private synergy' key in energy transition
desc: Thailand is seeking to strengthen its energy security by diversifying energy sources, expanding renewable energy development and promoting public-private cooperation, amid concerns over its dependence on imported liquefied natural gas (LNG) and exposure to global supply disruptions.
title_cn: 「公私合作」成能源转型关键
summary_cn: 泰国正通过能源多元化、扩大可再生能源开发和促进公私部门合作来增强能源安全。鉴于对进口液化天然气（LNG）的依赖和全球供应链中断风险，这一战略尤为重要。该举措涉及国家能源战略、经济发展和可持续性目标，长期可能影响能源价格和社会发展。
desc_original: Thailand is seeking to strengthen its energy security by diversifying energy sources, expanding renewable energy development and promoting public-private cooperation, amid concerns over its dependence on imported liquefied natural gas (LNG) and exposure to global supply disruptions.

desc: Myanmar man arrested over killing of woman in Bangkok room Legacy Bangkok police have arrested a 23 year old Myanmar man at a petrol station in Ayutthaya on 31 October, after a 20 year old Thai woman was found dead in her room in Din Daeng. Police said the suspect confessed to strangling her with his bare hands. He was caught while fleeing by bus to Kamphaeng Phet province. The Metropolitan Police Bureau ordered Din Daeng police detectives to hunt him down. He was arrested at a PTT petrol station in Bang Pa-in district, Ayutthaya. The case began when Din Daeng police were told a woman had died in a room in Soi Prachasongkhro 33. The dormitory owner opened it with the mother and brother-in-law present. They found the woman lying on her back on the bed with no signs of life. Police, a forensic doctor and crime scene officers examined the room and collected evidence. summary_cn: 曼谷遭遇洪水灾害，政府部门统计了受灾群众的救援登记情况和援助资金发放进展。截至10月31日，数千名受灾民众已完成登记并领取救援金。文章详细列出了登记人数最多的五个地区的统计数据，其中某些地区受灾程度更为严重，成为救援工作的重点关注区域。

desc: ผบช.ทท. สั่ง "ตำรวจท่องเที่ยว" ปล่อยแถวพร้อมกันคืน "วันฮาโลวีน" นำกำลังตรวจตราถนนข้าวสาร พบปะนักท่องเที่ยว–ผู้ประกอบการ สร้างความเชื่อมั่นด้านความปลอดภัย

desc: ศรัทธาหลั่งไหล แห่ทำบุญกราบไหว้องค์พ่อปู่ศรีสุทโธ-แม่ย่าศรีปทุมมา ที่ "วังพญานาค" วัดท่าใหม่อิ จ.เชียงใหม่ ขอโชคโค้งสุดท้ายก่อนหวยออกงวด 1 พ.ย. 2569
title_cn: 清迈龙宫寺挤满信众求彩票幸运数字
summary_cn: 随着11月1日泰国彩票开奖日期临近，大批信众纷纷前往清迈他新庙的龙宫殿参拜祈祷，寻求幸运的彩票号码。这一现象反映了泰国深厚的民间信仰传统与全社会广泛参与的彩票文化的深入融合，彩票已成为泰国文化生活的重要组成部分。
desc_original: ศรัทธาหลั่งไหล แห่ทำบุญกราบไหว้องค์พ่อปู่ศรีสุทโธ-แม่ย่าศรีปทุมมา ที่ "วังพญานาค" วัดท่าใหม่อิ จ.เชียงใหม่ ขอโชคโค้งสุดท้ายก่อนหวยออกงวด 1 พ.ย. 2569

title: Making a go of it in Hainan
desc: Thai entrepreneurs operating in China’s southern island province of Hainan say the opportunities created by the island’s growing free-trade economy remain significant, but success depends heavily on mastering the Chinese language, building local networks and understanding regulatory requirements.
title_cn: 泰国企业家在海南开拓事业
summary_cn: 泰国企业家在中国海南自由贸易港找到了新的商业机会，但成功经营需要付出额外努力。经营者需要掌握中文语言能力、建立本地人脉网络、深入理解当地监管环境。随着海南自由贸易港建设不断推进，越来越多泰国商人看好这片新兴市场的发展前景。
desc_original: Thai entrepreneurs operating in China’s southern island province of Hainan say the opportunities created by the island’s growing free-trade economy remain significant, but success depends heavily on mastering the Chinese language, building local networks and understanding regulatory requirements.

desc: “นายกฯ ภูฏาน” ชวน “นายกฯ อนุทิน” ออกรอบตีกอล์ฟออกกำลังกาย เจ้าตัวบอกได้เคาะสนิมวงสวิงหน่อย ก่อนถ่ายภาพคู่กัน
title_cn: 泰总理普拉尤特邀副总理阿努廷打高尔夫 自称球技生疏
summary_cn: 泰国总理普拉尤特邀请副总理阿努廷一同外出打高尔夫球锻炼身体。阿努廷表示自己的高尔夫球技有些生疏，两人在打球前进行了简短互动，随后合照留念。此举展现了两位高层政治人物的私下互动。

title: Hat Yai a test for Anutin
desc: The political balance in Hat Yai, the commercial heart of southern Thailand, could be tested by more than the threat of flooding.
title_cn: 合艾面临政治考验 泰南商业中心局势待观察
summary_cn: 作为泰国南方商业心脏的合艾 Hat Yai，其政治格局面临多重考验。除了洪水等自然灾害威胁外，该地区的政治平衡也受到副总理阿努廷等政治人物的影响。合艾的稳定对泰国南方地区发展至关重要。
desc_original: The political balance in Hat Yai, the commercial heart of southern Thailand, could be tested by more than the threat of flooding.

title: จับตา 4 สัญญาณ สะท้อนความเปราะบางตลาดแรงงานไทย
desc: โจทย์สำคัญของเศรษฐกิจไทยจึงไม่ได้อยู่ที่การรักษาอัตราการว่างงานให้ต่ำเท่านั้น แต่อยู่ที่การทำให้ “งาน” สร้างรายได้ที่เพียงพอและมั่นคง ท่ามกลางความเสี่ยงที่เพิ่มขึ้น
title_cn: 泰国劳动力市场四大警讯 就业质量堪忧
summary_cn: 泰国经济的核心挑战不仅在于维持低失业率，更在于创造充足稳定的就业收入。研究者指出需关注四个关键信号，反映当前劳动力市场的脆弱性。尽管失业率相对较低，但面对日益增加的经济风险，就业质量和收入稳定性仍需重点关注。

title: 泰国橡胶价格创10年来新高 政府启用GPS严查非法橡胶
desc: 泰国头条新闻社 据泰媒报道，10月30日，泰国总理府办公室副发言人帕达拉表示，根据泰国橡胶管理局经济部门的数据，截至2026年10月27日，泰国2026年橡胶价格已升至2015年以来10年间的最高水平。其中，三级烟片胶最高价格达到每公斤97.90泰铢，生胶片为每公斤93.50泰铢，鲜乳胶为每公斤89.95泰铢，100%杯胶为每公斤82.17泰铢。 泰国政府通过农业与合作社部，依托泰国橡胶管理局推进橡胶产业全链条管理，涵盖产量调控、市场供需平衡、非法橡胶流通防范以及泰国橡胶品质提升等方面，增加胶农以合理价格销售产品的机会，降低全球市场波动带来的影响。 她表示，政府已强调加强对非法橡胶的打击力度，防止此类橡胶进入市场、增加供应量，进而压低泰国胶农产品的收购价格。为此，政府将在2027财年启用Smart CESS系统，利用GPS技术追踪橡胶运输情况，并核查橡胶出口至境外所缴纳的相关费用信息。同时，政府还将依托帕披伦行动中心及相关部门开展监测、核查运输路线和执法工作。 尽管目前橡胶价格有所上涨，政府仍将重点保障胶农获得公平价格和持续收入。为此，需要同步推进产量管理、市场体系建设以及泰国橡胶质量标准维护，使泰国橡胶能够在长期内保持竞争力，并满足全球市场需求。 帕达拉补充表示，根据泰国橡胶管理局的预测，2026年第四季度橡胶价格预计仍将维持在较高水平，部分时段可能进一步上涨。这主要得益于全球橡胶市场供应趋紧，以及泰国政府采取的积极主动管理措施。 此外，泰国橡胶管理局还鼓励胶农使用符合标准的橡胶凝固剂，防止使用不合适的化学物质或掺入杂质，以免影响橡胶产品质量和买家信心。相关部门将密切跟踪橡胶需求、市场供应量以及全球市场动态。 上述措施也是泰国政府推进“创新农业，促进泰国农民可持续发展”政策的一部分，旨在从生产、质量和市场机制等方面提升橡胶产业效率，使泰国胶农能够把握市场机遇，实现收入稳定。 （编译：hansa ；审核：wan；来源：thairath ） The post 泰国橡胶价格创10年来新高 政府启用GPS严查非法橡胶 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国汽车市场分化明显 电车已占汽车总销量近31%
desc: 泰国头条新闻社 据泰媒报道，泰国汽车工业联合会公布的数据显示，2026年前9个月（1月至9月），泰国汽车销量共计521226辆，同比增长16.35%。 其中，燃油乘用车（ICE）销量为77837辆，同比下降20.20%；电动乘用车销量为161532辆，占汽车总销量的30.99%，较2025年同期增长98.56%。 在其他车型方面，1吨级皮卡销量为47552辆，同比下降16.11%；双排座皮卡销量为53681辆，同比增长7.60%；多用途运动型车（PPV）销量为29512辆，同比下降4.91%。 泰国汽车工业联合会发言人素拉蓬表示，皮卡销量持续下滑，主要受到金融机构收紧汽车贷款审批的影响，由于泰国国内经济增长缓慢，居民购买力疲软，同时生活成本高企，金融机构对贷款发放更加谨慎。此外，使用超过90%国产零部件的皮卡制造业，其生产活动仍在持续萎缩。 （编译：hansa ；审核：wan；来源：thansettakij ） The post 泰国汽车市场分化明显 电车已占汽车总销量近31% appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Toxic metals found at suspected Chonburi waste dump
desc: Toxic metals found at suspected Chonburi waste dump Legacy The Pollution Control Department has been ordered to trace the source of a suspected illegal industrial waste dump in Banglamung district, Chonburi, after preliminary tests detected high concentrations of antimony and cadmium . Deputy Government Spokesperson Lalida Perisvivatana said on 29 October that the tests found antimony at up to 720,000 parts per million (ppm), cadmium at 190,000 ppm and lead at 360 ppm. Laboratory analysis is still needed to confirm the results and to determine whether the material counts as hazardous waste. An inspection this week found industrial and municipal waste buried across more than 7 rai (about 11,200 square metres). Officials also found discarded cable insulation, plastic scraps, industrial waste bags and signs of burning. Air quality checks did not detect any volatile organic compounds, although inspectors reported chemical odours at the site. Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has instructed the Pollution Control Department to trace the origin of the waste and pursue legal action against those responsible. summary_cn: 泰国污染控制部接到举报，在春武里县（Chonburi）邦拉蒙（Banglamung）地区发现可疑的非法工业废料堆放点。初步检测显示现场锑含量达720000ppm、镉为190000ppm、铅为360ppm，均严重超标。现场已挖出超过7莱（1.12万平方米）的工业和生活垃圾、废电缆、塑料碎片等。环保部长已指示追查污染源头并依法查处。

title: Thailand sets new fuel fund rates from 1 November
desc: Thailand sets new fuel fund rates from 1 November Legacy Thailand’s Oil Fuel Fund Committee has set new fuel levy and subsidy rates from 1 November 2026, with diesel subsidised at 3.90 baht per litre and B20 diesel at 5.82 baht per litre. The committee issued Notice No. 181 on 30 October. It covers fuel produced in Thailand and imported for domestic use, and both are charged the same rates. The notice cancels Notice No. 178, issued on 29 October. The committee said the notice sets fund rates for each fuel type. It is not a direct announcement of pump prices at service stations. title: Chiang Rai school director shot dead in meeting room
desc: Chiang Rai school director shot dead in meeting room Legacy Police in Chiang Rai are hunting two gunmen who shot dead the director of a Chinese school in Mae Fah Luang district on Friday, October 30. The shooting happened at about 11am at the school in Village 27, Mae Salong Nai subdistrict. The victim, Sirasit (surname withheld), was shot with a 9mm firearm outside the school’s meeting room. Mae Fah Luang Police Station is investigating. A 49 year old construction foreman working at the school, Sakchai (surname withheld), told reporters he saw two strangers around the site at about 10am. He said they walked around the area and sat at its edge for 20 to 30 minutes. Workers assumed they were job seekers, as strangers often stopped by to watch the work. At about 11am, Sakchai and the crew heard two gunshots in quick succession and ran to the meeting room. They found Sirasit face down in a pool of blood by the door. Sakchai ran to fetch a senior teacher and rode a motorbike to find a doctor. Sirasit’s son Prasong arrived and took him to Mae Fah Luang Hospital, where he died. summary_cn: 泰国清莱府（Chiang Rai）美法隆县（Mae Fah Luang）一所中文学校校长西拉西（Sirasit）于10月30日上午11时左右在会议室外遭两名身份不明的枪手枪杀身亡。目击者称两人在现场逗留20-30分钟后实施作案，使用9毫米口径枪支。校长已被送往医院救治但不治身亡，两名枪手逃离现场。警方已介入调查。
